declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.DerivedVarieties.Representability.exists_iso_linearCoyoneda_of_isHomological_of_isRegular
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4A.** Let `X` be a proper scheme over a field `k` which is regular. Let
`G : D_perf(𝒪_X) → Vect_k` be a `k`-linear homological functor such that
`∑_{n ∈ ℤ} dim_k G(E[n]) < ∞` for all `E ∈ D_perf(𝒪_X)`. Then `G` is isomorphic to a functor of the
form `E ↦ Hom_X(K, E)` for some `K ∈ D_perf(𝒪_X)`.

Here `D_perf(𝒪_X)` is `AlgebraicGeometry.perfectDerived`, the perfect objects of the derived
category of `𝒪_X`-modules with its triangulated structure; "homological" is
`CategoryTheory.Functor.IsHomological`; `k`-linearity is for the `k`-structure induced by the
structure morphism, `AlgebraicGeometry.modulesLinear`; the sum is the cardinal sum of the
`k`-ranks over all of `ℤ`, and `< ∞` is `< ℵ₀`; regularity is `AlgebraicGeometry.IsRegular`
([Stacks, Tag 02IS]); and the isomorphism is one of `Vect_k`-valued functors with
`linearCoyoneda`, the `k`-linear `Hom_X(K, -)`.

The proof is the source's (`exists_iso_linearCoyoneda_of_representability`): `F(E) = G(E^∨)` is
cohomological of finite total dimension, so `F ≅ Hom_X(-, K')` with `K' ∈ D^b_Coh(𝒪_X)` by
[Stacks, Tag 0FYH] (`exists_iso_linearYoneda_of_isHomological_of_isProper`), `K'` is perfect by
[Stacks, Tag 0FDC], and `G ≅ Hom_X(K'^∨, -)` by [Stacks, Tag 08DQ].
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_iso_linearCoyoneda_of_isHomological_of_isRegular [IsProper X.hom]
    (hX : IsRegular X.left)
    (G : perfectDerived X.left ⥤ ModuleCat.{u} k) [G.IsHomological]
    (hG : ∀ {E E' : perfectDerived X.left} (f : E ⟶ E') (r : k), G.map (r • f) = r • G.map f)
    (hfin : ∀ E : perfectDerived X.left,
      Cardinal.sum (fun n : ℤ => Module.rank k (G.obj (E⟦n⟧))) < Cardinal.aleph0) :
    ∃ K : perfectDerived X.left,
      Nonempty (G ≅ (linearCoyoneda k (perfectDerived X.left)).obj (op K))

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.injective_baseChangeCyclePullback_fieldExtension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 0H4E.** For a scheme `X` locally of finite type over a field `k`
and an arbitrary extension `K/k` of fields, the base-change homomorphism
`Z_r(X) ⟶ Z_r(X_K)` on cycle groups is injective. The extension is not assumed algebraic, nor
even of finite type.
declarations.statement:
theorem injective_baseChangeCyclePullback_fieldExtension (k K : Type u) [Field k] [Field K]
    [Algebra k K] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (r : ℤ) :
    Function.Injective (baseChangeCyclePullback (fieldExtensionBaseChangeSituation k K) f r)
declarations.comment: the base change map on cycle groups along a field extension, and its injectivity

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.componentMultiplicity_baseChange_eq_one_or_char_pow
declarations.doc:
The multiplicity of an irreducible component of the base change of an integral scheme
locally of finite type over a field along a field extension is one or, in positive
characteristic, a power of the characteristic.
declarations.statement:
theorem componentMultiplicity_baseChange_eq_one_or_char_pow
    {k K : Type u} [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : Z ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsIntegral Z]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (ξ : genericPoints
      (pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K))) : Scheme)) :
    let ZK : Scheme := pullback f (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k K)))
    componentMultiplicity (𝟙 ZK) ξ = 1 ∨
      (ringChar k ≠ 0 ∧
        ∃ n : ℕ, componentMultiplicity (𝟙 ZK) ξ = (ringChar k : ℤ) ^ n)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.baseChangeCyclePullback_perfectClosure_injective
declarations.doc:
For an algebraic scheme `X` over a field `k`, the base-change homomorphism
`Z_r(X) ⟶ Z_r(X_{k^perf})` to the perfect closure of `k` is injective.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeCyclePullback_perfectClosure_injective (k : Type u) [Field k] (r : ℕ)
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] :
    Function.Injective
      (baseChangeCyclePullback (perfectClosureBaseChangeSituation k) f (r : ℤ))
declarations.comment: injectivity

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isElementPowerTorsion_cokernel_baseChangeCyclePullback_perfectClosure
declarations.doc:
For an algebraic scheme `X` over a field `k` of characteristic `p > 0`, the cokernel of the
base-change homomorphism `Z_r(X) ⟶ Z_r(X_{k^perf})` to the perfect closure of `k` is a `p`-power
torsion module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isElementPowerTorsion_cokernel_baseChangeCyclePullback_perfectClosure (k : Type u)
    [Field k] (p : ℕ) [CharP k p] (hp : 0 < p) (r : ℕ) {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] :
    IsElementPowerTorsion ℤ
      (CycleGroup (perfectClosureBaseChangeSituation k).baseChange
          (pullback.snd f (perfectClosureBaseChangeSituation k).g)
          ((r : ℤ) + (perfectClosureBaseChangeSituation k).c) ⧸
        (baseChangeCyclePullback (perfectClosureBaseChangeSituation k) f (r : ℤ)).range)
      (p : ℤ)
declarations.comment: p-power torsion cokernel

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.specializationMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H4H.** The specialization map `sp_{X/R} : Z_r(X_K) ⟶ Z_r(X_κ)` of a scheme locally
of finite type over a discrete valuation ring `R`, from the cycles on the generic fibre to the
cycles on the closed fibre. The generic fibre is the scheme-theoretic fibre over the generic
point of `Spec R`, whose residue field is the fraction field `K`, and the closed fibre is the
one over the closed point, whose residue field is `κ`.
declarations.statement:
def specializationMap (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R]
    {X : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (r : ℕ) :
    FiberCycleGroup sX (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r →+
      FiberCycleGroup sX (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) r
declarations.comment: the specialization map sp_{X/R}

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.topologicalKrullDim_supp_fiberModule_closedPoint_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4I.** Let `R` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K`
and residue field `kappa`, let `X` be a scheme locally of finite type over `R`, let `r >= 0` and
let `F` be a coherent `O_X`-module flat over `R`. If `dim(Supp(F_K)) <= r`, then
`dim(Supp(F_kappa)) <= r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem topologicalKrullDim_supp_fiberModule_closedPoint_le
    (hflat : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) (r : ℕ)
    (hK : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))))).obj F)) ≤
        (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R))).obj F)) ≤
      (r : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: the dimension bound on the special fibre

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_familyAssociatedToModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4I.** Let `R` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K`
and residue field `kappa`, let `X` be a scheme locally of finite type over `R`, let `r >= 0` and
let `F` be a coherent `O_X`-module flat over `R` with `dim(Supp(F_K)) <= r`. Then the
specialization map `sp_{X/R} : Z_r(X_K) -> Z_r(X_kappa)` carries `[F_K]_r` to `[F_kappa]_r`:
the member over the generic point of the family of cycles `[F/X/Spec R]_r` specializes to its
member over the closed point.
declarations.statement:
theorem specializationCycle_familyAssociatedToModule
    (hflat : AlgebraicGeometry.IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) (r : ℕ)
    (hK : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))))).obj F)) ≤
        (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    specializationCycle f r
        (familyAssociatedToModule f F r
          (topologicalKrullDim_supp_fiberModule_le_of_genericFibre f F hflat r hK)
          (genericPoint (Spec (.of R)))) =
      familyAssociatedToModule f F r
        (topologicalKrullDim_supp_fiberModule_le_of_genericFibre f F hflat r hK)
        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
declarations.comment: the specialization formula

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.topologicalKrullDim_supp_fiberClosedSubscheme_closedPoint_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H4J**, the dimension clause for the support of `i_* 𝒪_Z`. Let `R`
be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K` and residue field `κ`, let `Y` be locally
of finite type over `R`, let `r ≥ 0` and let `Z ⊆ Y` be a closed subscheme flat over `R`. If
`dim(Supp((i_* 𝒪_Z)_K)) ≤ r`, then `dim(Supp((i_* 𝒪_Z)_κ)) ≤ r`.

With `𝒪_Z` for the module this is the dimension clause of Tag 0H4I; it is the tag's own
statement `dim(Z_K) ≤ r ⟹ dim(Z_κ) ≤ r` read through
`Stacks.Chow.topologicalKrullDim_pullback_fiberι_eq_supp`, which is what
`Stacks.Chow.topologicalKrullDim_pullback_fiberClosedSubscheme_closedPoint_le` below does.
declarations.statement:
theorem topologicalKrullDim_supp_fiberClosedSubscheme_closedPoint_le {r : ℕ} {R : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [Flat (i ≫ p)]
    (hK : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (p.fiberι (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))))).obj
        (structureSheafPushforward i))) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (p.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R))).obj
        (structureSheafPushforward i))) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: the dimension bound on the special fibre, for the support of i_* 𝒪_Z

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H4J**, the specialization formula for the family of `i_* 𝒪_Z`. Let
`R` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K` and residue field `κ`, let `Y` be
locally of finite type over `R`, let `r ≥ 0` and let `Z ⊆ Y` be a closed subscheme flat over `R`
with `dim(Supp((i_* 𝒪_Z)_K)) ≤ r`. Then the specialization map `sp_{Y/R}` carries the member of
`[i_* 𝒪_Z/Y/Spec R]_r` over the generic point to its member over the closed point.

With `𝒪_Z` for the module this is the specialization clause of Tag 0H4I; the bound on every
fibre that the family `[Z/Y/Spec R]_r` consumes comes from the bound on the generic fibre by
`Stacks.Chow.topologicalKrullDim_supp_fiberModule_le_of_genericFibre`. The tag's own formula
`sp_{Y/R}([Z_K]_r) = [Z_κ]_r`, for the family `[Z/Y/Spec R]_r` of the closed subscheme itself,
is `Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_of_genericFibre` below.
declarations.statement:
theorem specializationCycle_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme {r : ℕ} {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (p : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType p] (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i] [Flat (i ≫ p)]
    (hK : topologicalKrullDim (SheafOfModules.supp
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (p.fiberι (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))))).obj
        (structureSheafPushforward i))) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    specializationCycle p r
        (familyAssociatedToModule p (structureSheafPushforward i) r
          (topologicalKrullDim_supp_fiberModule_le_of_genericFibre p
            (structureSheafPushforward i) (isFlatOver_pushforwardStructureSheaf i p) r hK)
          (genericPoint (Spec (.of R)))) =
      familyAssociatedToModule p (structureSheafPushforward i) r
        (topologicalKrullDim_supp_fiberModule_le_of_genericFibre p
          (structureSheafPushforward i) (isFlatOver_pushforwardStructureSheaf i p) r hK)
        (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
declarations.comment: the specialization formula for the family of i_* 𝒪_Z

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.topologicalKrullDim_pullback_fiberClosedSubscheme_closedPoint_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H4J.** Let `R` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K`
and residue field `κ`, let `Y` be locally of finite type over `R`, let `r ≥ 0` and let `Z ⊆ Y` be
a closed subscheme flat over `R`. If `dim(Z_K) ≤ r`, then `dim(Z_κ) ≤ r`.

This is the previous bound at the closed point of `Spec R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem topologicalKrullDim_pullback_fiberClosedSubscheme_closedPoint_le {r : ℕ} {R : Type u}
    [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [Flat (i ≫ p)]
    (hK : topologicalKrullDim (pullback i (p.fiberι (genericPoint (Spec (.of R)))) :
      Scheme.{u}) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    topologicalKrullDim (pullback i (p.fiberι (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)) :
      Scheme.{u}) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: the dimension bound on the special fibre

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_of_genericFibre
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H4J.** Let `R` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K`
and residue field `κ`, let `Y` be locally of finite type over `R`, let `r ≥ 0` and let `Z ⊆ Y` be
a closed subscheme flat over `R` with `dim(Z_K) ≤ r`. Then the specialization homomorphism
`sp_{Y/R}` of Section 0H4H carries `[Z_K]_r` to `[Z_κ]_r`.

This is the proof of the source: the family `[Z/Y/Spec R]_r` of the closed subscheme is the
family `[i_* 𝒪_Z/Y/Spec R]_r` of its structure sheaf by Chow Homology, Lemma 42.10.3, which is
`Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_eq_familyAssociatedToModule`, and for that family
the formula is the specialization clause of Tag 0H4I. The bound on every fibre that the
identification consumes comes from the bound on the generic fibre by
`Stacks.Chow.topologicalKrullDim_pullback_fiberι_le_of_genericFibre`.
declarations.statement:
theorem specializationCycle_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_of_genericFibre {r : ℕ}
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {Y Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [Flat (i ≫ p)]
    (hK : topologicalKrullDim (pullback i (p.fiberι (genericPoint (Spec (.of R)))) :
      Scheme.{u}) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    specializationCycle p r
        (familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme p i r (genericPoint (Spec (.of R)))) =
      familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme p i r (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R)
declarations.comment: the specialization formula

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFiberCycleOfEq_comp_specializationCycleHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4K.** Let `R'/R` be an extension of discrete valuation rings,
inducing a fraction field extension `K'/K` and a residue field extension `κ'/κ`, let `X` be
locally of finite type over `R` and let `X' = X_{R'}`. For `r ≥ 0` the square formed by the
specialization homomorphisms `sp_{X/R} : Z_r(X_K) ⟶ Z_r(X_κ)` and
`sp_{X'/R'} : Z_r(X'_{K'}) ⟶ Z_r(X'_{κ'})` of Section 0H4H and the base change maps of
Section 0H4E commutes.

The integral-subscheme case is
`Stacks.Chow.specializationCompatibleWithBaseChange` and the passage from it to an arbitrary
cycle is `Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFiberCycleOfEq_comp_specializationCycleHom_of_generator`.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeFiberCycleOfEq_comp_specializationCycleHom :
    (baseChangeSpecialFibreCycle R' f r).comp (specializationCycleHom f r) =
      (specializationCycleHom (pullback.snd f (specMapAlgebraMap R R')) r).comp
        (baseChangeGenericFibreCycle R' f r)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.fiberCycleFlatPullback_comp_specializationCycleHom
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H4L.** Let `R` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K`
and residue field `κ`, let `X` be a scheme locally of finite type over `R`, and let `p : X' ⟶ X`
be a morphism which is locally of finite type, flat and of relative dimension `e`. Then for
`r ≥ 0` the square formed by the specialization homomorphisms
`sp_{X/R} : Z_r(X_K) ⟶ Z_r(X_κ)` and `sp_{X'/R} : Z_{r+e}(X'_K) ⟶ Z_{r+e}(X'_κ)` of
Section 0H4H and the flat pullbacks `Z_r(X_K) ⟶ Z_{r+e}(X'_K)`, `Z_r(X_κ) ⟶ Z_{r+e}(X'_κ)` of
Section 0H4N commutes.

The integral-subscheme case is
`Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_fiberCycleFlatPullback_integralGenericCycle`. The passage from
it to an arbitrary cycle is the regrouping below: the coefficient of `sp_{X'/R}` of a flat
pullback is a locally finite sum over the points of `X'_K`, which is summed along the fibres of
`X'_K ⟶ X_K` and each fibre identified with the corresponding term of the flat pullback of
`sp_{X/R}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem fiberCycleFlatPullback_comp_specializationCycleHom :
    (fiberCycleFlatPullback f fX' p hp e he (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) r).comp
        (specializationCycleHom f r) =
      (specializationCycleHom fX' (r + e)).comp
        (fiberCycleFlatPullback f fX' p hp e he (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_baseChangedFiberCycleFlatPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H4L** for the base change of a flat morphism of the source to the
spectrum of a discrete valuation ring over the base. This is the shape in which the valuative
condition of Definition 0H50 compares the two members of a flat pullback of a family of cycles on
fibres: `Stacks.Chow.baseChangedFiberCycleFlatPullback` is flat pullback along the base change of
`j`, which is again flat, locally of finite type and of relative dimension `e`.
declarations.statement:
theorem specializationCycle_baseChangedFiberCycleFlatPullback {X S U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j] (h : j ≫ f = fU) (e : ℕ)
    (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e) {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] (g : Spec (.of R) ⟶ S) (r : ℕ)
    (c : FiberCycleGroup (pullback.snd f g) (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r) :
    baseChangedFiberCycleFlatPullback f fU j h e he g (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) r
        (specializationCycle (pullback.snd f g) r c) =
      specializationCycle (pullback.snd fU g) (r + e)
        (baseChangedFiberCycleFlatPullback f fU j h e he g
          (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r c)
declarations.comment: for the base change of the flat morphism to the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring over the base

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_fiberCycleRestrict
declarations.doc:
The specialization map commutes with restriction to an open subscheme of the source: for
`j : U ⟶ X` an open immersion of schemes locally of finite type over a discrete valuation ring
`R`, restricting an `r`-cycle on the generic fibre of `X` to the generic fibre of `U` and then
specializing is the same as specializing and then restricting to the special fibre of `U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem specializationCycle_fiberCycleRestrict {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {X U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (h : j ≫ f = fU) (r : ℕ)
    (c : FiberCycleGroup f (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r) :
    specializationCycle fU r
        (fiberCycleRestrict f fU j h (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r c) =
      fiberCycleRestrict f fU j h (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) r (specializationCycle f r c)
declarations.comment: open immersions

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_properPushforwardFamily
declarations.doc:
Specialization of cycles over a discrete valuation ring commutes with pushforward along a
closed immersion over that ring: pushing the specialization of a cycle on the generic fibre forward
along the morphism of closed fibres gives the specialization of its pushforward along the morphism
of generic fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem specializationCycle_properPushforwardFamily
    (c : FiberCycleGroup sX (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r) :
    fiberProperPushforward sX sY i hi (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) r (specializationCycle sX r c) =
      specializationCycle sY r
        (fiberProperPushforward sX sY i hi (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r c)
declarations.comment: specialization commutes with pushforward along a closed immersion

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_fiberProperPushforward
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H4M.** Let `R` be a discrete valuation ring with fraction field `K` and residue
field `κ`, let `f : X ⟶ Y` be a proper morphism of schemes locally of finite type over `R` and
let `r ≥ 0`. The square formed by the specialization maps `sp_{X/R} : Z_r(X_K) ⟶ Z_r(X_κ)` and
`sp_{Y/R} : Z_r(Y_K) ⟶ Z_r(Y_κ)` and the proper pushforwards along the morphisms `f_K` and
`f_κ` induced by `f` on the generic and the closed fibres commutes.
declarations.statement:
theorem specializationCycle_fiberProperPushforward (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] (hf : f ≫ sY = sX) (r : ℕ)
    (c : FiberCycleGroup sX (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r) :
    fiberProperPushforward sX sY f hf (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) r
        (specializationCycle sX r c) =
      specializationCycle sY r
        (fiberProperPushforward sX sY f hf (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r c)
declarations.comment: the square of the specialization maps and the proper pushforwards commutes

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.properPushforward_specializationMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H4M**, read on the specialization map `sp_{X/R}` of Stacks 0H4H: the square
formed by `sp_{X/R}`, `sp_{Y/R}` and the proper pushforwards along the morphisms induced by `f`
on the generic and the closed fibres commutes.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforward_specializationMap (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ Spec (.of R))
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (sY : Y ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [IsProper f] (hf : f ≫ sY = sX) (r : ℕ)
    (α : FiberCycleGroup sX (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r) :
    fiberProperPushforward sX sY f hf (IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) r
        (specializationMap R sX r α) =
      specializationMap R sY r
        (fiberProperPushforward sX sY f hf (genericPoint (Spec (.of R))) r α)
declarations.comment: the square, read on the specialization map sp_{X/R} of Stacks 0H4H

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.flatPullbackFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Section 0H4N.** The flat pullback `j^*α` of a family `α` of `r`-cycles on
the fibres of `X/S` along a flat morphism `j : U ⟶ X` of schemes over `S`, locally of finite type
and of relative dimension `e`: the family of `(r+e)`-cycles on the fibres of `U/S` whose member
over `s` is the flat pullback of `α_s` along `U_s ⟶ X_s`.
declarations.statement:
def flatPullbackFamily {X S U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j] (h : j ≫ f = fU)
    (e : ℕ) (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    FamilyOfCycles fU (r + e)
declarations.comment: flat pullback of a family of cycles on fibres

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamily_baseChangeFamily_comp
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4P, part (1).** Base change of families of cycles on fibres is
functorial: base changing a family `α` of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` along `g : S' ⟶ S`
and then along `h : S'' ⟶ S'` is base changing it along `h ≫ g`, the two families being
identified through the canonical isomorphism `(X ×_S S') ×_{S'} S'' ≅ X ×_S S''`.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeFamily_baseChangeFamily_comp {X S S' S'' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : S' ⟶ S) (h : S'' ⟶ S') (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    baseChangeFamily (pullback.snd f g) h r (baseChangeFamily f g r α) =
      fun u => fiberCycleRestrict (pullback.snd f (h ≫ g)) (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) h)
        (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso f g h).hom (pullbackLeftPullbackSndIso_hom_snd f g h) u r
        (baseChangeFamily f (h ≫ g) r α u)
declarations.comment: part (1): base change is functorial

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.restrictedFamily_eq_flatPullbackFamily_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4P, part (2).** Restriction of families of cycles on fibres is a
combination of base change and flat pullback: for open subschemes `U ⊆ X` and `V ⊆ S` with
`f(U) ⊆ V`, the restriction `α|_U` of a family `α` of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` is the
flat pullback, along the open immersion `U ⟶ X ×_S V` (flat of relative dimension zero), of the
base change of `α` along `V ⟶ S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictedFamily_eq_flatPullbackFamily_baseChangeFamily (r : ℕ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    (restrictedFamily f fU j i h r α).1 =
      flatPullbackFamily (pullback.snd f i) fU (pullback.lift j fU h) (pullback.lift_snd _ _ _) 0
        (relativeDimension_of_isOpenImmersion _) r (baseChangeFamily f i r α)
declarations.comment: part (2): restriction is base change followed by flat pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamily_flatPullbackFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4P, part (3).** Flat pullback of families of cycles on fibres commutes
with base change: for a flat morphism `j : U ⟶ X` over `S`, locally of finite type and of
relative dimension `e`, and a morphism `g : T ⟶ S`, the base change of `j^*α` along `g` is the
flat pullback of `g^*α` along the base change `U ×_S T ⟶ X ×_S T` of `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeFamily_flatPullbackFamily {X S U T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j] (h : j ≫ f = fU) (e : ℕ)
    (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e) (g : T ⟶ S) (r : ℕ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    baseChangeFamily fU g (r + e) (flatPullbackFamily f fU j h e he r α) =
      flatPullbackFamily (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.snd fU g) (pullbackRestrict f fU j h g)
        (pullbackRestrict_snd f fU j h g) e (relativeDimension_pullbackRestrict f fU j h g he) r
        (baseChangeFamily f g r α)
declarations.comment: part (3): flat pullback commutes with base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.flatPullbackFamily_flatPullbackFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4P, part (4).** Flat pullback of families of cycles on fibres is
functorial: for flat morphisms `j : U ⟶ X` and `k : V ⟶ U` over `S`, locally of finite type and
of relative dimensions `e` and `e'`, pulling a family `α` of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S`
back along `j` and then along `k` is pulling it back along `k ≫ j`, which has relative dimension
`e' + e`.

The two families are families of cycles of the dimensions `(r + e) + e'` and `r + (e' + e)`,
which are equal but not definitionally so; the statement is the equality of the underlying
cycles on every fibre of `V/S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullbackFamily_flatPullbackFamily {X S U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (fV : V ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType fV] (j : U ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j] (k : V ⟶ U)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType k] [Flat k] (h : j ≫ f = fU) (hk : k ≫ fU = fV) (e e' : ℕ)
    (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e)
    (he' : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension k e') (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (s : S) :
    (flatPullbackFamily fU fV k hk e' he' (r + e) (flatPullbackFamily f fU j h e he r α) s :
        AlgebraicCycle (fV.fiber s) ℤ) =
      (flatPullbackFamily f fV (k ≫ j) (by rw [Category.assoc, h, hk]) (e' + e)
        (AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension.comp_of_flat k j he' he) r α s :
          AlgebraicCycle (fV.fiber s) ℤ)
declarations.comment: part (4): flat pullback is functorial

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamily_properPushforwardFamily_of_isProper
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4P, part (5).** Proper pushforward of families of cycles on fibres
commutes with base change: for a proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` of schemes locally of finite type
over `S` and a morphism `g : S' ⟶ S`, the base change of `f_*α` along `g` is the pushforward of
`g^*α` along the base change `X ×_S S' ⟶ Y ×_S S'` of `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeFamily_properPushforwardFamily_of_isProper (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles sX r) :
    baseChangeFamily sY g r (properPushforwardFamily sX sY f hf r α) =
      properPushforwardFamily (pullback.snd sX g) (pullback.snd sY g)
        (baseChangeMap sX sY f hf g) (baseChangeMap_snd sX sY f hf g) r
        (baseChangeFamily sX g r α)
declarations.comment: part (5): proper pushforward commutes with base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardFamily_properPushforwardFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4P, part (6).** Proper pushforward of families of cycles on fibres is
functorial: for proper morphisms `f₁ : X ⟶ Y` and `f₂ : Y ⟶ Z` of schemes locally of finite type
over `S`, pushing a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` forward along `f₁` and then along
`f₂` is pushing it forward along `f₁ ≫ f₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforwardFamily_properPushforwardFamily {S X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (sY : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (sZ : Z ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sZ] (f₁ : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper f₁] (f₂ : Y ⟶ Z) [IsProper f₂]
    (hf₁ : f₁ ≫ sY = sX) (hf₂ : f₂ ≫ sZ = sY) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles sX r) :
    properPushforwardFamily sY sZ f₂ hf₂ r (properPushforwardFamily sX sY f₁ hf₁ r α) =
      properPushforwardFamily sX sZ (f₁ ≫ f₂) (by rw [Category.assoc, hf₂, hf₁]) r α
declarations.comment: part (6): proper pushforward is functorial

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.flatPullbackFamily_properPushforwardFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4P, part (7).** Proper pushforward of families of cycles on fibres
commutes with flat pullback: for a proper morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` and a flat morphism `g : Y' ⟶ Y`
of relative dimension `e` of schemes locally of finite type over `S`, with base changes
`f' : X ×_Y Y' ⟶ Y'` and `g' : X ×_Y Y' ⟶ X`, one has `g^*(f_*α) = f'_*((g')^*α)` for every
family `α` of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flatPullbackFamily_properPushforwardFamily (e : ℕ)
    (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension g e) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles sX r) :
    flatPullbackFamily sY sY' g hg e he r (properPushforwardFamily sX sY f hf r α) =
      properPushforwardFamily (pullback.fst f g ≫ sX) sY' (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullback_snd_comp_eq_fst_comp sX sY sY' f hf g hg) (r + e)
        (flatPullbackFamily sX (pullback.fst f g ≫ sX) (pullback.fst f g) rfl e
          (AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension.of_isPullback (IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g).flip
            he) r α)
declarations.comment: part (7): proper pushforward commutes with flat pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H4Q.** The family `[F/X/S]_r` of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `f` attached to a
quasi-coherent module `F` of finite type whose support on every fibre has dimension at most
`r`: its member over `s` is the cycle `[F_s]_r` associated to the pullback of `F` to the fibre
over `s`.
declarations.statement:
def familyAssociatedToModule (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤
        (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    FamilyOfCycles f r
declarations.comment: the associated family

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToModule_apply
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H4Q.** The member of `[F/X/S]_r` over a point `s` of the base is the cycle
`[F_s]_r` associated to the pullback of `F` to the fibre over `s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyAssociatedToModule_apply (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤
        (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) (s : S) :
    familyAssociatedToModule f F r hdim s =
      cycleAssociatedToCoherentSheaf (fieldChowSituation (S.residueField s))
        (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s) ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F) (r : ℤ)
        (fiberModule_schemeDeltaDimension_le f F r hdim s)
declarations.comment: fibrewise formula

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.supportDimension_le_of_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4R.** The dimension bound on the fibrewise supports of a
quasi-coherent module of finite type survives base change along a morphism that induces an
isomorphism on every residue field: the support on the fibre over `t` is the inverse image of the
support on the fibre over `g t` along an isomorphism of fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportDimension_le_of_baseChange (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (hres : ∀ t : S', IsIso (g.residueFieldMap t)) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∀ t : S', topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ((pullback.snd f g).fiberι t)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F))) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: module_base_change, residue-field-isomorphism case: dimension bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToModule_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4R.** Base change along a morphism `g` that induces an isomorphism on
every residue field carries the family of cycles associated to a quasi-coherent module of finite
type to the family associated to the base-changed module. Coefficientwise: the base change
preserves the multiplicity of the module and the relative dimension of a point of the fibre, and
the support of the base-changed module on a fibre over `t` is the inverse image of the support of
the original one on the fibre over `g t`.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyAssociatedToModule_baseChange (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (hres : ∀ t : S', IsIso (g.residueFieldMap t)) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    baseChangeFamilyOfResidueIso f g hres r (familyAssociatedToModule f F r hdim) =
      familyAssociatedToModule (pullback.snd f g)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) r
        (supportDimension_le_of_baseChange f g hres F r hdim)
declarations.comment: module_base_change, residue-field-isomorphism case

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.supportDimension_le_of_flatPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4R.** The fibrewise support dimension bound on a quasi-coherent
module of finite type passes to its pullback along a flat morphism `j : U ⟶ X` of schemes over
`S`, locally of finite type and of relative dimension `e`, with `r` replaced by `r + e`: on the
fibre over `s` this is the support dimension bound of Stacks 02RE, part (2), for the induced
morphism `U_s ⟶ X_s`, which is again flat of relative dimension `e`.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportDimension_le_of_flatPullback (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j] (h : j ≫ f = fU)
    (e : ℕ) (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤
        (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (fU.fiberι s)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj F))) ≤ ((r + e : ℕ) : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: module_flat_pullback: dimension bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToModule_flatPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4R.** The flat pullback of the family `[F/X/S]_r` of cycles
associated to a quasi-coherent module of finite type, along a flat morphism `j : U ⟶ X` of
schemes over `S` which is locally of finite type and of relative dimension `e`, is the family
`[j^*F/U/S]_{r+e}` associated to the pulled-back module.

On the fibre over `s` the morphism `U_s ⟶ X_s` induced by `j` is flat, locally of finite type and
of relative dimension `e`, so Stacks 02RE, part (2), identifies the flat pullback of the cycle
`[F_s]_r` with the cycle of the pullback of `F_s`; that pullback is the restriction of `j^*F` to
the fibre of `f_U`, the two orders of pulling `F` back being compared by the
pullback-composition isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyAssociatedToModule_flatPullback (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j] (h : j ≫ f = fU)
    (e : ℕ) (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤
        (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    flatPullbackFamily f fU j h e he r (familyAssociatedToModule f F r hdim) =
      familyAssociatedToModule fU ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj F) (r + e)
        (supportDimension_le_of_flatPullback f fU j h e he F r hdim)
declarations.comment: module_flat_pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.supportDimension_le_of_baseChange_general
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4R.** The fibrewise support dimension bound on a quasi-coherent
module of finite type survives base change along an arbitrary morphism of bases: the fibre of
`X ×_S S' ⟶ S'` over `t` is the base change of the fibre of `f` over `g t` along the residue
field extension `κ(t)/κ(g t)`, the support of the pulled-back module on it is the inverse image
of the support on the fibre over `g t`, and no point of the former has larger delta-dimension
than its image.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportDimension_le_of_baseChange_general (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤
        (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∀ t : S', topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback ((pullback.snd f g).fiberι t)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F))) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: module_base_change, arbitrary morphism of bases: dimension bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToModule_baseChange_general
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4R.** Base change of the family `[F/X/S]_r` of cycles associated to a
quasi-coherent module of finite type along an *arbitrary* morphism `g : S' ⟶ S` of bases is the
family associated to the pulled-back module.

The fibre of `X ×_S S' ⟶ S'` over a point `t` is the base change of the fibre of `f` over `g t`
along the residue field extension `κ(t)/κ(g t)`. That extension is flat and the dimension shift
of the associated base change of Chow situations vanishes, so Stacks 0FVI part (2) applies and
identifies the base change of the cycle `[F_{g t}]_r` with the cycle of the base-changed module;
transporting the result along the canonical isomorphism of fibres, which is an open immersion,
changes neither multiplicities nor relative dimensions.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyAssociatedToModule_baseChange_general (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤
        (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    baseChangeFamily f g r (familyAssociatedToModule f F r hdim) =
      familyAssociatedToModule (pullback.snd f g)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (pullback.fst f g)).obj F) r
        (supportDimension_le_of_baseChange_general f g F r hdim)
declarations.comment: module_base_change, arbitrary morphism of bases

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.supportDimension_le_of_openRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4R.** The dimension bound on the fibrewise supports of a
quasi-coherent module of finite type survives restriction of both the source and the base to
compatible open subschemes: the support on the fibre of `fU` over `t` is the inverse image of
the support on the fibre of `f` over `i t` along an open immersion of fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportDimension_le_of_openRestriction {X S U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ V) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (i : V ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i] (h : j ≫ f = fU ≫ i) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    ∀ t : V, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (fU.fiberι t)).obj
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj F))) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)
declarations.comment: module_restriction: dimension bound

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToModule_openRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4R.** The restriction to `U/V` of the family of cycles associated to
a quasi-coherent module of finite type is the family associated to the module restricted to `U`.
Coefficientwise: restriction preserves the multiplicity of the module and the relative dimension
of a point of the fibre, and the support of the restricted module on a fibre of `fU` is the
inverse image of the support of the original one.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyAssociatedToModule_openRestriction {X S U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ V) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (i : V ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i] (h : j ≫ f = fU ≫ i) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι s)).obj F)) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    (restrictedFamily f fU j i h r (familyAssociatedToModule f F r hdim)).1 =
      familyAssociatedToModule fU ((Scheme.Modules.pullback j).obj F) r
        (supportDimension_le_of_openRestriction f fU j i h F r hdim)
declarations.comment: module_restriction

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme
declarations.doc:
The family `[Z/X/S]_r` of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `f` attached to a
closed subscheme `i : Z ⟶ X` whose fibres have dimension at most `r`: its member over `s` is the
cycle `[Z_s]_r` of the inverse image of `Z` in the fibre over `s`.
declarations.statement:
def familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] {Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (r : ℕ) : FamilyOfCycles f r
declarations.comment: the associated family

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_apply
declarations.doc:
The member of `[Z/X/S]_r` over a point `s` of the base is the cycle
`[Z_s]_r` of the inverse image of `Z` in the fibre over `s`.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_apply (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    {Z : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (r : ℕ) (s : S) :
    familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme f i r s =
      cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (fieldChowSituation (S.residueField s))
        (f.fiberToSpecResidueField s) (fiberClosedImmersion f i s) (r : ℤ)
declarations.comment: fibrewise formula

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4T (base change).** The construction of Example 0H4S is compatible
with base change: let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed
subscheme with `dim(Z_s) ≤ r` for every `s ∈ S`, and let `g : S' ⟶ S` be an arbitrary morphism of
schemes. Then the base change of the family `[Z/X/S]_r` along `g` is the family attached to the
inverse image `Z ×_X (X ×_S S')` of `Z` in `X ×_S S'`.

With `F = i_* 𝒪_Z` the family `[Z/X/S]_r` is `[F/X/S]_r` by Chow Homology, Lemma 02QY, read on
each fibre, so this is the base-change clause of Lemma 0H4R applied to `F`, together with the
identification of the inverse image of `F` with the direct image of the structure sheaf of the
base change of `Z`.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_baseChange (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (r : ℕ)
    (hZ : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim (pullback i (f.fiberι s) : Scheme.{u}) ≤
      (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    baseChangeFamily f g r (familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme f i r) =
      familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (pullback.snd f g)
        (pullback.snd i (pullback.fst f g)) r
declarations.comment: base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_flatPullback
declarations.doc:
The construction of Example 0H4S is compatible with flat pullback: let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally
of finite type, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed subscheme with `dim(Z_s) ≤ r` for every `s ∈ S`, and
let `j : U ⟶ X` be flat, locally of finite type and of relative dimension `e`, a morphism of
schemes over `S` through `j ≫ f = f_U`. Then the flat pullback of the family `[Z/X/S]_r` along `j`
is the family `[Z ×_X U / U / S]_{r+e}` attached to the scheme-theoretic inverse image of `Z` in
`U`.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_flatPullback (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (fU : U ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j]
    (h : j ≫ f = fU) (e : ℕ) (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e) (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (r : ℕ)
    (hZ : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim (pullback i (f.fiberι s) : Scheme.{u}) ≤
      (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    flatPullbackFamily f fU j h e he r (familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme f i r) =
      familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme fU (pullback.snd i j) (r + e)
declarations.comment: flat pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_openRestriction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4T (restriction).** The construction of Example 0H4S is compatible
with restriction: let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type, let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed
subscheme with `dim(Z_s) ≤ r` for every `s ∈ S`, and let `j : U ⟶ X` and `i' : V ⟶ S` be open
subschemes with `fU : U ⟶ V` making the square commute. Then the restriction of the family
`[Z/X/S]_r` to the fibres of `U/V` is the family `[Z ∩ U / U / V]_r` attached to the closed
subscheme `Z ∩ U = Z ×_X U` of `U`.

Coefficientwise: restriction preserves the multiplicity of a component of a fibre of `Z` and
the relative dimension of a point of a fibre, and a component of `Z_{i' t}` contributes to the
restricted family exactly when it meets `U_t`. The comparison over a single point `t` of `V`
needs the dimension bound only over `i' t`; that is
`Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_openRestriction_apply`.
declarations.statement:
theorem familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme_openRestriction (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (fU : U ⟶ V) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (i' : V ⟶ S)
    [IsOpenImmersion i'] (h : j ≫ f = fU ≫ i') (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ∀ s : S,
      topologicalKrullDim ↥(pullback i (f.fiberι s)) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    (restrictedFamily f fU j i' h r (familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme f i r)).1 =
      familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme fU (pullback.fst j i) r
declarations.comment: restriction

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.supportOfFamily
declarations.doc:
The support of a family of cycles on the fibres of `f`: the union in `X` of the images of the
supports of its members.
declarations.statement:
def supportOfFamily {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] {r : ℕ}
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) : Set X
declarations.comment: support_of_a_family_of_cycles

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_family_support_not_closed
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4U.** The support of a family of cycles on fibres need not be
closed in the total space.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_family_support_not_closed :
    ∃ (X S : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S) (h : LocallyOfFiniteType f),
      letI : LocallyOfFiniteType f := h
      ∃ (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r), ¬ IsClosed (supportOfFamily f α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.supportOfFamily_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4V, the base-change clause.** Taking the support of a family of
cycles on the fibres is compatible with base change: the support of `g^*α` is the inverse image
of the support of `α` along the projection `X ×_S S' ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportOfFamily_baseChangeFamily {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : S' ⟶ S) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    supportOfFamily (pullback.snd f g) (baseChangeFamily f g r α) =
      pullback.fst f g ⁻¹' supportOfFamily f α
declarations.comment: base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.supportOfFamily_flatPullbackFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4V, the flat pullback clause.** Taking the support of a family of
cycles on the fibres is compatible with flat pullback: the support of `j^*α` is the inverse
image of the support of `α` along `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem supportOfFamily_flatPullbackFamily {X S U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ S) (j : U ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j]
    (hj : j ≫ f = fU) (e : ℕ) (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e) (r : ℕ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType fU := hj ▸ (inferInstance : LocallyOfFiniteType (j ≫ f))
    supportOfFamily fU (flatPullbackFamily f fU j hj e he r α) = j ⁻¹' supportOfFamily f α
declarations.comment: flat pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.image_supportOfFamily_restrictedFamily
declarations.doc:
The support of a restricted family of cycles, mapped back into the original total space, is
the intersection of the original support with the open subscheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem image_supportOfFamily_restrictedFamily
    {X S U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ V)
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (i : V ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (h : j ≫ f = fU ≫ i) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType fU := by
      let : LocallyOfFiniteType (fU ≫ i) := h ▸ inferInstance
      exact locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp fU i
    j '' (supportOfFamily fU (restrictedFamily f fU j i h r α).1) =
      Set.range j ∩ supportOfFamily f α
declarations.comment: support_restriction

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_preimage_preserving_residueField_trdeg
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type, let
`g : S' ⟶ S` be surjective and let `f' : X' ⟶ S'` be the base change of `f`. A point `x : X`
whose residue field has transcendence degree `r` over the residue field of `f x` has a preimage
in `X'` whose residue field has transcendence degree `r` over the residue field of its image in
`S'`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_preimage_preserving_residueField_trdeg {p : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} (hpb : IsPullback p f' f g) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [Surjective g]
    (r : ℕ) (x : X)
    (hr : letI := (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.trdeg ↥(S.residueField (f x)) ↥(X.residueField x) = r) :
    ∃ (x' : X') (_hx : p x' = x),
      letI := (f'.residueFieldMap x').hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.trdeg ↥(S'.residueField (f' x')) ↥(X'.residueField x') = r
declarations.comment: part (1)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_common_preimage_preserving_residueField_trdeg
declarations.doc:
In the situation of `AlgebraicGeometry.exists_preimage_preserving_residueField_trdeg`, let
`S''` be the self-intersection `S' ×_S S'` of the base change, with projections `q₁` and `q₂`,
and let `f'' : X'' ⟶ S''` be the base change of `f` to `S''`, with projections `p₁` and `p₂` to
`X'` exhibiting `X''` as `X' ×_X X'`. Two preimages `x₁'` and `x₂'` of `x` of the same relative
transcendence degree `r` are the two images of a point of `X''` whose residue field again has
transcendence degree `r` over the residue field of its image in `S''`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_common_preimage_preserving_residueField_trdeg {p : X' ⟶ X} {f' : X' ⟶ S'}
    {f : X ⟶ S} {g : S' ⟶ S} {q₁ q₂ : S'' ⟶ S'} {p₁ p₂ : X'' ⟶ X'} {f'' : X'' ⟶ S''}
    (hX' : IsPullback p f' f g) (hS'' : IsPullback q₁ q₂ g g)
    (hX''₁ : IsPullback p₁ f'' f' q₁) (hX''₂ : IsPullback p₂ f'' f' q₂)
    (hXX : IsPullback p₁ p₂ p p) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (r : ℕ) (x : X) (x₁' x₂' : X')
    (hr : letI := (f.residueFieldMap x).hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.trdeg ↥(S.residueField (f x)) ↥(X.residueField x) = r)
    (hx₁ : p x₁' = x) (hx₂ : p x₂' = x)
    (hr₁ : letI := (f'.residueFieldMap x₁').hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.trdeg ↥(S'.residueField (f' x₁')) ↥(X'.residueField x₁') = r)
    (hr₂ : letI := (f'.residueFieldMap x₂').hom.toAlgebra
      Algebra.trdeg ↥(S'.residueField (f' x₂')) ↥(X'.residueField x₂') = r) :
    ∃ x'' : X'', p₁ x'' = x₁' ∧ p₂ x'' = x₂' ∧
      (letI := (f''.residueFieldMap x'').hom.toAlgebra
       Algebra.trdeg ↥(S''.residueField (f'' x'')) ↥(X''.residueField x'') = r)
declarations.comment: part (2)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamily_injective
declarations.doc:
Base change of families of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X / S` along a surjective morphism
`g : S' ⟶ S` is injective: if `g^*α₁ = g^*α₂` then `α₁ = α₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeFamily_injective (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : S' ⟶ S)
    [Surjective g] (r : ℕ) (α₁ α₂ : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    (h : baseChangeFamily f g r α₁ = baseChangeFamily f g r α₂) :
    α₁ = α₂
declarations.comment: injectivity of base change on families of cycles on fibres

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.existsUnique_familyOfCycles_baseChangeFamily_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H4X (2).** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of finite type, let `r ≥ 0`, let
`g : S' ⟶ S` be a morphism such that every point of `S` has a preimage in `S'` whose residue
field extension is separable, and let `X' = X ×_S S'`. Given a family `α'` of `r`-cycles on the
fibres of `X' / S'` whose two pullbacks to the double overlap `S'' = S' ×_S S'` agree as families
of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `S'' ×_S X / S''`, there is a unique family `α` of `r`-cycles on
the fibres of `X / S` with `g^*α = α'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem existsUnique_familyOfCycles_baseChangeFamily_eq (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (hg : HasSeparableResidueFieldPoints g) (r : ℕ)
    (α' : FamilyOfCycles (pullback.snd f g) r)
    (hα' : ∀ (t : (pullback g g : Scheme.{u}))
      (x : (pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.fst g g)).fiber t),
      (baseChangeFamily (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.fst g g) r α' t :
          AlgebraicCycle ((pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.fst g g)).fiber t) ℤ) x =
        (baseChangeFamily (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.snd g g) r α' t :
            AlgebraicCycle ((pullback.snd (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.snd g g)).fiber t) ℤ)
          ((overlapFiberComparison f g t).hom x)) :
    ∃! α : FamilyOfCycles f r, baseChangeFamily f g r α = α'
declarations.comment:
descent of a family of cycles on fibres along a morphism with separable residue
  field extensions

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamilyOfCyclesAddEquiv
declarations.doc:
Base change along a morphism that is bijective on points and
induces isomorphisms of residue fields identifies the groups of families of cycles on the
fibres.
declarations.statement:
def baseChangeFamilyOfCyclesAddEquiv
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (hg : Function.Bijective g)
    (hres : ∀ t : S', IsIso (g.residueFieldMap t)) (r : ℕ) :
    FamilyOfCycles f r ≃+ FamilyOfCycles (pullback.snd f g) r
declarations.comment: the additive equivalence

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamilyOfCyclesAddEquiv_apply
declarations.doc:
The base-changed family has, on each fibre, the coefficients
of the original family transported along the canonical map of fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChangeFamilyOfCyclesAddEquiv_apply
    {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (g : S' ⟶ S) (hg : Function.Bijective g)
    (hres : ∀ t : S', IsIso (g.residueFieldMap t)) (r : ℕ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (t : S') (x : (pullback.snd f g).fiber t) :
    ((baseChangeFamilyOfCyclesAddEquiv f g hg hres r α) t :
      AlgebraicCycle ((pullback.snd f g).fiber t) ℤ) x =
        (α (g t) : AlgebraicCycle (f.fiber (g t)) ℤ)
          (restrictedFiberMap f (pullback.snd f g) (pullback.fst f g) g
            pullback.condition t x)
declarations.comment: the coefficient formula

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.IsRelativeCycle
declarations.doc:
A family `α` of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` is a *relative `r`-cycle* when for every
discrete valuation ring `R` and every morphism `g : Spec R ⟶ S` the specialization of the generic
member of the base change `g^*α` is its closed member: `sp_{X'/S'}(α_η) = α_0`.
declarations.statement:
def IsRelativeCycle {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) : Prop
declarations.comment: relative r-cycles

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCycles
declarations.doc:
The group `z(X/S, r)` of relative `r`-cycles on `X/S`: the subgroup of the group of families
of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` cut out by the valuative condition.
declarations.statement:
def relativeCycles {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) : AddSubgroup (FamilyOfCycles f r)
declarations.comment: the group z(X/S, r)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H51, the base change clause.** The base change of a relative
`r`-cycle along an arbitrary morphism `g : S' ⟶ S` of locally Noetherian schemes is a relative
`r`-cycle on `X ×_S S'` over `S'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_baseChangeFamily {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] [IsLocallyNoetherian S'] (g : S' ⟶ S)
    (r : ℕ) {α : FamilyOfCycles f r} (hα : IsRelativeCycle f r α) :
    IsRelativeCycle (pullback.snd f g) r (baseChangeFamily f g r α)
declarations.comment: base change along an arbitrary morphism of locally Noetherian bases

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_flatPullbackFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H51, the flat pullback clause.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of
finite type with `S` locally Noetherian and let `j : U ⟶ X` be a flat morphism, locally of finite
type and of relative dimension `e`, with `j ≫ f = f_U`. Then the flat pullback `j^*α` of a
relative `r`-cycle `α` on `X/S` is a relative `(r + e)`-cycle on `U/S`.

The valuative condition for `j^*α` at a morphism `g : Spec R ⟶ S` from the spectrum of a discrete
valuation ring is the valuative condition for `α` at `g`, pulled back along the base change of
`j`: base change of the base scheme commutes with flat pullback by Lemma 0H4P part (3),
`Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamily_flatPullbackFamily`, and specialization commutes with flat pullback
by Lemma 0H4L, `Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_baseChangedFiberCycleFlatPullback`.

No surjectivity is involved; this is the single-morphism statement whose family form is the
forward direction of `Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_iff_forall_flatPullbackFamily` below.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_flatPullbackFamily {X S U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (fU : U ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j] (hj : j ≫ f = fU) (e : ℕ)
    (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e) (r : ℕ) {α : FamilyOfCycles f r}
    (hα : IsRelativeCycle f r α) :
    IsRelativeCycle fU (r + e) (flatPullbackFamily f fU j hj e he r α)
declarations.comment: flat pullback along a flat morphism of relative dimension e

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_restrictedFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H51, restriction to open subschemes of the source and of the base.**
For open immersions `j : U ⟶ X` and `i : V ⟶ S` with `j ≫ f = fU ≫ i`, the restriction to
`U/V` of a relative `r`-cycle on `X/S` is a relative `r`-cycle.

The restriction is the base change along `i`, restricted along the open immersion
`U ⟶ X ×_S V` over `V`: the base change along an open immersion changes no coefficient, the
residue fields being equal, and the fibre maps factor through the fibres of `X ×_S V`
(`Stacks.Chow.fiberRestrict_pullbackLift_comp_restrictedFiberMap`). Both operations preserve
relative cycles.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_restrictedFamily {X S U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (fU : U ⟶ V) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (i : V ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i] (h : j ≫ f = fU ≫ i)
    (r : ℕ) {α : FamilyOfCycles f r} (hα : IsRelativeCycle f r α) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian V := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion i
    IsRelativeCycle fU r (restrictedFamily f fU j i h r α).1
declarations.comment: restriction to open subschemes of the source and of the base

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_properPushforwardFamily
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be locally Noetherian, let `sX : X ⟶ S` and `sY : Y ⟶ S` be locally of finite type, let
`q : X ⟶ Y` be proper with `q ≫ sY = sX` and let `r ≥ 0`. The proper pushforward `q_*α` of a
relative `r`-cycle `α` on `X/S` is a relative `r`-cycle on `Y/S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_properPushforwardFamily {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (sY : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (q : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper q] (hq : q ≫ sY = sX) (r : ℕ) {α : FamilyOfCycles sX r}
    (hα : IsRelativeCycle sX r α) :
    IsRelativeCycle sY r (properPushforwardFamily sX sY q hq r α)
declarations.comment: proper pushforward

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_fiberCycleRestrict
declarations.doc:
The restriction of a relative `r`-cycle on `X/S` to an open subscheme `U ⊆ X`, taken over the
same base, is a relative `r`-cycle on `U/S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_fiberCycleRestrict {X S U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (fU : U ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (h : j ≫ f = fU) (r : ℕ) {α : FamilyOfCycles f r}
    (hα : IsRelativeCycle f r α) :
    IsRelativeCycle fU r (fun s => fiberCycleRestrict f fU j h s r (α s))
declarations.comment: restriction along an open immersion of the source

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_iff_forall_isRelativeCycle_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H52.** Let `S` be locally Noetherian, let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of
finite type, let `r ≥ 0` and let `α` be a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S`. Let
`{g i : S' i ⟶ S}` be an h covering. Then `α` is a relative `r`-cycle if and only if each base
change `(g i)^*α` is a relative `r`-cycle.

This is `Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_iff_forall_baseChangeFamily` with its two inputs supplied:
the two-step base change compatibility by
`Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_baseChangeFamily_baseChangeFamily_iff` and the descent along an
extension of discrete valuation rings by
`Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_baseChangeFamily_of_isExtension`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_iff_forall_isRelativeCycle_baseChangeFamily {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    {I : Type v} (S' : I → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, S' i ⟶ S) (hg : IsHCovering S' g) :
    IsRelativeCycle f r α ↔
      ∀ i, @IsRelativeCycle _ _ (pullback.snd f (g i)) _ (hg.isLocallyNoetherian i) r
        (baseChangeFamily f (g i) r α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_iff_forall_flatPullbackFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H53.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes with `S` locally
Noetherian and `f` locally of finite type, let `r, e ≥ 0` and let `α` be a family of `r`-cycles
on the fibres of `X/S`. Let `{f_i : X_i ⟶ X}` be a jointly surjective family of flat morphisms,
locally of finite type and of relative dimension `e`. Then `α` is a relative `r`-cycle if and
only if every flat pullback `f_i^*α` is a relative `(r+e)`-cycle.

The proof is the one in the source. Both directions are read off after base change to the
spectrum of a discrete valuation ring: there the valuative identity for `f_i^*α` is the identity
`sp(f_{i,η}^*α_η) = f_{i,0}^*α_0`, and base change of a flat pullback
(`Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamily_flatPullbackFamily_apply`, Lemma 0H4P part (3)) with the
commutation of specialization and flat pullback
(`Stacks.Chow.specializationCycle_baseChangedFiberCycleFlatPullback`, Lemma 0H4L) turns it into
`f_{i,0}^*(sp(α_η)) = f_{i,0}^*α_0`. That is implied by the valuative identity for `α`, which
gives the forward direction, and implies it because the `f_{i,0}^*` are jointly injective by
`Stacks.Chow.eq_of_forall_baseChangedFiberCycleFlatPullback`, which gives the converse.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_iff_forall_flatPullbackFamily {Idx : Type v} {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    {Y : Idx → Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (p : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ X) [∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType (p i)] [∀ i, Flat (p i)]
    (fY : ∀ i, Y i ⟶ S) [∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType (fY i)] (hY : ∀ i, p i ≫ f = fY i) (e : ℕ)
    (he : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension (p i) e)
    (hsurj : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, ∃ y : Y i, (p i).base y = x) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    IsRelativeCycle f r α ↔
      ∀ i, IsRelativeCycle (fY i) (r + e)
        (flatPullbackFamily f (fY i) (p i) (hY i) e (he i) r α)
declarations.comment: both directions, for a jointly surjective family of flat morphisms of relative dimension e

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_iff_isRelativeCycle_properPushforwardFamily
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme, let `i : X ⟶ Y` be a closed immersion of schemes
locally of finite type over `S`, let `r ≥ 0` and let `α` be a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of
`X/S`. Then `α` is a relative `r`-cycle on `X/S` if and only if `i_*α` is a relative `r`-cycle on
`Y/S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_iff_isRelativeCycle_properPushforwardFamily [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (α : FamilyOfCycles sX r) :
    IsRelativeCycle sX r α ↔
      IsRelativeCycle sY r (properPushforwardFamily sX sY i hi r α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.IsRelativeCycle.eq_iff_eq_of_mem_genericPoints
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H55.** Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme, let `f : X ⟶ S` be
locally of finite type and let `r ≥ 0`. Two relative `r`-cycles on `X/S` are equal if and only
if their members over the generic points of the irreducible components of `S` agree.
declarations.statement:
theorem IsRelativeCycle.eq_iff_eq_of_mem_genericPoints {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) {α β : FamilyOfCycles f r}
    (hα : IsRelativeCycle f r α) (hβ : IsRelativeCycle f r β) :
    α = β ↔ ∀ η ∈ genericPoints ↥S, α η = β η

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_familyAssociatedToModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H56.** Let `S` be locally Noetherian, let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of
finite type and let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite type whose fibrewise support
has dimension at most `r`. If `F` is flat over `S` in dimensions `≥ r`, then `[F/X/S]_r` is a
relative `r`-cycle on `X/S`.

Flatness over `S` in dimensions `≥ r` is spelled out as Stacks Definition 0CWG defines it: for
every point `s` of `S` the locus in the fibre `X_s` where `F` fails to be flat over `S` has
dimension less than `r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_familyAssociatedToModule {r : ℕ} {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (F : X.Modules) [F.IsFiniteType]
    [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      ↥{y : f.fiber s | ¬ IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom F (f.fiberι s y)} < (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hdim : FiberSupportDimensionLE f F r) :
    IsRelativeCycle f r (familyAssociatedToModule f F r hdim)
declarations.comment: the source's hypothesis that the module is flat over the base in dimensions at least r, Stacks Definition 0CWG, written out as the dimension bound on the non-flat locus

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H57.** Let `S` be locally Noetherian, let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of
finite type and let `i : Z ⟶ X` be a closed immersion. If the structure sheaf of `Z`, viewed on
`X`, is flat over `S` in dimensions `≥ r` and its fibrewise support has dimension at most `r`,
then `[Z/X/S]_r` is a relative `r`-cycle on `X/S`.

This is the proof of the source: the cycle of a closed subscheme is the cycle of its structure
sheaf by Tag 02QY, so Tag 0H56 applies to the direct image of that structure sheaf.

Flatness over `S` in dimensions `≥ r` is spelled out as Stacks Definition 0CWG defines it: for
every point `s` of `S` the locus in the fibre `X_s` where `i_* 𝒪_Z` fails to be flat over `S`
has dimension less than `r`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme {r : ℕ} {X S Z : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [(structureSheafPushforward i).IsFiniteType]
    [(structureSheafPushforward i).IsQuasicoherent]
    (hZ : ∀ s : S, topologicalKrullDim
      ↥{y : f.fiber s | ¬ IsFlatOverAt f.toLRSHom.toShHom (structureSheafPushforward i)
        (f.fiberι s y)} < (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hdim : FiberSupportDimensionLE f (structureSheafPushforward i) r) :
    IsRelativeCycle f r (familyAssociatedToModule f (structureSheafPushforward i) r hdim)
declarations.comment: the source's hypothesis that the structure sheaf is flat over the base in dimensions at least r, Stacks Definition 0CWG, written out as the dimension bound on the non-flat locus

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCycleClassMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Equation 0H58.** Let `S` be locally Noetherian, let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally
of finite type and let `r ≥ 0`. The cycle-class homomorphism from the free abelian group on
`Hilb(X/S, r)` to the group `z(X/S, r)` of relative `r`-cycles on `X/S`, sending `∑ nᵢ [Zᵢ]` to
`∑ nᵢ [Zᵢ/X/S]_r`. It refines the homomorphism of Tag 0H6V, whose values are families of
`r`-cycles on fibres, by cutting its codomain down to the relative cycles: each `[Zᵢ/X/S]_r` is
a relative `r`-cycle by Lemma 0H57.

The source takes `f` of finite type; quasi-compactness of `f` is not needed, so it is not
assumed. Under the source's hypotheses the members of `Hilb(X/S, r)` are exactly the closed
subschemes flat and of relative dimension at most `r` over `S`, by
`Stacks.Chow.HilbertCycleDatum.ofFlat`.
declarations.comment: the homomorphism into z(X/S, r)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCycleClassMap_of
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Equation 0H58.** On a generator the cycle-class homomorphism into
`z(X/S, r)` is the family of cycles `[Z/X/S]_r` of the closed subscheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeCycleClassMap_of {r : ℕ} {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (Z : HilbertCycleDatum f r) :
    (relativeCycleClassMap f (FreeAbelianGroup.of Z)).1 = Z.cycleFamily f
declarations.comment: on generators

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCycleClassMap_val
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Equation 0H58.** The cycle-class homomorphism into `z(X/S, r)` is the
homomorphism of Tag 0H6V followed by the inclusion of the relative cycles into the families of
`r`-cycles on fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeCycleClassMap_val {r : ℕ} {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S]
    (α : FreeAbelianGroup (HilbertCycleDatum f r)) :
    (relativeCycleClassMap f α).1 = cycleClassMap f r α
declarations.comment: compatibility with the homomorphism of Tag 0H6V

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_isProper_isCompletelyDecomposed_relativeCycleClassMap_eq
declarations.doc:
Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a finite type morphism of schemes with `S` Noetherian, let `r ≥ 0` and
let `α` be a relative `r`-cycle on `X/S`. Then there is a proper, completely decomposed
(Definition 0GTI) morphism `g : S' ⟶ S` from a Noetherian scheme `S'` such that `g^*α` is in the
image of the cycle class map `FreeAbelianGroup (Hilb(X ×_S S' / S', r)) ⟶ z(X ×_S S' / S', r)` of
Equation 0H58.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isProper_isCompletelyDecomposed_relativeCycleClassMap_eq {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [IsNoetherian S] (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (r : ℕ)
    (α : relativeCycles f r) :
    ∃ (S' : Scheme.{u}) (g : S' ⟶ S) (_ : IsNoetherian S'), IsProper g ∧
      IsCompletelyDecomposed g ∧
      ∃ c : FreeAbelianGroup (HilbertCycleDatum (pullback.snd f g) r),
        (relativeCycleClassMap (pullback.snd f g) c : FamilyOfCycles (pullback.snd f g) r) =
          baseChangeFamily f g r α

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.surjective_relativeCycleClassMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5A.** Let `f : X ⟶ Spec R` be a morphism of finite type with `R` a
discrete valuation ring and let `r ≥ 0`. Then the cycle-class homomorphism of Equation 0H58 is
surjective: every relative `r`-cycle on `X/Spec R` is a combination of the classes `[Z/X/S]_r` of
members of `Hilb(X/Spec R, r)`.

A relative `r`-cycle is determined by its member over the generic point of `Spec R` by Tag 0H55,
and that member is the generic member of a cycle class by
`Stacks.Chow.exists_cycleClassMap_apply_genericPoint_eq`.
declarations.statement:
theorem surjective_relativeCycleClassMap {r : ℕ} {R : Type u} [CommRing R] [IsDomain R]
    [IsDiscreteValuationRing R] {X : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Spec (.of R)) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [QuasiCompact f] :
    Function.Surjective (relativeCycleClassMap (r := r) f)
declarations.comment: finite type is the source's hypothesis, stated as locally of finite type plus quasi-compact

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isClopen_supportOfFamily_of_specializes
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5B**, reduction step. The support of a family of `r`-cycles on the
fibres of a morphism locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian base is open and closed in
the total space as soon as membership in it is unchanged along every specialization of points of
the total space.

This is the step of the source which replaces local constancy of the coefficient function
`x ↦ n_x` by its invariance along specializations: the total space is locally Noetherian, being
locally of finite type over a locally Noetherian base, and on a locally Noetherian scheme a
subset invariant along specializations is open and closed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClopen_supportOfFamily_of_specializes {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {r : ℕ} (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    (hα : ∀ x y : X, x ⤳ y → (x ∈ supportOfFamily f α ↔ y ∈ supportOfFamily f α)) :
    IsClopen (supportOfFamily f α)
declarations.comment: the support is clopen once membership is invariant along specializations

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isClopen_irreducibleComponent_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5B**, geometric step. On a scheme smooth over a field every
irreducible component is open and closed, so it is an open subscheme and is itself smooth over
the field. This is what makes the unique component of a smooth fibre through a point reduced
after any extension of the base field.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClopen_irreducibleComponent_of_smooth {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth p] (y : Y) : IsClopen (irreducibleComponent y)
declarations.comment: components of a smooth scheme over a field are open and closed

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isLocallyConstant_of_specializes_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5B**, topological reduction for a function. A function on a
quasi-sober locally Noetherian space whose value is unchanged along every specialization is
locally constant: membership in each of its fibres is unchanged along specializations, hence
each fibre is open.

This is the sentence of the source which replaces local constancy of the coefficient function
`x ↦ n_x` by the implication `x' ⤳ x → n_{x'} = n_x`.
declarations.comment:
the reduction of local constancy of the fibrewise coefficient function to its
invariance along specializations; not that invariance itself

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isClopen_tsupport_of_smooth
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5B** over the spectrum of a field. The support of a cycle of
relative dimension `k` on a scheme smooth over a field is open and closed, provided every
generic point of an irreducible component has relative dimension `k`; that proviso is what
being smooth of relative dimension `k` supplies.

Such a cycle is supported on generic points of irreducible components, and on a scheme smooth
over a field the closure of a set of such points is a union of connected components.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClopen_tsupport_of_smooth {k : Type u} [Field k] {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (p : Y ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [Smooth p] (j : ℤ)
    (hgen : ∀ ξ ∈ genericPoints ↥Y,
      relativeDimension (fieldChowSituation k).dimensionFunction p ξ = j)
    (c : CycleGroup (fieldChowSituation k) p j) :
    IsClopen (tsupport (c.1 : AlgebraicCycle Y ℤ))
declarations.comment:
the support of a cycle of top relative dimension on a scheme smooth over a field
is open and closed; neither the statement over a general base nor local constancy of the
fibrewise coefficient function

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isClopen_supportOfFamily_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5B.** Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme, let `f : X ⟶ S` be
smooth of relative dimension `r` and let `α` be a relative `r`-cycle on `X/S`. Then the support
of `α` is open and closed in `X`.

By the reduction step it suffices to know that membership in the support is unchanged along
every specialization `x ⤳ y` of points of `X`. Such a specialization is realized by the
generic-to-closed specialization on the spectrum of a discrete valuation ring `R` mapping to
`X`, and the base change `X ×_S Spec R ⟶ Spec R` — again smooth of relative dimension `r` —
carries a section through which the two points are seen. The valuative condition applies there,
and compatibility of supports with base change transports the conclusion back to `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClopen_supportOfFamily_of_smoothOfRelativeDimension {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
