    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) [SmoothOfRelativeDimension r f]
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (hα : IsRelativeCycle f r α) :
    IsClopen (supportOfFamily f α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isClosed_setOf_fiberCycle_eq
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5C.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes with `S` locally
Noetherian and `f` locally of finite type, let `r ≥ 0` and let `α, β ∈ z(X/S, r)`. Then the set
`E = {s ∈ S : α_s = β_s}` is closed in `S`.

With `γ = α - β`, the set `E` is the vanishing locus of the relative cycle `γ`. It is stable
under specialization, and every point `η ∉ E` has an open neighbourhood containing no point of
`E` specializing from `η` (`Stacks.Chow.exists_isOpen_forall_specializes_ne_zero`); on a locally
Noetherian space these two properties make `E` closed.

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.nonempty_isColimit_relativeCyclesCocone
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5D.** Let `S = lim_{i ∈ I} S_i` be the limit of a cofiltered system
of Noetherian schemes with affine transition morphisms, let `i₀ ∈ I` and let `X₀ ⟶ S_{i₀}` be of
finite type; for a stage `a ≥ i₀` put `X_a = X₀ ×_{S_{i₀}} S_a`, and put `X = X₀ ×_{S_{i₀}} S`. If
`S` is Noetherian, then `z(X/S, r) = colim_{a ≥ i₀} z(X_a/S_a, r)`, the transition maps being
base change of relative `r`-cycles: the cocone `Stacks.Chow.relativeCyclesCocone` of base changes
along the projections `S ⟶ S_a` is a colimit in the category of abelian groups.
declarations.statement:
theorem nonempty_isColimit_relativeCyclesCocone {I : Type u} [Category.{u} I] [IsCofiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : I} (v : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map v)]
    [∀ i, IsNoetherian (D.obj i)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) [IsNoetherian c.pt] {i₀ : I}
    {X₀ : Scheme.{u}} (f₀ : X₀ ⟶ D.obj i₀) [LocallyOfFiniteType f₀] [QuasiCompact f₀] (r : ℕ) :
    Nonempty (IsColimit (relativeCyclesCocone D c f₀ r))

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCyclesAddEquivOfIsThickening
declarations.doc:
Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme and let `i : X ⟶ Y` be a thickening of schemes locally
of finite type over `S`. For `r ≥ 0` proper pushforward along `i` is an additive equivalence
`z(X/S, r) ≃ z(Y/S, r)` of groups of relative `r`-cycles.
declarations.statement:
def relativeCyclesAddEquivOfIsThickening (hthick : Stacks.Thickenings.IsThickening i) (r : ℕ) :
    ↥(relativeCycles sX r) ≃+ ↥(relativeCycles sY r)
declarations.comment: the bijection i_* : z(X/S, r) → z(X'/S, r) of relative r-cycles

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCyclesAddEquivOfIsThickening_coe
declarations.doc:
The additive equivalence of relative `r`-cycles attached to a thickening is proper pushforward:
the family of fibrewise cycles underlying the image of `α` is the fibrewise proper pushforward of
the family underlying `α`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeCyclesAddEquivOfIsThickening_coe
    (hthick : Stacks.Thickenings.IsThickening i) (r : ℕ) (α : ↥(relativeCycles sX r)) :
    (relativeCyclesAddEquivOfIsThickening sX sY i hi hthick r α).1 =
      properPushforwardFamily sX sY i hi r α.1
declarations.comment: the equivalence is the fibrewise proper pushforward of families of cycles

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCyclesRestrictEquiv
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5F.** Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme, let `X` be a scheme
locally of finite type over `S`, let `r ≥ 0` and let `j : U ⟶ X` be an open immersion over `S`
such that the complement of `U` has relative dimension `< r` over `S`, that is
`dim(X_s \ U_s) < r` for all `s ∈ S`. Then restriction is a bijection
`z(X/S, r) ⟶ z(U/S, r)`.

The inverse is extension by zero, not a chosen section: fibrewise, the cycle on `X_s` keeps the
coefficients of the cycle on `U_s` and vanishes off `U_s`.
declarations.statement:
def relativeCyclesRestrictEquiv {X S U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (fU : U ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU] (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (h : j ≫ f = fU) (r : ℕ)
    (hdim : ComplementFibreDimensionLT f fU j h r) :
    relativeCycles f r ≃+ relativeCycles fU r
declarations.comment: restriction is a bijection z(X/S, r) → z(U/S, r)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCyclesAddEquivOfUniversalHomeomorphism
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5G.** Let `g : S' ⟶ S` be a universal homeomorphism of locally
Noetherian schemes which induces isomorphisms on all residue fields, let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally
of finite type, let `X' = S' ×_S X` and let `r ≥ 0`. Base change along `g` is an additive
equivalence `z(X/S, r) ≃ z(X'/S', r)` of groups of relative `r`-cycles.
declarations.statement:
def relativeCyclesAddEquivOfUniversalHomeomorphism
    (hres : ∀ t : S', IsIso (g.residueFieldMap t)) (r : ℕ) :
    ↥(relativeCycles f r) ≃+ ↥(relativeCycles (pullback.snd f g) r)
declarations.comment: the bijection z(X/S, r) → z(X'/S', r) determined by base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCyclesAddEquivOfUniversalHomeomorphism_coe
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H5G.** The additive equivalence of relative `r`-cycles attached to a
universal homeomorphism inducing isomorphisms on all residue fields is base change: the family of
fibrewise cycles underlying the image of `α` is the base change of the family underlying `α`.
declarations.statement:
theorem relativeCyclesAddEquivOfUniversalHomeomorphism_coe
    (hres : ∀ t : S', IsIso (g.residueFieldMap t)) (r : ℕ) (α : ↥(relativeCycles f r)) :
    (relativeCyclesAddEquivOfUniversalHomeomorphism f g hres r α).1 =
      baseChangeFamily f g r α.1
declarations.comment: the bijection is base change of families of cycles on fibres

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.IsEquidimensional
declarations.doc:
A family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `f` is *equidimensional* when its support is
contained in a closed subset of `X` whose relative dimension over `S` is at most `r`.
declarations.statement:
def IsEquidimensional {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) : Prop
declarations.comment: the equidimensionality condition

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.equidimensionalRelativeCycles
declarations.doc:
The group `z_equi(X/S, r)` of equidimensional relative `r`-cycles on `X/S`: the subgroup of
the group of families of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` whose members are the relative
`r`-cycles whose support is contained in a closed subset of `X` of relative dimension at most `r`
over `S`.
declarations.statement:
def equidimensionalRelativeCycles {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) : AddSubgroup (FamilyOfCycles f r)
declarations.comment: the group z_equi(X/S, r) of equidimensional relative r-cycles

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.NotEquidimensional.exampleFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5J.** The family of `0`-cycles on the fibres of
`Spec k[x, y, t] ⟶ Spec k[x, y]` of Suslin--Voevodsky's example.
declarations.statement: def exampleFamily (k : Type u) [Field k] : FamilyOfCycles (projection k) 0
declarations.comment: the family of 0-cycles of the example

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.NotEquidimensional.exampleFamily_of_eq_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5J, first clause.** The example family vanishes on the fibre over
a point where the image of `y` is zero.
declarations.statement:
theorem exampleFamily_of_eq_zero (k : Type u) [Field k] (s : baseScheme k)
    (hb : yImage k s = 0) : exampleFamily k s = 0
declarations.comment: the first clause: the member of the family is zero when b = 0

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.NotEquidimensional.exampleFamily_of_ne_zero
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5J, second clause.** On a fibre where the image `b` of `y` is
nonzero the member of the example family is the difference `[p] - [q]` of the `κ(s)`-rational
points at `t = a/b` and at `t = (a + b²)/b`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exampleFamily_of_ne_zero (k : Type u) [Field k] (s : baseScheme k)
    (hb : yImage k s ≠ 0) :
    (exampleFamily k s : AlgebraicCycle ((projection k).fiber s) ℤ) =
      twoPointCycle (firstPoint k s) (secondPoint k s)
declarations.comment: the second clause: the member of the family is [p] - [q] when b is nonzero

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.NotEquidimensional.mem_closure_supportOfFamily_exampleFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5J.** The closure of the support of the example family contains the
whole fibre over the origin, which is a line: the surface `y·t = x` lies in that closure and
contains the fibre over the origin.
declarations.statement:
theorem mem_closure_supportOfFamily_exampleFamily (k : Type u) [Field k] (z : totalScheme k)
    (hz : projection k z = origin k) :
    z ∈ closure (supportOfFamily (projection k) (exampleFamily k))
declarations.comment: the closure of the support contains the whole fibre over the origin

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.NotEquidimensional.not_isEquidimensional_exampleFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5J.** The example family of `0`-cycles on the fibres of
`Spec k[x, y, t] ⟶ Spec k[x, y]` is not equidimensional: a closed subset of `X` containing its
support contains the whole fibre over the origin, which is a line, so that closed subset
cannot have relative dimension `0` over the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isEquidimensional_exampleFamily (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ¬ IsEquidimensional (projection k) 0 (exampleFamily k)
declarations.comment: the example family is not equidimensional

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.NotEquidimensional.isRelativeCycle_exampleFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5J.** The family `α` of Suslin--Voevodsky's example is a relative
`0`-cycle: it is compatible with specializations. Over a discrete valuation ring `R` with a
morphism `g : Spec R ⟶ S` there are three cases. If `b = 0` in the residue field of the generic
point of `Spec R` then it also vanishes at the closed point, so both members of the base change
are zero. If `b ≠ 0` at the generic point but `b = 0` at the closed point, then the translation
`t ↦ t + y` of the affine line is the identity on the special fibre and carries the first of the
two rational points to the second, so their fundamental cycles have the same specialization and
the difference specializes to zero, which is the vanishing member at the closed point. If
`b ≠ 0` at the closed point then `y` is a unit of `R`, the value `a/b` lies in `R` and the two
points of the generic fibre extend to closed sections of `X ×_S Spec R` over `Spec R`, whose
values at the closed point are the two rational points of the special fibre; the specialization
of the fundamental cycle of a section is the prime cycle of its closed value.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_exampleFamily (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    IsRelativeCycle (projection k) 0 (exampleFamily k)
declarations.comment: the example family is a relative 0-cycle, compatible with specializations

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.NotEquidimensional.exists_isRelativeCycle_not_isEquidimensional
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5J.** There exist relative `0`-cycles which are not
equidimensional: Suslin--Voevodsky's family on `Spec k[x, y, t] ⟶ Spec k[x, y]` is one.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isRelativeCycle_not_isEquidimensional (k : Type u) [Field k] :
    ∃ α : FamilyOfCycles (projection k) 0,
      IsRelativeCycle (projection k) 0 α ∧ ¬ IsEquidimensional (projection k) 0 α
declarations.comment: there exist relative r-cycles which are not equidimensional

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEquidimensional_restrictedFamily
declarations.doc:
Restriction to compatible open subschemes of the source and the base preserves
equidimensionality of a family of cycles on the fibres.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquidimensional_restrictedFamily {X S U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (fU : U ⟶ V) (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j]
    (i : V ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i] (h : j ≫ f = fU ≫ i) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    (hα : IsEquidimensional f r α) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian V := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion i
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType fU := by
      let : LocallyOfFiniteType (fU ≫ i) := h ▸ inferInstance
      exact locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp fU i
    IsEquidimensional fU r (restrictedFamily f fU j i h r α).1
declarations.comment: restriction

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEquidimensional_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5K, the base-change clause.** The base change of an equidimensional
family of `r`-cycles along an arbitrary morphism `g : S' ⟶ S` of the base is equidimensional:
its support is the inverse image of the support of the original family, and the base change of
a bounding closed subscheme bounds it and has the same relative dimension over `S'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquidimensional_baseChangeFamily {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (g : S' ⟶ S) [IsLocallyNoetherian S']
    (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (hα : IsEquidimensional f r α) :
    IsEquidimensional (pullback.snd f g) r (baseChangeFamily f g r α)
declarations.comment: base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEquidimensional_flatPullbackFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5K, the flat-pullback clause.** The flat pullback of an
equidimensional family of `r`-cycles along a morphism `j : U ⟶ X` of schemes over `S` which is
flat, locally of finite type and of relative dimension `e` is an equidimensional family of
`(r + e)`-cycles: the inverse image of a closed subscheme bounding the support of the original
family bounds the support of the pullback, and its relative dimension over `S` is at most
`r + e` because it maps to the bounding subscheme by a morphism of relative dimension `e`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquidimensional_flatPullbackFamily {X S U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (fU : U ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j] (h : j ≫ f = fU) (e : ℕ)
    (he : RelativeDimension j e) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    (hα : IsEquidimensional f r α) :
    IsEquidimensional fU (r + e) (flatPullbackFamily f fU j h e he r α)
declarations.comment: flat pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEquidimensional_iff_forall_restrictedFamily
declarations.doc:
Equidimensionality of a family of cycles may be checked Zariski locally on `X` and on `S`:
given open subschemes `U t ⊆ X` lying over open subschemes `V t ⊆ S` whose members cover `X`,
the family is equidimensional exactly when each of its restrictions is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquidimensional_iff_forall_restrictedFamily {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    {ι : Type*} (U V : ι → Scheme.{u})
    (fU : ∀ t, U t ⟶ V t) (j : ∀ t, U t ⟶ X) (hj : ∀ t, IsOpenImmersion (j t))
    (i : ∀ t, V t ⟶ S) (hi : ∀ t, IsOpenImmersion (i t))
    (h : ∀ t, j t ≫ f = fU t ≫ i t)
    (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ (t : ι) (y : U t), j t y = x) :
    IsEquidimensional f r α ↔
      ∀ t : ι,
        letI : IsOpenImmersion (j t) := hj t
        letI : IsOpenImmersion (i t) := hi t
        letI : IsLocallyNoetherian (V t) := isLocallyNoetherian_of_isOpenImmersion (i t)
        letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (fU t) := by
          let : LocallyOfFiniteType (fU t ≫ i t) := h t ▸ inferInstance
          exact locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp (fU t) (i t)
        IsEquidimensional (fU t) r (restrictedFamily f (fU t) (j t) (i t) (h t) r α).1

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEquidimensional_iff_forall_of_fppfCovering
declarations.doc:
The support form of Tag 0H5M: for an fppf covering `{g i : T i ⟶ S}` of the base, a family
of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `f : X ⟶ S` is equidimensional exactly when each family on the
fibres of `X ×_S T i ⟶ T i` whose support is the preimage of its support is equidimensional.
The base changes of the family have that property, by the base-change clause of Tag 0H4V.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquidimensional_iff_forall_of_fppfCovering {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    {I : Type v} {T : I → Scheme.{u}} (g : ∀ i, T i ⟶ S)
    (hg : Presieve.ofArrows T g ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage S)
    (β : ∀ i, FamilyOfCycles (pullback.snd f (g i)) r)
    (hβ : ∀ i, supportOfFamily (pullback.snd f (g i)) (β i) =
      pullback.fst f (g i) ⁻¹' supportOfFamily f α) :
    letI (i : I) : IsLocallyNoetherian (T i) :=
      isLocallyNoetherian_of_mem_fppfPrecoverage g hg i
    (IsEquidimensional f r α ↔
      ∀ i, IsEquidimensional (pullback.snd f (g i)) r (β i))
declarations.comment: generalized: the families over the covering are an argument and enter only through their supports, so no relative-cycle condition is needed; `isEquidimensional_iff_forall_baseChangeFamily` instantiates them at the base changes themselves

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEquidimensional_iff_forall_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5M.** Equidimensionality of a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of
`f : X ⟶ S` is local for an fppf covering `{g i : T i ⟶ S}` of the base: the family is
equidimensional exactly when every base change `g i ^* α` is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquidimensional_iff_forall_baseChangeFamily {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    {I : Type v} {T : I → Scheme.{u}} (g : ∀ i, T i ⟶ S)
    (hg : Presieve.ofArrows T g ∈ Scheme.fppfPrecoverage S) :
    letI (i : I) : IsLocallyNoetherian (T i) :=
      isLocallyNoetherian_of_mem_fppfPrecoverage g hg i
    (IsEquidimensional f r α ↔
      ∀ i, IsEquidimensional (pullback.snd f (g i)) r (baseChangeFamily f (g i) r α))

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEquidimensional_iff_forall_flatPullbackFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5N.** Equidimensionality of a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of
`f : X ⟶ S` can be checked after a jointly surjective family `{fi i : Xi i ⟶ X}` of flat
morphisms locally of finite type of relative dimension `e`: the family is equidimensional
exactly when every flat pullback `fi i ^* α`, a family of `(r + e)`-cycles on the fibres of
`Xi i ⟶ S`, is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquidimensional_iff_forall_flatPullbackFamily {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r e : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    {I : Type v} {Xi : I → Scheme.{u}} (fi : ∀ i, Xi i ⟶ X)
    [∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType (fi i)] [∀ i, Flat (fi i)]
    (hdim : ∀ i, RelativeDimension (fi i) e)
    (hsurj : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, x ∈ Set.range (fi i)) :
    IsEquidimensional f r α ↔
      ∀ i, IsEquidimensional (fi i ≫ f) (r + e)
        (flatPullbackFamily f (fi i ≫ f) (fi i) rfl e (hdim i) r α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCycleWeight
declarations.doc:
The function `w_α : X → ℤ` attached to a family `α` of `0`-cycles on the fibres of
`f : X ⟶ S`: the coefficient of `α` at a point `x`, taken on the scheme-theoretic fibre through
`x`, times the inseparable degree `[κ(x) : κ(f x)]_i`.
declarations.statement:
def relativeCycleWeight {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f 0) : X → ℤ
declarations.comment: the construction of w_α preceding the lemma; none of the lemma's three claims

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isWeighting_relativeCycleWeight
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5P**, clause (1). Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme and let
`f : X ⟶ S` be a locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes. For `α ∈ z(X/S, 0)` the map
`w_α : X → ℤ` is a weighting of `f`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isWeighting_relativeCycleWeight (α : relativeCycles f 0) :
    IsWeighting f (relativeCycleWeight f α.1)
declarations.comment: clause (1): the map attached to a relative zero-cycle is a weighting

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_relativeCycle_nsmul_eq_relativeCycleWeight
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5P**, clause (2). Let `S` be a locally Noetherian scheme, let
`f : X ⟶ S` be a locally quasi-finite morphism of schemes and let `X` be quasi-compact. Given a
weighting `w : X → ℤ` of `f` there is an integer `n > 0` with `n·w = w_α` for some
`α ∈ z(X/S, 0)`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_relativeCycle_nsmul_eq_relativeCycleWeight [CompactSpace X] (w : X → ℤ)
    (hw : IsWeighting f w) :
    ∃ (n : ℕ) (α : relativeCycles f 0), 0 < n ∧
      ∀ x : X, (n : ℤ) * w x = relativeCycleWeight f α.1 x
declarations.comment: clause (2): every weighting is a positive integer multiple of one attached to a relative zero-cycle, for a quasi-compact source

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_relativeCycle_primePow_nsmul_eq_relativeCycleWeight
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5P**, clause (3). In the situation of clause (2), if `S` is a scheme
over `𝔽_p` for a prime `p`, then the integer `n` may be chosen to be a power of `p`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_relativeCycle_primePow_nsmul_eq_relativeCycleWeight [CompactSpace X] (p : ℕ)
    [Fact p.Prime] (σ : S ⟶ Spec (CommRingCat.of (ULift.{u} (ZMod p)))) (w : X → ℤ)
    (hw : IsWeighting f w) :
    ∃ (e : ℕ) (α : relativeCycles f 0), 0 < p ^ e ∧
      ∀ x : X, ((p ^ e : ℕ) : ℤ) * w x = relativeCycleWeight f α.1 x
declarations.comment: clause (3): over a scheme of characteristic p the multiple may be taken to be a power of p

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.IsEffectiveRelativeCycle
declarations.doc:
A relative `r`-cycle `α` on `X/S` is *effective* when for every point `s` of `S` the
`r`-cycle `α_s` it carries on the scheme-theoretic fibre over `s` is an effective cycle.
declarations.statement:
def IsEffectiveRelativeCycle {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : ↥(relativeCycles f r)) : Prop
declarations.comment: effectivity of a relative r-cycle

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.effectiveRelativeCycles
declarations.doc:
The monoid `z^eff(X/S, r)` of *effective relative `r`-cycles* on `X/S`: the submonoid of the
group `z(X/S, r)` of relative `r`-cycles consisting of those whose cycle on every fibre is
effective.
declarations.statement:
def effectiveRelativeCycles {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) : AddSubmonoid ↥(relativeCycles f r)
declarations.comment: the monoid z^eff(X/S, r)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveFamily_restrictedFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5S.** The restriction of an effective family of `r`-cycles on the
fibres of `X/S` to open subschemes `U ⊆ X` and `V ⊆ S` with `f(U) ⊆ V` is effective.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveFamily_restrictedFamily {X S U V : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (fU : U ⟶ V) (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (i : V ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion i] (h : j ≫ f = fU ≫ i) (r : ℕ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (hα : IsEffectiveFamily f r α) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType fU := by
      let : LocallyOfFiniteType (fU ≫ i) := h ▸ inferInstance
      exact locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp fU i
    IsEffectiveFamily fU r (restrictedFamily f fU j i h r α).1
declarations.comment: restriction

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveFamily_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5S, base change.** The base change of an effective family of
`r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` along any morphism `g : S' ⟶ S` of bases is effective; no
surjectivity of `g` is needed.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveFamily_baseChangeFamily {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (g : S' ⟶ S) (r : ℕ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (hα : IsEffectiveFamily f r α) :
    IsEffectiveFamily (pullback.snd f g) r (baseChangeFamily f g r α)
declarations.comment: base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveFamily_flatPullbackFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5S, flat pullback.** The flat pullback of an effective family of
`r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` along a flat morphism `j : U ⟶ X` of schemes over `S`, locally
of finite type and of relative dimension `e`, is an effective family of `(r+e)`-cycles on the
fibres of `U/S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveFamily_flatPullbackFamily {X S U : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (fU : U ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType fU]
    (j : U ⟶ X) [LocallyOfFiniteType j] [Flat j] (h : j ≫ f = fU) (e : ℕ)
    (he : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension j e) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    (hα : IsEffectiveFamily f r α) :
    IsEffectiveFamily fU (r + e) (flatPullbackFamily f fU j h e he r α)
declarations.comment: flat pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveFamily_properPushforwardFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5S, proper pushforward.** The proper pushforward of an effective
family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` along a proper morphism `p : X ⟶ Y` of schemes over
`S` is an effective family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `Y/S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveFamily_properPushforwardFamily {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (sX : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (sY : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY]
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [IsProper p] (hp : p ≫ sY = sX) (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles sX r)
    (hα : IsEffectiveFamily sX r α) :
    IsEffectiveFamily sY r (properPushforwardFamily sX sY p hp r α)
declarations.comment: proper pushforward

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveFamily_iff_forall_restrictedFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5T.** Effectivity of a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S`
may be checked Zariski locally on `X` and on `S`: given open subschemes `U a ⊆ X` and
`V a ⊆ S` with `f(U a) ⊆ V a` and with the `U a` covering `X`, the family is effective exactly
when each of its restrictions is.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveFamily_iff_forall_restrictedFamily {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] {ι : Type v} {U V : ι → Scheme.{u}}
    (fU : ∀ a : ι, U a ⟶ V a) (j : ∀ a : ι, U a ⟶ X) [∀ a : ι, IsOpenImmersion (j a)]
    (i : ∀ a : ι, V a ⟶ S) [∀ a : ι, IsOpenImmersion (i a)]
    (h : ∀ a : ι, j a ≫ f = fU a ≫ i a) (hcover : ∀ x : X, ∃ a : ι, x ∈ Set.range (j a))
    (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    letI : ∀ a : ι, LocallyOfFiniteType (fU a) := fun a => by
      let : LocallyOfFiniteType (fU a ≫ i a) := h a ▸ inferInstance
      exact locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp (fU a) (i a)
    IsEffectiveFamily f r α ↔
      ∀ a : ι, IsEffectiveFamily (fU a) r
        (restrictedFamily f (fU a) (j a) (i a) (h a) r α).1

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveFamily_iff_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5U.** Let `α` be a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` and
let `g : S' ⟶ S` be surjective. Then `α` is effective if and only if its base change `g^*α` is
effective.

Effectivity is a condition on each coefficient separately, and a coefficient of `g^*α` is a
coefficient of `α` times a multiplicity. The multiplicity is nonnegative, which gives the
forward implication. For the converse, surjectivity supplies a point `t` of `S'` over a given
point of `S`, and over `t` the fibre of the base change has a point lying over the chosen point
of the fibre of `f` at which that multiplicity is nonzero, hence positive; so a negative
coefficient of `α` would make a coefficient of `g^*α` negative.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveFamily_iff_baseChangeFamily {X S S' : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (g : S' ⟶ S) [Surjective g] (r : ℕ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    IsEffectiveFamily f r α ↔
      IsEffectiveFamily (pullback.snd f g) r (baseChangeFamily f g r α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveFamily_iff_forall_flatPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5V.** Let `α` be a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` and
let `{g i : X' i ⟶ X}` be a jointly surjective family of flat morphisms, locally of finite type
and of relative dimension `e`. If `β i` is the flat pullback of `α` along `g i`, then `α` is
effective if and only if every `β i` is.

The fibres of `g i ≫ f` map to those of `f` by the base changes of the `g i`, again flat,
locally of finite type and of relative dimension `e`, and jointly surjective on every fibre, so
this is the fibrewise `Stacks.Chow.isEffectiveFamily_iff_forall`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEffectiveFamily_iff_forall_flatPullback {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] {r e : ℕ} (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) {Idx : Type*}
    {X' : Idx → Scheme.{u}} (g : ∀ i, X' i ⟶ X) [∀ i, LocallyOfFiniteType (g i)]
    [∀ i, Flat (g i)] (hrel : ∀ i, AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension (g i) e)
    (hsurj : ∀ x : X, ∃ i, ∃ x' : X' i, (g i).base x' = x)
    (β : ∀ i, FamilyOfCycles (g i ≫ f) (r + e))
    (hβ : ∀ (i : Idx) (s : S) (x : (g i ≫ f).fiber s),
      (β i s : AlgebraicCycle ((g i ≫ f).fiber s) ℤ) x =
        (α s : AlgebraicCycle (f.fiber s) ℤ) ((f.fiberMap (g i) s).base x) *
          flatPullbackWeight (fieldChowSituation (S.residueField s))
            ((g i ≫ f).fiberToSpecResidueField s) (f.fiberMap (g i) s)
            ((r : ℤ) + (e : ℤ)) x) :
    IsEffectiveFamily f r α ↔ ∀ i, IsEffectiveFamily (g i ≫ f) (r + e) (β i)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isClosed_supportOfFamily_of_isEffectiveFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5W.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes with `S` locally
Noetherian and `f` locally of finite type, let `r ≥ 0` be an integer and let `α` be a relative
`r`-cycle on `X/S`. If `α` is effective then its support is closed in `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isClosed_supportOfFamily_of_isEffectiveFamily (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (hα : IsRelativeCycle f r α)
    (heff : IsEffectiveFamily f r α) : IsClosed (supportOfFamily f α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isEquidimensional_of_isEffectiveFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H5X.** Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of schemes with `S` locally
Noetherian and `f` locally of finite type, let `r ≥ 0` be an integer and let `α` be a relative
`r`-cycle on `X/S`. If `α` is effective then `α` is equidimensional.
declarations.statement:
theorem isEquidimensional_of_isEffectiveFamily (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (hα : IsRelativeCycle f r α)
    (heff : IsEffectiveFamily f r α) : IsEquidimensional f r α

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor
declarations.doc:
The contravariant functor `S' ↦ z^eff(X'/S', r)`, `X' = S' ×_S X`, on the category of
schemes locally of finite type over `S`, the map attached to a morphism `S'' ⟶ S'` over `S` being
base change of effective relative `r`-cycles.
declarations.statement: def effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor : (LocallyOfFiniteTypeOver S)ᵒᵖ ⥤ Type u
declarations.comment: the functor S' ↦ z^eff(X'/S', r), X' = S' ×_S X, on schemes locally of finite type over S

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.not_isRepresentable_effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor_specFieldExt
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 0H5Y.** Let `k` be a field and let `K/k` be a finite purely
inseparable extension of degree `> 1`, so that `S = Spec k` is Noetherian and
`f : X = Spec K ⟶ S` is finite. The functor `S' ↦ z^eff(X'/S', 0)`, `X' = S' ×_S X`, on schemes
locally of finite type over `S` is not representable.

This is the reason the source gives, made into a counter example: relative cycles do not see
nilpotents. If `M` represented the functor, the diagonal cycle `ξ ∈ z^eff(X_K/Spec K, 0)` would
be a morphism `Spec K ⟶ M` whose two pullbacks to `Spec K ×_k Spec K` agree, because they agree
on the reduction and base change to the reduction is injective; as `Spec K ⟶ Spec k` is an
effective epimorphism, `ξ` would come from `z^eff(X/S, 0)`. But the cycle `ξ` is one rational
point with coefficient one, while every base change of a cycle along `K/k` has coefficients
divisible by `[K : k]` at such a point.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isRepresentable_effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor_specFieldExt
    [IsPurelyInseparable k K] (hK : Module.finrank k K ≠ 1) :
    ¬ (effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor (specFieldExt k K) 0).IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: the functor S' ↦ z^eff(X'/S', r) is not representable, the counter example the remark leaves to the reader, built from z(X'/S', r) = z(X'_red/S'_red, r)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_not_isRepresentable_effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 0H5Y.** The functor `S' ↦ z^eff(X'/S', r)`, `X' = S' ×_S X`, on
schemes locally of finite type over `S` is not representable in general: there are a locally
Noetherian scheme `S`, a morphism `f : X ⟶ S` locally of finite type and an `r ≥ 0` for which it is
not representable. One may take `S = Spec 𝔽₂`, `X = A²` and `r = 0`
(`Stacks.Chow.SymPlane.not_isRepresentable`).
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_not_isRepresentable_effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor :
    ∃ (S X : Scheme.{u}) (f : X ⟶ S) (_ : LocallyOfFiniteType f) (_ : IsLocallyNoetherian S)
      (r : ℕ), ¬ (effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor f r).IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: the functor S' ↦ z^eff(X'/S', r) cannot be representable in general

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.relativeCyclesAddEquivReductionReduction
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 0H5Y.** `z(X/S, r) = z(X_red/S_red, r)`: the group of relative
`r`-cycles does not change when both the source and the base are replaced by their reductions.
Base change along `S_red ⟶ S` identifies `z(X/S, r)` with `z(X ×_S S_red / S_red, r)`
(`Stacks.Chow.relativeCyclesAddEquivReduction`), and `X_red ⟶ X ×_S S_red` is a thickening over
`S_red`, along which proper pushforward identifies the groups of relative cycles (Tag 0H5E).
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def relativeCyclesAddEquivReductionReduction :
    ↥(relativeCycles f r) ≃+ ↥(relativeCycles (Scheme.reductionMap f) r)
declarations.comment: the invariance z(X/S, r) = z(X_red/S_red, r)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.SymPlane.baseChange_quot_ne_alpha
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 0H5Y, the characteristic `2` example: there is no cycle `β`.** Let
`k` be a field of characteristic `2`, `X = A²_k`, `W = X ×_k X` and `Sym²(X) = Spec B` with
`B = k[u₁ + u₂, u₁u₂, v₁ + v₂, v₁v₂, u₁v₁ + u₂v₂]`. No family `β` of `0`-cycles on the fibres of
`X ×_k Sym²(X) ⟶ Sym²(X)`, in particular no relative `0`-cycle, pulls back along the quotient
morphism `W ⟶ Sym²(X)` to the cycle `α` with `α_{(x₁, x₂)} = [x₁] + [x₂]`: at the generic point
`η` of the image `V = Spec k[u₁², v₁²]` of the diagonal the cycle `β_η` would be a `0`-cycle on
`A²_{k(u₁², v₁²)}` whose pullback to `A²_{k(u₁, v₁)}` is twice the rational point `(u₁, v₁)`, which
is impossible.
declarations.statement:
theorem baseChange_quot_ne_alpha
    (β : FamilyOfCycles (pullback.snd (planeHom k) (symObj k).obj.hom) 0) :
    baseChangeFamilyOfIsPullback (pullback.snd (planeHom k) (symObj k).obj.hom)
      (isPullback_overBaseChange (planeHom k) (quot k).hom) 0 β ≠ (alpha k).1.1
declarations.comment: in characteristic 2 the cycle α on A² × A² does not descend to Sym²(A²): there is no cycle β whose pullback to W is α

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.SymPlane.not_isRepresentable_of_le
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 0H5Y, the characteristic `2` example.** Let `k` be a field of
characteristic `2` and `X = A²_k`. On any full subcategory of the schemes of finite type over
`k` containing `W = X ×_k X` and the principal open subschemes of `W` and of
`Sym²(X) = W/⟨σ⟩`, the functor `S' ↦ z^eff(S' ×_k X / S', 0)` is not representable. Such is the
category of weakly normal schemes of finite type over `k`
(`Stacks.Chow.SymPlane.not_isRepresentable_weaklyNormal`), so replacing seminormality by weak
normality does not make the functor representable when the base has points of positive
characteristic.

If `M` represented the functor, the cycle `α` would be a morphism `W ⟶ M` invariant under the
involution `σ` exchanging the factors, because `α` is; near the generic point of the image of the
diagonal it would factor through `W ⟶ Sym²(X)`, and the cycle `β` on `Sym²(X)` corresponding to
the factorization would pull back to `α`. There is no such cycle
(`Stacks.Chow.SymPlane.map_quotAway_ne`).
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isRepresentable_of_le (P : ObjectProperty (LocallyOfFiniteTypeOver (Spec (.of k))))
    (hW : P (squareObj k))
    (hP : ∀ h : sym k, h ≠ 0 → P (squareAwayObj k h) ∧ P (symAwayObj k h)) :
    ¬ (P.ι.op ⋙ effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor (planeHom k) 0).IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: in characteristic 2 the functor is not representable on any category of schemes of finite type over k containing W and the principal opens of W and of Sym²(X)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.SymPlane.map_sym_diagonalRestriction
declarations.doc:
**The image of the diagonal in `Sym²(X)` is `V = Spec k[u², v²]`**, in characteristic `2`:
the coordinate ring of `Sym²(X)` restricts on the diagonal to `k[u², v²]`.
declarations.comment: the image of the diagonal in Sym²(X) is V = Spec k[u₁², v₁²]

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.SymPlane.not_isRepresentable_weaklyNormal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Remark 0H5Y, the characteristic `2` example, on weakly normal schemes.**
Let `k` be a field of characteristic `2` and `X = A²_k`. Call a scheme weakly normal if every
birational universal homeomorphism onto it has a section. On the category of weakly normal
schemes of finite type over `k` the functor `S' ↦ z^eff(S' ×_k X / S', 0)` is not representable:
`W = X ×_k X` is normal, hence weakly normal, `Sym²(X)` is normal, and so are their principal
opens (`Stacks.Chow.SymPlane.not_isRepresentable_of_le`).
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isRepresentable_weaklyNormal :
    ¬ ((weaklyNormalOfFiniteType k).ι.op ⋙
      effectiveRelativeCyclesFunctor (planeHom k) 0).IsRepresentable
declarations.comment: in characteristic 2 the functor is not representable on the category of weakly normal schemes of finite type over k

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.SymPlane.mem_sym_iff
declarations.doc:
**The invariants of the swap.** In characteristic `2`, an element of `k[u₁, u₂, v₁, v₂]` is
fixed by the involution exchanging the two factors exactly when it lies in
`k[u₁ + u₂, u₁u₂, v₁ + v₂, v₁v₂, u₁v₁ + u₂v₂]`.
declarations.statement: theorem mem_sym_iff (x : ring k) : x ∈ sym k ↔ swap k x = x
declarations.comment: Sym²(X) = W/⟨σ⟩ is the spectrum of k[u₁ + u₂, u₁u₂, v₁ + v₂, v₁v₂, u₁v₁ + u₂v₂]

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.IsProperRelativeCycle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Definition 0H61.** A family `α` of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` has
proper support when its support is contained in a closed subset `W ⊆ X` proper over `S`; a
relative `r`-cycle with this property is a *proper relative cycle*.
declarations.statement:
def IsProperRelativeCycle {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (r : ℕ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) : Prop
declarations.comment: the predicate

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.properRelativeCycles
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Definition 0H61.** The group `c(X/S, r)` of proper relative `r`-cycles on
`X/S`: the subgroup of the group of families of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S` whose members
are the relative `r`-cycles with support contained in a closed subset proper over `S`.
declarations.statement:
def properRelativeCycles {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) : AddSubgroup (FamilyOfCycles f r)
declarations.comment: the group c(X/S, r) of proper relative cycles

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isProperRelativeCycle_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H62.** Let `S` be locally Noetherian, let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of
finite type and let `α` be a relative `r`-cycle on `X/S`. If `α` is proper, then every base
change of `α` along a morphism `S' ⟶ S` is proper.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProperRelativeCycle_baseChangeFamily {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) {α : FamilyOfCycles f r}
    (hα : α ∈ properRelativeCycles f r) :
    ∀ (S' : Scheme.{u}) (g : S' ⟶ S),
      IsProperRelativeCycle (pullback.snd f g) r (baseChangeFamily f g r α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isProperRelativeCycle_iff_forall_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H63.** Let `S` be locally Noetherian, let `f : X ⟶ S` be locally of
finite type and let `α` be a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S`. Let `{g i : S i ⟶ S}`
be an h covering. Then `α` is a proper relative cycle if and only if each base change
`(g i)^*α` is a proper relative cycle.

Properness of a relative cycle is a condition on its support alone, so neither the valuative
condition defining a relative `r`-cycle nor any hypothesis on the members of the covering beyond
the h-covering condition enters.
declarations.statement:
theorem isProperRelativeCycle_iff_forall_baseChangeFamily {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    {I : Type v} (S' : I → Scheme.{u}) (g : ∀ i, S' i ⟶ S) (hg : IsHCovering S' g) :
    IsProperRelativeCycle f r α ↔
      ∀ i, IsProperRelativeCycle (pullback.snd f (g i)) r (baseChangeFamily f (g i) r α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cap_add_left
declarations.doc: The action is additive in the family of fibre cycles.
declarations.statement:
theorem cap_add_left (C : ChowSituation.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType s]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] {r : ℕ}
    (α₁ α₂ : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    {e : ℤ} (β : CycleGroup C s e) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (f ≫ s) := inferInstance
    cap C s f (α₁ + α₂) β = cap C s f α₁ β + cap C s f α₂ β
declarations.comment: additivity in the family of fibre cycles

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cap_add_right
declarations.doc: The action is additive in the cycle on the base.
declarations.statement:
theorem cap_add_right (C : ChowSituation.{u})
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (s : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType s]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] {r : ℕ}
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    {e : ℤ} (β₁ β₂ : CycleGroup C s e) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (f ≫ s) := inferInstance
    cap C s f α (β₁ + β₂) = cap C s f α β₁ + cap C s f α β₂
declarations.comment: additivity in the cycle on the base

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cycleGroupRestrict_cap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H67.** If `U ⊆ X` and `V ⊆ Y` are open and `f(U) ⊆ V`, then the
restriction to `U` of the cycle `α ∩ β` is `α|_U ∩ β|_V`, the cycle obtained by letting the
restriction of the family `α` to the fibres of `U/V` act on the restriction of `β` to `V`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleGroupRestrict_cap (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X Y U V : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (sV : V ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sV]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (fU : U ⟶ V)
    (j : U ⟶ X) [IsOpenImmersion j] (i : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i]
    (hi : i ≫ sY = sV) (h : j ≫ f = fU ≫ i) (r : ℕ) (e : ℤ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (β : CycleGroup C sY e) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType fU := by
      let : LocallyOfFiniteType (fU ≫ i) := h ▸ inferInstance
      exact locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp fU i
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (f ≫ sY) := inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (fU ≫ sV) := inferInstance
    cycleGroupRestrict C (f ≫ sY) (fU ≫ sV) j
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, h, Category.assoc, hi]) ((r : ℤ) + e)
        (cap C sY f α β) =
      cap C sV fU (restrictedFamily f fU j i h r α).1
        (cycleGroupRestrict C sY sV i hi e β)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cap_flatPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H68.** Forming `α ∩ β` is compatible with flat pullback: if
`g : Y' ⟶ Y` is flat, locally of finite type and of relative dimension `c`, if `α'` is the base
change of the family `α` along `g` and `β'` the flat pullback of `β`, then the cycle `α' ∩ β'` on
`X ×_Y Y'` is the flat pullback of `α ∩ β` along `X ×_Y Y' ⟶ X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cap_flatPullback (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [Flat g] (c : ℕ)
    (hg : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension g c) (r : ℕ) (e : ℤ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (β : CycleGroup C sY e) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (f ≫ sY) := inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (g ≫ sY) := inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.snd f g ≫ g ≫ sY) := inferInstance
    (cap C (g ≫ sY) (pullback.snd f g) (baseChangeFamily f g r α)
          (flatPullback C (g ≫ sY) sY g rfl c hg e β) :
        AlgebraicCycle (pullback f g : Scheme.{u}) ℤ) =
      (flatPullback C (pullback.snd f g ≫ g ≫ sY) (f ≫ sY) (pullback.fst f g)
          (by rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.condition, Category.assoc]) c
          (AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension.of_isPullback
            ((IsPullback.of_hasPullback f g).flip) hg) ((r : ℤ) + e) (cap C sY f α β) :
        AlgebraicCycle (pullback f g : Scheme.{u}) ℤ)
declarations.comment: compatibility with flat pullback

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cap_baseChange
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H68.** Forming `α ∩ β` is compatible with flat base change: in the
situation of Tag 0FVG, with `α'` the base change of the family `α` along `Y' = Y ×_S S' ⟶ Y` and
`β' = g^*β ∈ Z_{e + c}(Y')` the base change of `β`, the cycle `α' ∩ β'` is the base change of
`α ∩ β`, read along the canonical isomorphism of `X ×_Y Y'` with `X' = X ×_S S'`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cap_baseChange (B : FlatBaseChangeSituation.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ B.base.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (r : ℕ) (e : ℤ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (β : CycleGroup B.base sY e)
    (w : (pullback f (pullback.fst sY B.g) : Scheme.{u})) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (f ≫ sY) := inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.snd sY B.g) := inferInstance
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (pullback.snd f (pullback.fst sY B.g)) := inferInstance
    (cap B.baseChange (pullback.snd sY B.g) (pullback.snd f (pullback.fst sY B.g))
          (baseChangeFamily f (pullback.fst sY B.g) r α)
          (baseChangeCyclePullback B sY e β) :
        AlgebraicCycle (pullback f (pullback.fst sY B.g) : Scheme.{u}) ℤ) w =
      (baseChangeCyclePullback B (f ≫ sY) ((r : ℤ) + e) (cap B.base sY f α β) :
        AlgebraicCycle (pullback (f ≫ sY) B.g : Scheme.{u}) ℤ)
        ((pullbackRightPullbackFstIso sY B.g f).hom.base w)
declarations.comment: compatibility with flat base change

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cap_familyAssociatedToModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H69.** Let `(S, δ)` and `f : X ⟶ Y` be as in Section 0H65, let `F` be
a coherent `𝒪_X`-module whose support on every fibre of `f` has dimension at most `r` and let `G`
be a coherent `𝒪_Y`-module whose support has delta-dimension at most `e`. Set `α = [F/X/Y]_r` and
`β = [G]_e`. If `F` is flat over `Y` then `α ∩ β = [F ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^* G]_{r + e}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cap_familyAssociatedToModule (r : ℕ) (e : ℤ) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsCoherent]
    (hdim : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι y)).obj F)) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsCoherent]
    (hGe : schemeDeltaDimension C ((reducedSupport G).subschemeι ≫ sY) ≤ (e : EInt)) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian X := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian (f ≫ sY)
    letI : F.IsFiniteType := isFiniteType_of_isCoherent F
    letI : F.IsQuasicoherent := isQuasicoherent_of_isCoherent F
    cap C sY f (familyAssociatedToModule f F r hdim)
        (cycleAssociatedToCoherentSheaf C sY G e hGe) =
      cycleAssociatedToCoherentSheaf C (f ≫ sY) (tensorPullback f F G) ((r : ℤ) + e)
        (schemeDeltaDimension_tensorPullback_le C sY f r e F hdim G hGe)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cap_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6A.** Let `(S, δ)` and `f : X ⟶ Y` be as in Section 0H65. Let
`Z ⊆ X` be a closed subscheme of relative dimension at most `r` over `Y`, so that the fibres
`Z_y = Z ×_X X_y` have dimension at most `r`, and set `α = [Z/X/Y]_r` (Example 0H4S). Let
`W ⊆ Y` be a closed subscheme of `δ`-dimension at most `e` and set `β = [W]_e` (Chow Homology,
Definition 02QU). If `Z` is flat over `Y`, then `α ∩ β = [Z ×_Y W]_{r + e}`.

The proof is the special case `F = 𝒪_Z`, `G = 𝒪_W` of Stacks 0H69: the family `α` is the family
of cycles attached to the coherent module `i_* 𝒪_Z` of Example 0H4Q, by
`Stacks.Chow.familyAssociatedToModule_pushforwardStructureSheaf`; the cycle of a closed
subscheme is the cycle of its structure sheaf (Stacks 02QY) on both sides; flatness of `Z` over
`Y` is flatness of `i_* 𝒪_Z` over `Y` because a closed immersion is affine; and the projection
formula together with base change identifies `i_* 𝒪_Z ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^* j_* 𝒪_W` with the structure
sheaf of `Z ×_Y W` pushed forward to `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cap_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X Y Z W : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (r : ℕ) (e : ℤ)
    (i : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion i] [Flat (i ≫ f)]
    (hZ : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (pullback i (f.fiberι y) : Scheme.{u}) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (j : W ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hWe : schemeDeltaDimension C (j ≫ sY) ≤ (e : EInt)) :
    cap C sY f (familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme f i r)
        (cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C sY j e) =
      cycleAssociatedToClosedSubscheme C (f ≫ sY) (pullback.fst (i ≫ f) j ≫ i)
        ((r : ℤ) + e)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.properPushforward_cap_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6B.** Let `(S, δ)` be a Chow situation, let
```
X' --f--> X
|         |
v         v
Y' --g--> Y
```
be a cartesian square of schemes locally of finite type over `S` with `g` proper, realized by
the fibre product `X' = X ×_Y Y'` with `f = pullback.fst`, let `r ≥ 0` and `e ∈ ℤ`, let `α` be a
family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/Y` and let `β' ∈ Z_e(Y')`. Then

`f_*(g^*α ∩ β') = α ∩ g_*β'`   in   `Z_{r + e}(X)`,

where `∩` is the action `Stacks.Chow.cap` and `g^*α` is the base change
`Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamily` of the family.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforward_cap_baseChangeFamily (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X Y Y' : Scheme.{u}}
    (sX : X ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sX] (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY]
    (sY' : Y' ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY'] (p : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType p]
    (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [IsProper g] (hp : p ≫ sY = sX) (hg : g ≫ sY = sY') (r : ℕ) (e : ℤ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles p r) (β' : CycleGroup C sY' e) :
    properPushforward C (pullback.snd p g ≫ sY') sX (pullback.fst p g)
        (pullbackFst_comp_eq_of_base g hp hg) ((r : ℤ) + e)
        (cap C sY' (pullback.snd p g) (baseChangeFamily p g r α) β') =
      hp ▸ cap C sY p α (properPushforward C sY' sY g hg e β')

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.properPushforward_gysinCycleMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H6D.** The Gysin map on cycles of Stacks 0B6Z commutes with proper pushforward:
in the cartesian square of Stacks 0B6Y

  `D' --i'--> X'`
  `|g          |f`
  `D  --i-->  X`

attached to a triple `(L, s, i : D ⟶ X)` whose invertible module restricts trivially to the zero
scheme `D = Z(s)`, one has `i^* f_* α' = g_* (i')^* α'` in `Z_k(D)` for every `α' ∈ Z_{k+1}(X')`.

The triviality of `L'|_{D'}` that the Gysin map on `X'` needs is not a hypothesis: it follows from
the triviality of `L|_D`, by
`Stacks.Divisors.isTrivial_pullback_zeroScheme_pullbackGlobalSections`.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforward_gysinCycleMap
    (htriv : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsTrivial (zeroScheme X L s).subscheme.sheaf.obj
      (zeroScheme X L s).subscheme.ringCatSheaf.property
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (zeroScheme X L s).subschemeι).obj L))
    (α : CycleGroup C p' (k + 1)) :
    gysinCycleMap C p k L s htriv (properPushforward C p' p f hf (k + 1) α) =
      properPushforward C ((pullbackZeroScheme f L s).subschemeι ≫ p')
        ((zeroScheme X L s).subschemeι ≫ p) (zeroSchemePullbackMap f L s)
        (zeroSchemePullbackMap_comp_structureMorphism f L s p p' hf) k
        (gysinCycleMap C p' k ((Scheme.Modules.pullback f).obj L)
          (AlgebraicGeometry.pullbackGlobalSections f L s)
          (isTrivial_pullback_zeroScheme_pullbackGlobalSections f L s htriv) α)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cap_baseChangeFamily_gysinCycleMap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6E.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Section 0H65, let `p : X ⟶ Y` be a
morphism of schemes locally of finite type over `S`, let `r ≥ 0` and let `α ∈ z(X/Y, r)` be a
relative `r`-cycle on `X/Y`. Let `(L, s, i : D ⟶ Y)` be as in Chow Homology, Definition 02T8:
`L` an invertible module on `Y`, `s` a global section and `i` the closed immersion of its zero
scheme `D`. Form the cartesian square of Chow Homology, Remark 0B6Y,
```
E = X ×_Y D --j--> X
     |             |
     v             v
     D    --i-->   Y
```
so that `j` presents `E` as the zero scheme of the pulled-back section `p^* s` of `p^* L`. If
`L|_D ≅ 𝒪_D`, then for every `e ∈ ℤ` and every `β ∈ Z_{e+1}(Y)`
`i^*α ∩ i^*β = j^*(α ∩ β)` in `Z_{r+e}(E)`,
where `∩` is the action of Section 0H65, `i^*α` the base change of `α` along `i`, and
`i^* : Z_{e+1}(Y) ⟶ Z_e(D)` and `j^* : Z_{r+e+1}(X) ⟶ Z_{r+e}(E)` the Gysin maps on cycles of
Chow Homology, Remark 0B6Z, the latter read along the presentation `j` of the zero scheme of
`p^* s` (`Stacks.Chow.gysinCycleMapAlong`). The triviality of `(p^* L)|_E` that `j^*` needs is
not a hypothesis: it follows from that of `L|_D`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cap_baseChangeFamily_gysinCycleMap (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (p : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] (r : ℕ) (e : ℤ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles p r)
    (hα : letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sY
      IsRelativeCycle p r α)
    (L : Y.Modules)
    [AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsInvertible Y.sheaf.obj Y.ringCatSheaf.property L]
    (s : Γ(L, ⊤))
    (htriv : AlgebraicGeometry.SheafOfModules.IsTrivial
      (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L s).subscheme.sheaf.obj
      (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L s).subscheme.ringCatSheaf.property
      ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L s).subschemeι).obj L))
    (β : CycleGroup C sY (e + 1)) :
    cap C ((Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L s).subschemeι ≫ sY)
        (pullback.snd p (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L s).subschemeι)
        (baseChangeFamily p (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L s).subschemeι r α)
        (gysinCycleMap C sY e L s htriv β) =
      gysinCycleMapAlong C (p ≫ sY)
        (pullback.snd p (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L s).subschemeι ≫
          (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L s).subschemeι ≫ sY) ((r : ℤ) + e)
        ((Scheme.Modules.pullback p).obj L) (pullbackGlobalSections p L s)
        (pullback.fst p (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme Y L s).subschemeι)
        (Stacks.Divisors.isTrivial_pullback_zeroScheme_pullbackGlobalSections p L s htriv)
        (by rw [← Category.assoc, pullback.condition, Category.assoc])
        (Stacks.Divisors.zeroScheme_pullback p L s).symm
        (cycleGroupCongr C (p ≫ sY) (by ring) (cap C sY p α β))

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.exists_bivariantClass_cap_mk_eq_relativeCycleCap
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Proposition 0H6F.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Section 0H65, let `p : X ⟶ Y` be
a morphism of schemes locally of finite type over `S`, let `r ≥ 0` and let `α ∈ z(X/Y, r)` be a
relative `r`-cycle on `X/Y`. The rule that to every morphism `g : Y' ⟶ Y` locally of finite type
and every `k ∈ ℤ` associates the operation `g^*α ∩ - : Z_k(Y') ⟶ Z_{r + k}(X')`,
`X' = Y' ×_Y X` (`Stacks.Chow.relativeCycleCap`), factors through rational equivalence to define
a bivariant class `c(α) ∈ A^{-r}(X ⟶ Y)`: there is a bivariant class of degree `-r` for `p`
whose cap operation on every test scheme sends the class of a cycle `β` to the class of
`g^*α ∩ β`. The class is `Stacks.Chow.relativeCycleBivariantClass`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_bivariantClass_cap_mk_eq_relativeCycleCap :
    ∃ c : BivariantClass C (gysinSystemOfInvertible C) (p ≫ sY) sY p rfl (-(r : ℤ)),
      ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (g : T ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (k : ℤ)
        (β : CycleGroup C (g ≫ sY) k),
        c.cap g k (QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rationalEquivalences C (g ≫ sY) k) β) =
          QuotientAddGroup.mk' (rationalEquivalences C (pullback.fst p g ≫ p ≫ sY) (k - -(r : ℤ)))
            (cycleGroupCongr C _ (by ring) (relativeCycleCap C sY p r α g k β))

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.CompatibleCycleCapRule.exists_relativeCycle
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6G.** Let `(S, δ)` be as in Section 0H65, let `p : X ⟶ Y` be a morphism
of schemes locally of finite type over `S` and let `r ≥ 0`. Let `c` be a rule that to every
morphism `g : Y' ⟶ Y` locally of finite type and every `e ∈ ℤ` associates an operation
`c ∩ - : Z_e(Y') ⟶ Z_{r+e}(X')`, `X' = Y' ×_Y X`, compatible with proper pushforward, flat
pullback, and Gysin maps as in Lemma 0H6E (`Stacks.Chow.CompatibleCycleCapRule`). Then there is a
relative `r`-cycle `α` on `X/Y` such that `c ∩ - = g^*α ∩ -` for every such `g`, where `g^*α ∩ -`
is `Stacks.Chow.relativeCycleCap`.
declarations.statement:
theorem CompatibleCycleCapRule.exists_relativeCycle (C : ChowSituation.{u}) {X Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (p : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] (r : ℕ)
    (c : CompatibleCycleCapRule C sY p r) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian sY
    ∃ α ∈ relativeCycles p r, ∀ {Y' : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (e : ℤ),
      c.cap g e = relativeCycleCap C sY p r α g e

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.compFamily_add_left
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6I.** The composition of families of cycles on fibres is additive in
the family on `X/Y`: `(α₁ + α₂) ∘ β = α₁ ∘ β + α₂ ∘ β`.
declarations.statement:
theorem compFamily_add_left (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (r e : ℕ) (α₁ α₂ : FamilyOfCycles f r) (β : FamilyOfCycles g e) :
    compFamily f g r e (α₁ + α₂) β = compFamily f g r e α₁ β + compFamily f g r e α₂ β
declarations.comment: additivity in the family on X/Y

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.compFamily_add_right
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6I.** The composition of families of cycles on fibres is additive in
the family on `Y/S`: `α ∘ (β₁ + β₂) = α ∘ β₁ + α ∘ β₂`.
declarations.statement:
theorem compFamily_add_right (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (r e : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (β₁ β₂ : FamilyOfCycles g e) :
    compFamily f g r e α (β₁ + β₂) = compFamily f g r e α β₁ + compFamily f g r e α β₂
declarations.comment: additivity in the family on Y/S

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.restrictedFamily_compFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6J.** If `U ⊆ X`, `V ⊆ Y` and `W ⊆ S` are open with `f(U) ⊆ V` and
`g(V) ⊆ W`, then the restriction of the composition `α ∘ β` to `U` is the composition of the
restriction of `α` to the fibres of `U/V` with the restriction of `β` to the fibres of `V/W`.
The source's statement is the case `W = S`.
declarations.statement:
theorem restrictedFamily_compFamily {U V W : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (g : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (fU : U ⟶ V) (gV : V ⟶ W) (j : U ⟶ X)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] (i : V ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion i] (k : W ⟶ S) [IsOpenImmersion k]
    (hU : j ≫ f = fU ≫ i) (hV : i ≫ g = gV ≫ k) (r e : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    (β : FamilyOfCycles g e) :
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType fU := by
      let : LocallyOfFiniteType (fU ≫ i) := hU ▸ inferInstance
      exact locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp fU i
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType gV := by
      let : LocallyOfFiniteType (gV ≫ k) := hV ▸ inferInstance
      exact locallyOfFiniteType_of_comp gV k
    (restrictedFamily (f ≫ g) (fU ≫ gV) j k (comp_restrictionSquare hU hV) (r + e)
        (compFamily f g r e α β)).1 =
      compFamily fU gV r e (restrictedFamily f fU j i hU r α).1
        (restrictedFamily g gV i k hV e β).1

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.compFamily_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
The formation of the composition `α ∘ β` of a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/Y` with
a family of `e`-cycles on the fibres of `Y/S` is compatible with an arbitrary base change
`h : S' ⟶ S`: the composition of the base change of `α` along `Y ×_S S' ⟶ Y` with the base change
of `β` along `h` is the base change of `α ∘ β` along `h`, read on the fibre over a point `t` of
`S'` through the canonical identification of `(X ×_Y (Y ×_S S'))_t` with `(X ×_S S')_t`.
declarations.statement:
theorem compFamily_baseChangeFamily (r e : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r)
    (β : FamilyOfCycles g e) :
    compFamily (pullback.snd f (pullback.fst g h)) (pullback.snd g h) r e
        (baseChangeFamily f (pullback.fst g h) r α) (baseChangeFamily g h e β) t =
      fiberCycleRestrict (pullback.snd (f ≫ g) h)
        (pullback.snd f (pullback.fst g h) ≫ pullback.snd g h)
        (pullbackRightPullbackFstIso g h f).hom
        (pullbackRightPullbackFstIso_hom_snd g h f) t (r + e)
        (baseChangeFamily (f ≫ g) h (r + e) (compFamily f g r e α β) t)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.compFamily_familyAssociatedToModule
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6L.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes, both
locally of finite type, and let `r, e ≥ 0`. Let `F` be a quasi-coherent `𝒪_X`-module of finite
type whose support on every fibre of `f` has dimension at most `r`, and let `G` be a
quasi-coherent `𝒪_Y`-module of finite type whose support on every fibre of `g` has dimension at
most `e`. Set `α = [F/X/Y]_r` and `β = [G/Y/S]_e`. If `F` is flat over `Y` then
`α ∘ β = [F ⊗_{𝒪_X} f^* G/X/S]_{r + e}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem compFamily_familyAssociatedToModule {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (r e : ℕ) (F : X.Modules)
    [F.IsFiniteType] [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hF : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (f.fiberι y)).obj F)) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (hflat : IsFlatOver f.toLRSHom.toShHom F) (G : Y.Modules) [G.IsFiniteType]
    [G.IsQuasicoherent]
    (hG : ∀ t : S, topologicalKrullDim
      (SheafOfModules.supp ((Scheme.Modules.pullback (g.fiberι t)).obj G)) ≤ (e : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    compFamily f g r e (familyAssociatedToModule f F r hF)
        (familyAssociatedToModule g G e hG) =
      familyAssociatedToModule (f ≫ g) (tensorPullback f F G) (r + e)
        (fibreDim_tensorPullback_le f g r e F hF G hG)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.compFamily_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6M.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes, both
locally of finite type, and let `r, e ≥ 0`. Let `Z ⊆ X` be a closed subscheme of relative
dimension at most `r` over `Y`, so that the fibres `Z_y = Z ×_X X_y` have dimension at most `r`,
and let `W ⊆ Y` be a closed subscheme of relative dimension at most `e` over `S`. Set
`α = [Z/X/Y]_r` and `β = [W/Y/S]_e` (Example 0H4S). If `Z` is flat over `Y` then
`α ∘ β = [Z ×_Y W/X/S]_{r + e}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem compFamily_familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme {X Y S Z W : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (r e : ℕ) (i : Z ⟶ X)
    [IsClosedImmersion i] [Flat (i ≫ f)]
    (hZ : ∀ y : Y, topologicalKrullDim (pullback i (f.fiberι y) : Scheme.{u}) ≤ (r : WithBot ℕ∞))
    (j : W ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion j]
    (hW : ∀ t : S,
      topologicalKrullDim (pullback j (g.fiberι t) : Scheme.{u}) ≤ (e : WithBot ℕ∞)) :
    compFamily f g r e (familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme f i r)
        (familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme g j e) =
      familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (f ≫ g) (pullback.fst (i ≫ f) j ≫ i) (r + e)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardFamily_compFamily_baseChangeFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6N.** Let `S` be a scheme, let
```
X' --f--> X
|         |
v         v
Y' --g--> Y
```
be a cartesian square of schemes locally of finite type over `S` with `g` proper, realized by
the fibre product `X' = X ×_Y Y'` with `f = pullback.fst`, let `r, e ≥ 0`, let `α` be a family
of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/Y` and let `β'` be a family of `e`-cycles on the fibres of
`Y'/S`. Then

`f_*(g^*α ∘ β') = α ∘ g_*β'`

as families of `(r + e)`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S`, where `∘` is the composition
`Stacks.Chow.compFamily`, `g^*` is `Stacks.Chow.baseChangeFamily` and `f_*`, `g_*` are
`Stacks.Chow.properPushforwardFamily`.
declarations.statement:
theorem properPushforwardFamily_compFamily_baseChangeFamily {X Y Y' S : Scheme.{u}}
    (sY : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY] (sY' : Y' ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sY']
    (p : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType p] (g : Y' ⟶ Y) [IsProper g] (hg : g ≫ sY = sY')
    (r e : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles p r) (β' : FamilyOfCycles sY' e) :
    properPushforwardFamily (pullback.snd p g ≫ sY') (p ≫ sY) (pullback.fst p g)
        (pullbackFst_comp_eq_of_base g rfl hg) (r + e)
        (compFamily (pullback.snd p g) sY' r e (baseChangeFamily p g r α) β') =
      compFamily p sY r e α (properPushforwardFamily sY' sY g hg e β')

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cap_compFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6P.** Associativity of the action of families of cycles on fibres:
for `α` a family of `r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/Y`, `β` a family of `e`-cycles on the fibres
of `Y/S` and `γ` a `d`-cycle on `S`, we have `(α ∘ β) ∩ γ = α ∩ (β ∩ γ)` in `Z_{r + e + d}(X)`.
Each side carries its δ-dimension in its own type, so the relation is stated between the
underlying cycles on `X`.
declarations.statement:
theorem cap_compFamily (C : ChowSituation.{u}) (sS : S ⟶ C.S) [LocallyOfFiniteType sS]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f] (g : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] (r e : ℕ) {d : ℤ}
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (β : FamilyOfCycles g e) (γ : CycleGroup C sS d) :
    (cap C sS (f ≫ g) (compFamily f g r e α β) γ : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ) =
      (cap C (g ≫ sS) f α (cap C sS g β γ) : AlgebraicCycle X ℤ)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.isRelativeCycle_compFamily
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H6R.** Let `X --f--> Y --g--> S` be morphisms of schemes, both
locally of finite type, with `S` locally Noetherian, and let `r, e ≥ 0`. If `α` is a relative
`r`-cycle on `X/Y` and `β` is a relative `e`-cycle on `Y/S`, then the composition `α ∘ β` is a
relative `(r + e)`-cycle on `X/S`.

`Y` is locally Noetherian because it is locally of finite type over the locally Noetherian
scheme `S`, which is what makes the hypothesis on `α` meaningful.
declarations.statement:
theorem isRelativeCycle_compFamily {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [LocallyOfFiniteType f]
    (g : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [IsLocallyNoetherian S] (r e : ℕ)
    (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) (β : FamilyOfCycles g e) :
    letI : IsLocallyNoetherian Y := LocallyOfFiniteType.isLocallyNoetherian g
    IsRelativeCycle f r α → IsRelativeCycle g e β →
      IsRelativeCycle (f ≫ g) (r + e) (compFamily f g r e α β)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.compFamily_familyAssociatedToSelf
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H6S.** Let `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` be morphisms of schemes, both
locally of finite type and flat, of relative dimension `r` resp. `e`. Then the composition
`[X/X/Y]_r ∘ [Y/Y/S]_e` of the families of cycles on fibres attached to the closed subschemes
`X ⊆ X` and `Y ⊆ Y` (Example 0H4S) is the family `[X/X/S]_{r + e}`. The equality is one of
families of cycles on fibres, so the local Noetherian hypothesis on `S`, needed only to speak of
the group `z(X/S, r + e)` containing them, is not used.
declarations.statement:
theorem compFamily_familyAssociatedToSelf {X Y S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [Flat f] (g : Y ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [Flat g] (r e : ℕ)
    (hf : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension f r)
    (hg : AlgebraicGeometry.RelativeDimension g e) :
    compFamily f g r e (familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme f (𝟙 X) r)
        (familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme g (𝟙 Y) e) =
      familyAssociatedToClosedSubscheme (f ≫ g) (𝟙 X) (r + e)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.HilbertCycleDatum
declarations.doc:
A member of `Hilb(X/S, r)`: a closed subscheme `Z ⊆ X`, given by its ideal sheaf, whose
structure morphism `Z ⟶ S` is flat, of finite presentation, and of relative dimension at most `r`.
declarations.statement: structure HilbertCycleDatum {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (r : ℕ)
declarations.comment: the set Hilb(X/S, r)

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cycleClassMap
declarations.doc:
The cycle-class homomorphism from the free abelian group on `Hilb(X/S, r)` to the families of
`r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S`, sending `∑ nᵢ [Zᵢ]` to `∑ nᵢ [Zᵢ/X/S]_r`.
declarations.statement:
def cycleClassMap {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] (r : ℕ) :
    FreeAbelianGroup (HilbertCycleDatum f r) →+ FamilyOfCycles f r
declarations.comment: the homomorphism

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.cycleClassMap_of
declarations.doc:
On a generator the cycle-class homomorphism is the family of cycles `[Z/X/S]_r` of the closed
subscheme.
declarations.statement:
theorem cycleClassMap_of {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    (r : ℕ) (Z : HilbertCycleDatum f r) :
    cycleClassMap f r (FreeAbelianGroup.of Z) = Z.cycleFamily f
declarations.comment: on generators

declarations.name: Stacks.Chow.comesFromNoetherianBase_iff_hasCompletelyDecomposedCycleClassCover
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Lemma 0H6W.** Let `S` be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme, let
`f : X ⟶ S` be a morphism of finite presentation, let `r ≥ 0` and let `α` be a family of
`r`-cycles on the fibres of `X/S`. The following are equivalent:

1. there are a cartesian square with right-hand column a finite type morphism `X₀ ⟶ S₀` of
   Noetherian schemes and `α₀ ∈ z(X₀/S₀, r)` such that `α` is the base change of `α₀` by
   `S ⟶ S₀`;
2. there is a completely decomposed proper morphism `g : S' ⟶ S` of finite presentation such
   that `g^*α` is in the image of the cycle class map of Tag 0H6V.

Finite presentation of `f` is spelled `LocallyOfFinitePresentation`, `QuasiCompact` and
`QuasiSeparated`, as in the source.
declarations.statement:
theorem comesFromNoetherianBase_iff_hasCompletelyDecomposedCycleClassCover {X S : Scheme.{u}}
    [CompactSpace S] [QuasiSeparatedSpace S] (f : X ⟶ S) [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f]
    [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f] (r : ℕ) (α : FamilyOfCycles f r) :
    ComesFromNoetherianBase f r α ↔ HasCompletelyDecomposedCycleClassCover f r α

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekBaseChangeIso_hom_comp_toDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0H6X], compatibility (2), on `D⁺_tors(X_étale, Λ)`**: the map `Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*`
is compatible with the isomorphism `g⁻¹ ∘ Rf_! ≅ Rf'_! ∘ (g')⁻¹` of [Stacks, Tag 0F7L]
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekBaseChangeIso`) and the base change map
`g⁻¹ ∘ Rf_* ⟶ Rf'_* ∘ (g')⁻¹` of Cohomology on Sites, Remark 07A7
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleModuleDerivedBaseChange`): for a cartesian square
`g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g`, a compactification `j` of `f` and `K` in `D⁺_tors(X_étale, Λ)`,
`g⁻¹ Rf_! K ≅ Rf'_! (g')⁻¹ K ⟶ Rf'_* (g')⁻¹ K` is `g⁻¹ Rf_! K ⟶ g⁻¹ Rf_* K ⟶ Rf'_* (g')⁻¹ K`,
`Rf'_!` being computed with the base change of `j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLowerShriekBaseChangeIso_hom_comp_toDirectImage (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (K : (isTorsionPlus.{u, 0} Λ X).FullSubcategory) :
    (derivedLowerShriekBaseChangeIso Λ sq j).hom.app K ≫
        (derivedLowerShriekToDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ f' (j.baseChange sq)).app
          ((etaleModuleDerivedInverseImagePlus.{u, 0} Λ g').obj K.obj) =
      (etaleModuleDerivedInverseImagePlus.{u, 0} Λ g).map
          ((derivedLowerShriekToDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ f j).app K.obj) ≫
        (etaleModuleDerivedBaseChange.{u, 0} Λ f f' g g' sq.w.symm).app K.obj
declarations.comment: (2), on D⁺_tors

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekCompIso_hom_comp_toDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0H6X], compatibility (1), on `D⁺_tors(X_étale, Λ)`**: the map `Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*`
is compatible with the isomorphism `R(g ∘ f)_! ≅ Rg_! ∘ Rf_!` of [Stacks, Tag 0F7J]
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekCompIso`) and the composition isomorphism
`R(g ∘ f)_* ≅ Rg_* ∘ Rf_*` of Cohomology on Sites, Tag 0D6E, for arbitrary compactifications
`jf`, `jg`, `j` of `f`, `g` and `g ∘ f`: for `K` in `D⁺_tors(X_étale, Λ)`,
`R(g ∘ f)_! K ≅ Rg_! Rf_! K ⟶ Rg_! Rf_* K ⟶ Rg_* Rf_* K ≅ R(g ∘ f)_* K` is the map
`R(g ∘ f)_! K ⟶ R(g ∘ f)_* K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLowerShriekCompIso_hom_comp_toDirectImage (jf : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f))
    (jg : CompactificationOf (Over.mk g)) (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk (f ≫ g)))
    (K : (isTorsionPlus.{u, 0} Λ X).FullSubcategory) :
    (derivedLowerShriekCompIso Λ f g jf jg j).hom.app K ≫
        (derivedLowerShriek.{u, 0} g jg Λ).map
          ((derivedLowerShriekToDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ f jf).app K.obj) ≫
        (derivedLowerShriekToDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ g jg).app
          ((etaleModuleDerivedDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ f).obj K.obj) ≫
        (etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageComp.{u, 0} Λ f g (f ≫ g) rfl).inv.app K.obj =
      (derivedLowerShriekToDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ (f ≫ g) j).app K.obj
declarations.comment: (1), on D⁺_tors

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekToDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**The map `Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*` of [Stacks, Tag 0H6X]** on `D⁺(X_étale, Λ)`. For a finite type
separated morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` and a compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄`, `f̄ : X̄ ⟶ Y` of `X` over `Y`
it is
```
Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ Rj_! ⟶ Rf̄_* ∘ Rj_* ≅ R(j ≫ f̄)_* = Rf_*,
```
`Rf̄_*` of the map `Rj_! ⟶ Rj_*` induced by the canonical transformation `j_! ⟶ j_*` of
[Stacks, Tag 0F4L], followed by the composition isomorphism of derived direct images
(Cohomology on Sites, Tag 0D6E). It is natural in `K`, and restricts to `D⁺_tors(X_étale, Λ)`.
declarations.statement:
def derivedLowerShriekToDirectImage :
    derivedLowerShriek.{u, w} f j Λ ⟶ etaleModuleDerivedDirectImage.{u, w} Λ f
declarations.comment: the map Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*, functorial in K, on D⁺_tors

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekCompactificationIsoUniv_hom_comp_toDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0H6X]: the map `Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*` does not depend on the compactification**, on
`D⁺_tors(X_étale, Λ)`: for any two compactifications `j₁`, `j₂` of `X` over `Y`, the canonical
isomorphism `Rf_!^{j₁} ≅ Rf_!^{j₂}` of [Stacks, Tag 0F7I], computed through a compactification
dominating both, followed by the map `Rf_!^{j₂} ⟶ Rf_*` is the map `Rf_!^{j₁} ⟶ Rf_*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLowerShriekCompactificationIsoUniv_hom_comp_toDirectImage [CompactSpace Y]
    [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    (j₁ j₂ : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) :
    (derivedLowerShriekCompactificationIsoUniv f j₁ j₂ Λ).hom ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (isTorsionPlus.{u, w} Λ X).ι
          (derivedLowerShriekToDirectImage.{u, w} Λ f j₂) =
      Functor.whiskerLeft (isTorsionPlus.{u, w} Λ X).ι
        (derivedLowerShriekToDirectImage.{u, w} Λ f j₁)
declarations.comment: independence of the compactification, on D⁺_tors

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedBaseChange_comp_toDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0H6X], compatibility (2), on `D(X_étale, Λ)`**: the map `Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*` is
compatible with the base change map `g⁻¹ ∘ Rf_! ⟶ Rf'_! ∘ (g')⁻¹` of [Stacks, Tag 0F7L]
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedBaseChange`, whose components are those of the
isomorphism `Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedBaseChangeIso` when `Λ` is torsion)
and the base change map `g⁻¹ ∘ Rf_* ⟶ Rf'_* ∘ (g')⁻¹` of Cohomology on Sites, Remark 07A7
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.etaleModuleDerivedBaseChangeUnbounded`): for a cartesian square
`g' ≫ f = f' ≫ g` and a compactification `j` of `f`, the composite
`g⁻¹ ∘ Rf_! ⟶ Rf'_! ∘ (g')⁻¹ ⟶ Rf'_* ∘ (g')⁻¹` is `g⁻¹ ∘ Rf_! ⟶ g⁻¹ ∘ Rf_* ⟶ Rf'_* ∘ (g')⁻¹`,
as transformations of functors on `D(X_étale, Λ)`, `Rf'_!` being computed with the base change of
`j`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLowerShriekUnboundedBaseChange_comp_toDirectImage (sq : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) :
    derivedLowerShriekUnboundedBaseChange.{u, r} Λ sq j ≫
        Functor.whiskerLeft (etaleModuleDerivedInverseImage.{u, r} Λ g')
          (derivedLowerShriekUnboundedToDirectImage.{u, r} Λ f' (j.baseChange sq)) =
      Functor.whiskerRight (derivedLowerShriekUnboundedToDirectImage.{u, r} Λ f j)
          (etaleModuleDerivedInverseImage.{u, r} Λ g) ≫
        etaleModuleDerivedBaseChangeUnbounded.{u, r} Λ f g g' f' sq.w
declarations.comment: (2), on D(X_étale, Λ), Λ torsion

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedCompIso_hom_comp_toDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0H6X], compatibility (1), on `D(X_étale, Λ)`** for a torsion ring `Λ`: the map
`Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*` is compatible with the isomorphism `R(g ∘ f)_! ≅ Rg_! ∘ Rf_!` of [Stacks, Tag 0F7J]
(`Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedCompIso`) and the composition isomorphism
`R(g ∘ f)_* ≅ Rg_* ∘ Rf_*` of Cohomology on Sites, Tag 0D6E, for arbitrary compactifications
`jf`, `jg`, `j` of `f`, `g` and `g ∘ f`: for `K` in `D(X_étale, Λ)`,
`R(g ∘ f)_! K ≅ Rg_! Rf_! K ⟶ Rg_! Rf_* K ⟶ Rg_* Rf_* K ≅ R(g ∘ f)_* K` is the map
`R(g ∘ f)_! K ⟶ R(g ∘ f)_* K`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLowerShriekUnboundedCompIso_hom_comp_toDirectImage
    (jf : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f)) (jg : CompactificationOf (Over.mk g))
    (j : CompactificationOf (Over.mk (f ≫ g))) (K : DerivedCategory (EtaleModules.{u, 0} Λ X)) :
    (derivedLowerShriekUnboundedCompIso Λ hΛ f g jf jg j).hom.app K ≫
        (derivedLowerShriekUnbounded.{u, 0} g jg Λ).map
          ((derivedLowerShriekUnboundedToDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ f jf).app K) ≫
        (derivedLowerShriekUnboundedToDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ g jg).app
          ((etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnbounded.{u, 0} Λ f).obj K) ≫
        (etaleModuleDerivedDirectImageUnboundedLerayIso.{u, 0} Λ f g (f ≫ g) rfl).inv.app K =
      (derivedLowerShriekUnboundedToDirectImage.{u, 0} Λ (f ≫ g) j).app K
declarations.comment: (1), on D(X_étale, Λ), Λ torsion

declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedToDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**The map `Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*` of [Stacks, Tag 0H6X]** on `D(X_étale, Λ)`. For a finite type
separated morphism `f : X ⟶ Y` and a compactification `j : X ⟶ X̄`, `f̄ : X̄ ⟶ Y` of `X` over `Y`
it is
```
Rf_! = Rf̄_* ∘ Rj_! ⟶ Rf̄_* ∘ Rj_* ≅ R(j ≫ f̄)_* = Rf_*,
```
`Rf̄_*` of the map `Rj_! ⟶ Rj_*` induced by the canonical transformation `j_! ⟶ j_*` of
[Stacks, Tag 0F4L], followed by the inverse of the Leray isomorphism of unbounded derived direct
images. It is natural in `K`.
declarations.comment: the map Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*, functorial in K, on D(X_étale, Λ)
