declarations.name: Stacks.EtaleCohomology.derivedLowerShriekUnboundedCompactificationIsoUniv_hom_comp_toDirectImage
declarations.doc:
**[Stacks, Tag 0H6X]: the map `Rf_! ⟶ Rf_*` does not depend on the compactification**, on
`D(X_étale, Λ)` for a torsion ring `Λ`: for any two compactifications `j₁`, `j₂` of `X` over
`Y`, the canonical isomorphism `Rf_!^{j₁} ≅ Rf_!^{j₂}` of [Stacks, Tag 0F7I], computed through a
compactification dominating both, followed by the map `Rf_!^{j₂} ⟶ Rf_*` is the map
`Rf_!^{j₁} ⟶ Rf_*`.
declarations.statement:
theorem derivedLowerShriekUnboundedCompactificationIsoUniv_hom_comp_toDirectImage
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) [CompactSpace Y] [QuasiSeparatedSpace Y] [IsSeparated f]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f] (j₁ j₂ : CompactificationOf (Over.mk f))
    (hΛ : ∃ m : ℕ, 0 < m ∧ (m : Λ) = 0) :
    (derivedLowerShriekUnboundedCompactificationIsoUniv f j₁ j₂ Λ hΛ).hom ≫
        derivedLowerShriekUnboundedToDirectImage.{u, r} Λ f j₂ =
      derivedLowerShriekUnboundedToDirectImage.{u, r} Λ f j₁
declarations.comment: independence of the compactification, on D(X_étale, Λ), Λ torsion

declarations.name: CategoryTheory.Presheaf.isIso_presheafToSheaf_map_of_hasEnoughObjects_bijective
declarations.doc:
Let `φ : F ⟶ G` be a map of presheaves on a site `(C, J)`. If every object of `C` has a
covering by objects `U` for which `φ` is bijective on sections over `U`, then the map of
sheafifications `F^# ⟶ G^#` is an isomorphism.
declarations.statement:
theorem isIso_presheafToSheaf_map_of_hasEnoughObjects_bijective
    [HasWeakSheafify J D] [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective D]
    (hB : J.HasEnoughObjects (fun U => Function.Bijective (φ.app (op U)))) :
    IsIso ((presheafToSheaf J D).map φ)
declarations.comment:
Bijectivity of a map of presheaves on a family of objects covering every
  object makes the induced map of sheafifications an isomorphism.

declarations.name: not_isLocalHom_algebraMap_atPrime
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H70**: for a local ring `R` and a non-maximal prime `𝔭`, the localization map
`R → R_𝔭` is not a local homomorphism.

The witness is any `x ∈ 𝔪_R \ 𝔭`, which exists precisely because `𝔭 ⊊ 𝔪_R`: it becomes a unit
in `R_𝔭`, so a local homomorphism would force it to be a unit already in `R`, contradicting
`x ∈ 𝔪_R`.
declarations.statement:
theorem not_isLocalHom_algebraMap_atPrime {R : Type*} [CommRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (p : Ideal R) [hp : p.IsPrime] (hne : p ≠ maximalIdeal R) :
    ¬ IsLocalHom (algebraMap R (Localization.AtPrime p))

declarations.name: fittingIdeal_quotient_and_prod
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H73.** The zeroth Fitting ideal of `R ⧸ I` is `I`; for the direct sum of two such
quotients, the zeroth and first Fitting ideals are respectively the product and sum of the
defining ideals.
declarations.statement:
theorem fittingIdeal_quotient_and_prod {R : Type*} [CommRing R] (I J : Ideal R) :
    fittingIdeal (M := R ⧸ I) 0 = I ∧
      fittingIdeal (M := (R ⧸ I) × (R ⧸ J)) 0 = I * J ∧
      fittingIdeal (M := (R ⧸ I) × (R ⧸ J)) 1 = I + J

declarations.name: exists_lift_of_smooth_of_henselianPair
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H74.** Every map from a smooth algebra to the quotient of a henselian pair lifts
to the original ring.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_lift_of_smooth_of_henselianPair
    {R : Type u} {S : Type v} {A : Type w}
    [CommRing R] [CommRing S] [CommRing A] [Algebra R S] [Algebra R A]
    [Algebra.Smooth R S] (I : Ideal A) (hI : HenselianPair A I)
    (f : S →ₐ[R] A ⧸ I) :
    ∃ f' : S →ₐ[R] A, (Ideal.Quotient.mkₐ R I).comp f' = f

declarations.name: StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.hasTorAmplitudeIn_derivedExtensionScalars_certified_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H75.** Let `f : R' → R` be a surjective map of commutative rings whose kernel is a
nilpotent ideal, and let `L` be the derived base change along `f`. For every object `K` of `D(R')`
and every finite interval `[a, b]`, the object `L.obj K` has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` if and only
if `K` does.

`L` is quantified over together with its comparison to termwise extension of scalars and the
`Functor.IsLeftDerivedFunctor` certificate, which pins it down as *the* derived base change rather
than an arbitrary functor. Each of the two derived tensor products is quantified as a
`StacksDraft.TorAmplitude.CertifiedDerivedTensoring`: the bifunctor, its comparison with termwise
tensoring by a module placed in degree zero, and the universal property making each `- ⊗ᴸ M[0]` the
total left derived functor of `- ⊗ M`. That is exactly the datum Stacks 0652 reads Tor amplitude
off, and no more; in particular neither the comparison at pairs of K-flat complexes nor exactness
in the second variable is assumed.

The universe of `R'`, the universe of `R` and the universe of the module carriers are independent:
`R' : Type u`, `R : Type v`, and both rings' modules are read in `ModuleCat.{max u v w}`, as in the
source statement. Neither ring is `ULift`ed in the statement.

The proof moves both sides into the lifted rings, where the ring universe and the module universe
coincide, by `hasTorAmplitude_iff_scalarLift` for the Tor amplitudes and
`derivedExtensionLiftSquare` for the base change, and there applies
`hasTorAmplitudeIn_derivedExtensionScalars_iff_sameUniverse` to the canonical derived tensor
product of Stacks 0BYI.
declarations.statement:
public theorem hasTorAmplitudeIn_derivedExtensionScalars_certified_iff
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hnil : IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker f))
    (L : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R') ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R))
    (comparison : DerivedCategory.Q (C := ModuleCat.{max u v w} R') ⋙ L ⟶
      (ModuleCat.extendScalars.{u, v, max u v w} f).mapHomologicalComplex
          (ComplexShape.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q (C := ModuleCat.{max u v w} R))
    [L.IsLeftDerivedFunctor comparison
      (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R') (ComplexShape.up ℤ))]
    (D' : CertifiedDerivedTensoring.{u, max u v w} R')
    (D : CertifiedDerivedTensoring.{v, max u v w} R)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v w} R')) (a b : ℤ) :
    D.HasTorAmplitudeIn (L.obj K) a b ↔ D'.HasTorAmplitudeIn K a b

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.isPseudoCoherent_derivedExtensionScalars_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H76.** Derived extension of scalars along a surjective map of commutative rings
with nilpotent kernel preserves *and reflects* pseudo-coherence.

Preservation is [stacks 0650]. Reflection is [stacks 09AR]: a bounded above finite projective
representative of the reduction, which exists by [stacks 064U], lifts to a bounded above
projective representative of `K`, whose terms are finite because their extensions of scalars
are and the kernel is nilpotent.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isPseudoCoherent_derivedExtensionScalars_iff
    {R' R : Type u} [CommRing R'] [CommRing R] (f : R' →+* R)
    (hf : Function.Surjective f) (hnil : IsNilpotent (RingHom.ker f))
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} R')) :
    PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent
        ((totalDerivedExtensionScalars.{u, u, v} f).functor.obj K) ↔
      PseudoCoherence.IsPseudoCoherent K

declarations.name: FormalGlueing.canonicalSectionsAdjunction
declarations.doc:
The compatible-sections functor `H⁰` on module glueing data is right adjoint to the canonical
glueing-data functor.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def canonicalSectionsAdjunction
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (S : Type v) [CommRing S] [Algebra R S]
    {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → R)
    (C : FormalGlueing.ModuleGlueingConstruction.{u, v, w} S f) :
    letI := C.category
    C.canonical ⊣ C.sections

declarations.name: Stacks.NonvanishingPullback.preimage_nonvanishingLocus_lrs
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Tag 0H78.** For a morphism of locally ringed spaces, the inverse image of the
nonvanishing locus of a global section of a module is the nonvanishing locus of the pulled-back
section.
declarations.statement:
theorem preimage_nonvanishingLocus_lrs (s : L.sections) :
    f.base ⁻¹' Stacks.NonvanishingTrivialize.nonvanishingLocus X.toRingedSpace L s =
      Stacks.NonvanishingTrivialize.nonvanishingLocus Y.toRingedSpace
        ((modulePullback f.toShHom).obj L) (pullbackSections f L s)

declarations.name: Stacks.SheafOfModules.preimage_nonvanishingLocus
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H78.** For a morphism `f : Y ⟶ X` of locally ringed spaces and a
global section `s` of a sheaf of `𝒪_X`-modules `L`, the nonvanishing locus of the pullback of
`s` is the preimage of the nonvanishing locus of `s`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem preimage_nonvanishingLocus (s : L.sections) :
    f.base ⁻¹' nonvanishingLocus (X := X.toRingedSpace) L s =
      nonvanishingLocus (X := Y.toRingedSpace)
        ((modulePullback f.toShHom).obj L) (modulePullbackSection f L s)

declarations.name: Stacks.Sheaves.RingedSpaceDifferentials.triangleDifferentials_exact
declarations.doc:
For morphisms of ringed spaces `f : X ⟶ Y` and `g : Y ⟶ S` the canonical maps form a complex
`f^* Ω_{Y/S} ⟶ Ω_{X/S} ⟶ Ω_{X/Y}` which is exact at `Ω_{X/S}`. Together with
`triangleDifferentials_epi` this is the exactness of `f^* Ω_{Y/S} ⟶ Ω_{X/S} ⟶ Ω_{X/Y} ⟶ 0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem triangleDifferentials_exact (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S) :
    ∃ h : differentialMap f g (f ≫ g) (𝟙 S) (by simp) ≫ toRelativeDifferentials f g = 0,
      (ShortComplex.mk _ _ h).Exact
declarations.comment: exactness at the middle term

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.AbelianSheaf.preservesColimit_higherDirectImage_of_isBasis
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H7A.** If cohomology over the inverse images of the opens of a basis of `Y`
commutes with a colimit of abelian sheaves on `X`, then so does the degree-`p` higher direct
image along `f`.

This is the local criterion of Stacks 0H7B for the morphism of sites given by the continuous
functor `Opens.map f`, together with the observation that a basis of `Y` supplies, for every
open `V`, a covering of `V` by members of the basis — which is what 0H7B asks for.
declarations.statement:
theorem preservesColimit_higherDirectImage_of_isBasis
    {I : Type v} [SmallCategory I] (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (F : I ⥤ X.Sheaf AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (p : ℕ)
    (h : Opens.IsBasis {V : Opens Y |
      PreservesColimit F (cohomologyOver ((Opens.map f).obj V) p)}) :
    PreservesColimit F (higherDirectImage f p)

declarations.name: Stacks.Cohomology.HigherDirectImage.preservesColimit_rightDerived_sheafPushforwardContinuous
declarations.doc:
Let `u : D ⥤ C` be the continuous functor associated to a morphism of sites and let `F` be
a diagram of abelian sheaves on `C`. If every object of `D` has a cover by objects over which
degree-`p` cohomology commutes with the colimit of `F`, then the degree-`p` higher direct image
commutes with that colimit.
declarations.statement:
public theorem preservesColimit_rightDerived_sheafPushforwardContinuous
    {C : Type a} {D : Type d} [SmallCategory C] [SmallCategory D]
    (J : GrothendieckTopology C) (K : GrothendieckTopology D)
    [HasSheafify J (Ab.{b})] [HasSheafify K (Ab.{b})]
    [EnoughInjectives (Sheaf J (Ab.{b}))]
    (u : D ⥤ C) [u.IsContinuous K J]
    (p : ℕ) {I : Type c} [SmallCategory I]
    (F : I ⥤ Sheaf J (Ab.{b}))
    (h : ∀ V : D, ∃ E : PreZeroHypercover.{d} V, E.sieve₀ ∈ K V ∧
      ∀ i : E.I₀, PreservesColimit F
        (((sheafSections J (Ab.{b})).obj (op (u.obj (E.X i)))).rightDerived p)) :
    PreservesColimit F
      ((u.sheafPushforwardContinuous (Ab.{b}) K J).rightDerived p)

declarations.name: StacksDefinitionInjective
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H7H, full statement.**

Let `X : TopCat`.

1. For a morphism `f : F ⟶ G` of presheaves of types on `X`:
   - `f` is a monomorphism iff each component `f.app U` is injective;
   - `f` is an epimorphism iff each component `f.app U` is surjective.
2. For a morphism `f : F ⟶ G` of sheaves of types on `X`:
   - `f` is a monomorphism iff each component `f.1.app U` is injective,
     iff `f` is injective on every stalk;
   - `f` is an epimorphism iff `f` is surjective on every stalk.

The Stacks notion of "injective map of sheaves" is "injective on every open set", and the
Stacks notion of "surjective map of sheaves" is "surjective on every stalk"
(cf. Stacks tag 008Q).  With those Stacks definitions, the two parts above show that
in `Sh(X)` the epimorphisms are exactly the surjective maps of sheaves and the
monomorphisms are exactly the injective maps of sheaves.
declarations.statement:
theorem StacksDefinitionInjective :
    -- Part (1): presheaves
    (∀ {F G : TopCat.Presheaf (Type u) X} (f : F ⟶ G),
        Mono f ↔ ∀ U : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ, Function.Injective (f.app U)) ∧
    (∀ {F G : TopCat.Presheaf (Type u) X} (f : F ⟶ G),
        Epi f ↔ ∀ U : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ, Function.Surjective (f.app U)) ∧
    -- Part (2): sheaves
    (∀ {F G : TopCat.Sheaf (Type u) X} (f : F ⟶ G),
        Mono f ↔ ∀ U : (Opens X)ᵒᵖ, Function.Injective (f.1.app U)) ∧
    (∀ {F G : TopCat.Sheaf (Type u) X} (f : F ⟶ G),
        Mono f ↔ ∀ x : X,
          Function.Injective ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (Type u) x).map f.1)) ∧
    (∀ {F G : TopCat.Sheaf (Type u) X} (f : F ⟶ G),
        Epi f ↔ ∀ x : X,
          Function.Surjective ((TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor (Type u) x).map f.1))

declarations.name: TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallyInjective_presheafToSheaf_map_of_injective
declarations.doc:
The sheafification of an injective morphism of presheaves of sets is injective: if every
`φ.app U` is injective, then the sheafified morphism is locally injective, which for a morphism of
sheaves is injectivity (see `TopCat.Presheaf.injective_app_presheafToSheaf_map_of_injective`).
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallyInjective_presheafToSheaf_map_of_injective
    (hφ : ∀ U, Function.Injective (φ.app U)) :
    Sheaf.IsLocallyInjective
      ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Type u)).map φ)

declarations.name: TopCat.Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_presheafToSheaf_map_of_surjective
declarations.doc:
The sheafification of a surjective morphism of presheaves of sets is surjective: if every
`φ.app U` is surjective, then every section of the sheafification of `G` is locally in the image of
the sheafification of `φ`.
declarations.statement:
theorem isLocallySurjective_presheafToSheaf_map_of_surjective
    (hφ : ∀ U, Function.Surjective (φ.app U)) :
    Sheaf.IsLocallySurjective
      ((presheafToSheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) (Type u)).map φ)

declarations.name: exists_common_extension
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Lemma 0H7K**: Given two field extensions E/K and F/K, there exists a common field
extension M/K with K-algebra maps E → M and F → M. (The Lean statement is more general but will
apply where `[Field K] [Field E] [Field F]` by virtue of Mathlib instance
`Module.FaithfullyFlat.lTensor_nontrivial`.)
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_common_extension (K : Type u) (E : Type v) (F : Type w) [CommSemiring K]
    [CommRing E] [CommSemiring F] [Algebra K E] [Algebra K F] [Nontrivial (E ⊗[K] F)] :
    ∃ (M : Type (max v w)) (_ : Field M) (_ : Algebra K M) (_ : Algebra E M) (_ : Algebra F M),
    IsScalarTower K E M ∧ IsScalarTower K F M

declarations.name: contraction_ne_bot_of_algebraic
declarations.doc:
**Algebraic core (Stacks 0H7L).** Let `A ⊆ B` be an inclusion of integral
domains, modeled by an injective `algebraMap A B`. Let `K = Frac(A)` and
`L = Frac(B)` be their fields of fractions, with the induced field embedding
`K ↪ L` (encoded by the algebra structure `Algebra K L` and the scalar towers
`A → K → L`, `A → B → L`). Assume the extension `K ⊆ L` is algebraic. If `J` is
a nonzero ideal of `B`, then its contraction `A ∩ J = comap (algebraMap A B) J`
is a nonzero ideal of `A`.
declarations.statement:
theorem contraction_ne_bot_of_algebraic
    (A B K L : Type*)
    [CommRing A] [CommRing B] [IsDomain A] [IsDomain B]
    [Algebra A B] (hinj : Function.Injective (algebraMap A B))
    [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K]
    [Field L] [Algebra B L] [IsFractionRing B L]
    [Algebra A L] [Algebra K L]
    [IsScalarTower A B L] [IsScalarTower A K L]
    [Algebra.IsAlgebraic K L]
    (J : Ideal B) (hJ : J ≠ ⊥) :
    Ideal.comap (algebraMap A B) J ≠ ⊥
declarations.comment: first sentence

declarations.name: PrimeSpectrum.not_dense_image_comap_of_isAlgebraic
declarations.doc:
Let `A → B` be an algebraic ring map from a reduced ring into a domain. Then the image in
`Spec A` of a proper closed subset of `Spec B` is not dense.
declarations.statement:
theorem PrimeSpectrum.not_dense_image_comap_of_isAlgebraic {A B : Type*} [CommRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsReduced A] [IsDomain B] [Algebra A B] [Algebra.IsAlgebraic A B]
    {Z : Set (PrimeSpectrum B)} (hZ : IsClosed Z) (hZ' : Z ≠ Set.univ) :
    ¬ Dense (PrimeSpectrum.comap (algebraMap A B) '' Z)
declarations.comment: second sentence

declarations.name: projective_of_projective_quotient_inter_zero
declarations.doc:
Stacks Tag 0H7M, Lemma 10.77.8: if $I \cap J = 0$ and both $P/IP$ (as an
$R/I$-module) and $P/JP$ (as an $R/J$-module) are projective, then $P$ is a
projective $R$-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem projective_of_projective_quotient_inter_zero
    (R : Type*) [CommRing R] (I J : Ideal R) (hIJ : I ⊓ J = ⊥)
    (P : Type*) [AddCommGroup P] [Module R P]
    (hI : Module.Projective (R ⧸ I) (P ⧸ (I • (⊤ : Submodule R P))))
    (hJ : Module.Projective (R ⧸ J) (P ⧸ (J • (⊤ : Submodule R P)))) :
    Module.Projective R P

declarations.name: Module.flat_and_faithfullyFlat_of_flat_away_of_flat_quotSMulTop
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H7N.** Let `A` be a ring, let `M` be an `A`-module and let `f ∈ A` be a
nonzerodivisor on `A` and on `M`. If `M_f` is a flat `A_f`-module and `M/fM` is a flat
`A/fA`-module, then `M` is a flat `A`-module; the same with "flat" replaced by "faithfully flat".

Here `A_f` is any localization `Aₜ` of `A` away from `f` and `M_f` is any localization `Mₜ` of `M`
at the powers of `f`, while `M/fM` is `QuotSMulTop f M` as a module over `A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}`.
declarations.statement:
theorem flat_and_faithfullyFlat_of_flat_away_of_flat_quotSMulTop
    {A : Type*} [CommRing A] {M : Type*} [AddCommGroup M] [Module A M] (f : A)
    (Aₜ : Type*) [CommRing Aₜ] [Algebra A Aₜ] [IsLocalization.Away f Aₜ]
    (Mₜ : Type*) [AddCommGroup Mₜ] [Module A Mₜ] [Module Aₜ Mₜ] [IsScalarTower A Aₜ Mₜ]
    (g : M →ₗ[A] Mₜ) [IsLocalizedModule (Submonoid.powers f) g]
    (hA : IsSMulRegular A f) (hM : IsSMulRegular M f) :
    (Flat Aₜ Mₜ → Flat (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) (QuotSMulTop f M) → Flat A M) ∧
      (FaithfullyFlat Aₜ Mₜ → FaithfullyFlat (A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) (QuotSMulTop f M) →
        FaithfullyFlat A M)
declarations.comment:
The two forms of the lemma are the two components of the conjunction: they share
the hypotheses on `f`. `M_f` is an arbitrary localization away from `f` (`IsLocalization.Away`,
`IsLocalizedModule`) rather than the model, `M/fM` is `QuotSMulTop f M` over `A ⧸ Ideal.span {f}`,
and `f` a nonzerodivisor on `A` and on `M` is `IsSMulRegular A f` and `IsSMulRegular M f`.

declarations.name: Module.flat_and_faithfullyFlat_of_isLocalized_away_of_isZero_Tor'
declarations.doc:
Let `A` be a ring, let `M` be an `A`-module, and let `I` be the ideal
generated by a finite family of elements `f i` of `A`, with `r` the number of generators. Assume
`Tor_n^A(A/I, M) = 0` for `1 ≤ n ≤ r + 1`. If each localization `M_{f i}` is flat over `A_{f i}`
and `M/IM` is flat over `A/I`, then `M` is flat over `A`; and the same with "flat" replaced by
"faithfully flat" throughout.

Here `Tor_n^A(A/I, M)` is `((Tor' (ModuleCat A) n).obj (A ⧸ I)).obj M`, the `n`-th left derived
functor of `- ⊗_A M` evaluated at `A ⧸ I`, and `M/IM` is `M ⧸ I • ⊤` with its canonical
`A ⧸ I`-module structure. The localizations are given abstractly, by
`IsLocalization.Away (f i) (Af i)` and `IsLocalizedModule.Away (f i) (g i)`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem flat_and_faithfullyFlat_of_isLocalized_away_of_isZero_Tor'
    (hI : Ideal.span (Set.range f) = I)
    (hTor : ∀ n : ℕ, 1 ≤ n → n ≤ Nat.card ι + 1 →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} A) n).obj (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I))).obj
        (ModuleCat.of A M))) :
    ((∀ i, Module.Flat (Af i) (Mf i)) →
        Module.Flat (A ⧸ I) (M ⧸ (I • (⊤ : Submodule A M))) →
        Module.Flat A M) ∧
      ((∀ i, Module.FaithfullyFlat (Af i) (Mf i)) →
        Module.FaithfullyFlat (A ⧸ I) (M ⧸ (I • (⊤ : Submodule A M))) →
        Module.FaithfullyFlat A M)
declarations.comment:
Both statements: `.1` is the flat one and `.2` the faithfully flat one ("same
with flat replaced by faithfully flat"), sharing the generating family and the Tor hypotheses.
The two arguments of `Tor_n^A` are in the order used by the source's own proof (through 051C),
namely `Tor_n^A(A/I, M)`; the two orders agree by the symmetry of Tor (00M3). The generators are
a family indexed by a finite type, and the source's `r ≥ 1` is dropped. See the module
docstring.

declarations.name: henselization_iInf_equiv_pi
declarations.doc:
Let `(I i)` be a finite nonempty family of pairwise comaximal ideals of a commutative ring `A`.
For arbitrary choices of a henselization `Aʰ` of `A` along `⨅ i, I i` and henselizations `Aʰᵢ`
along each `I i`, the natural map from `Aʰ` to the product of the `Aʰᵢ` is an isomorphism. The
displayed compatibility with the structure maps identifies this isomorphism canonically.
declarations.statement:
theorem henselization_iInf_equiv_pi {ι : Type} [Finite ι] [Nonempty ι]
    (A : Type u) [CommRing A] (I : ι → Ideal A)
    (hI : ∀ i j, i ≠ j → I i ⊔ I j = ⊤)
    (Ah : Type u) [CommRing Ah] (algebraMap_h : A →+* Ah)
    (hAh : HenselianPair Ah ((⨅ i, I i).map algebraMap_h) ∧
      ∀ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (J : Ideal B),
        HenselianPair B J →
          ∀ f : A →+* B, (⨅ i, I i) ≤ J.comap f →
            ∃! g : Ah →+* B,
              g.comp algebraMap_h = f ∧ (⨅ i, I i).map algebraMap_h ≤ J.comap g)
    (Ahi : ι → Type u) [∀ i, CommRing (Ahi i)] (algebraMap_i : ∀ i, A →+* Ahi i)
    (hAhi : ∀ i, HenselianPair (Ahi i) ((I i).map (algebraMap_i i)) ∧
      ∀ (B : Type u) (_ : CommRing B) (J : Ideal B),
        HenselianPair B J →
          ∀ f : A →+* B, I i ≤ J.comap f →
            ∃! g : Ahi i →+* B,
              g.comp (algebraMap_i i) = f ∧ (I i).map (algebraMap_i i) ≤ J.comap g) :
    ∃! e : Ah ≃+* (∀ i, Ahi i),
      ∀ (a : A) (i : ι), e (algebraMap_h a) i = algebraMap_i i a

declarations.name: isRegularRingHom_flat_geometricallyRegular_specialFiber_formallySmooth_tfae_0h7u
declarations.statement:
public theorem isRegularRingHom_flat_geometricallyRegular_specialFiber_formallySmooth_tfae_0h7u
    {A : Type u} {B : Type v}
    [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    [CommRing B] [IsNoetherianRing B] [IsLocalRing B]
    (f : A →+* B) [IsLocalHom f]
    (hA : letI : WithIdeal A := ⟨maximalIdeal A⟩
      IsRegularRingHom
        (Completion.coeRingHom : A →+* Completion A)) :
    letI : Algebra A B := f.toAlgebra
    let k := ResidueField A
    let Bbar := k ⊗[A] B
    List.TFAE [
      IsRegularRingHom f,
      Module.Flat A B ∧ Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular k Bbar,
      Module.Flat A B ∧
        RingHom.FormallySmoothNAdic.{max u v}
          (algebraMap k Bbar) (maximalIdeal Bbar),
      RingHom.FormallySmoothNAdic.{max u v} f (maximalIdeal B)]

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Kunneth.exists_kunneth_convolution_spectral_sequence
declarations.doc:
For decreasingly filtered complexes `K` and `L` satisfying the flatness and K-flatness
assumptions of the Künneth construction, there is a convolution-filtered tensor product `T` and an
associated spectral sequence with the expected first page. If both filtrations are finite, or their
steps are eventually acyclic and eventually quasi-isomorphic to the underlying complexes, then the
first page has finite support in each total degree, the induced filtration on cohomology is finite,
and the sequence converges with the canonical stable-page comparison.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_kunneth_convolution_spectral_sequence
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (K L : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
    (hflatK :
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Flat R (K.X.X n)) ∧
      (∀ i n : ℤ, Module.Flat R ((K.filtration.obj (op i)).X n)) ∧
      (∀ i n : ℤ, Module.Flat R (((FilteredObject.gr i).obj K).X n)))
    (hflatL :
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Flat R (L.X.X n)) ∧
      (∀ i n : ℤ, Module.Flat R ((L.filtration.obj (op i)).X n)) ∧
      (∀ i n : ℤ, Module.Flat R (((FilteredObject.gr i).obj L).X n)))
    (hkflatK : K.X.KFlat ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, (K.filtration.obj (op i)).KFlat) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, ((FilteredObject.gr i).obj K).KFlat))
    (hkflatL : L.X.KFlat ∧ (∀ i : ℤ, (L.filtration.obj (op i)).KFlat) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, ((FilteredObject.gr i).obj L).KFlat)) :
    ∃ (T : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
      (eT : K.X ⊗ L.X ≅ T.X),
      (∀ p n : ℤ, ∀ Q : Subobject (T.X.X n),
        Subobject.mk ((T.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n) ≤ Q ↔
          ∀ ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = p},
            imageSubobject ((((K.filtration.ι.app (op ij.1.1)) ⊗ₘ
              (L.filtration.ι.app (op ij.1.2))) ≫ eT.hom).f n) ≤ Q) ∧
      ∃ (F : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
        (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
        (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
        (FH : ∀ (n _p : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.homology n))
        (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0)
        (hE : ∀ (r p q n : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_ : n = p + q), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _ (inf_le_right : D r p n ⊓ Z r p n ≤ Z r p n))),
      (∀ p n : ℤ, F p n = Subobject.mk ((T.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n)) ∧
      (∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
        F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (T.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1))) ∧
      (∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
        (Subobject.«exists» (T.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1))) ∧
      (∀ n p : ℤ, FH n p =
        imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((E.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
        ∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = p} ↦
          (((FilteredObject.gr ij.1.1).obj K) ⊗
            ((FilteredObject.gr ij.1.2).obj L)).homology (p + q))) ∧
      (((K.filtration.IsFinite ∧ L.filtration.IsFinite) ∨
          ∃ a b : ℤ, a < b ∧
            (∀ i : ℤ, b < i → (K.filtration.obj (op i)).Acyclic) ∧
            (∀ i : ℤ, i < a → QuasiIso (K.filtration.ι.app (op i))) ∧
            (∀ j : ℤ, b < j → (L.filtration.obj (op j)).Acyclic) ∧
            (∀ j : ℤ, j < a → QuasiIso (L.filtration.ι.app (op j)))) →
      (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ FH n a = ⊤ ∧ FH n b = ⊥) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), b ≤ r →
      (E.page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0) ∧
    (∀ p n : ℤ,
      IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (T.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1)) ⊔ F (p + 1) n)
        (kernelSubobject (T.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n) ∧
      IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ =>
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.«exists» (T.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (F (p - r) (n - 1)) ⊔
            F (p + 1) n)
        (imageSubobject (T.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n)) ∧
    (∀ p n : ℤ,
      let A := (Subobject.pullback (T.X.iCycles n)).obj (F p n)
      let N := kernelSubobject (T.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
      let B := imageSubobject (T.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
      ∃ (a : (A : ModuleCat.{u} R) ⟶ (N : ModuleCat.{u} R))
        (b : (A : ModuleCat.{u} R) ⟶
          image (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))
        (e : cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≅
          cokernel (image.preComp
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.diagram.map
              (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))),
        A.arrow ≫ T.X.iCycles n = a ≫ N.arrow ∧
        A.arrow ≫ T.X.homologyπ n =
          b ≫ image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n) ∧
        a ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≫ e.hom =
          b ≫ cokernel.π (image.preComp
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.diagram.map
              (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
            (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))))

declarations.name: CochainComplex.KFlat.exists_free_kFlat_filtered_resolution
declarations.doc:
A filtered complex of modules admits a filtered morphism from a complex whose underlying
terms, filtration steps, and associated graded pieces are free and K-flat, and this morphism is
a quasi-isomorphism on the underlying complex, on every filtration step, and on every associated
graded piece.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_free_kFlat_filtered_resolution
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (K : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ) :
    ∃ (P : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ) (f : P ⟶ K),
      (∀ n : ℤ, Module.Free R (P.X.X n)) ∧
      (∀ i n : ℤ, Module.Free R ((P.filtration.obj (op i)).X n)) ∧
      (∀ i n : ℤ,
        Module.Free R (((FilteredObject.gr i).obj P).X n)) ∧
      P.X.KFlat ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, (P.filtration.obj (op i)).KFlat) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, ((FilteredObject.gr i).obj P).KFlat) ∧
      QuasiIso f.hom ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, QuasiIso (f.natTrans.app (op i))) ∧
      (∀ i : ℤ, QuasiIso ((FilteredObject.gr i).map f))

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Kunneth.exists_kunneth_filtered_complex
declarations.doc:
Two filtered complexes of modules have a filtered K-flat tensor representative whose
associated spectral sequence has the expected Künneth first page. If the filtration steps of both
complexes are eventually acyclic and eventually quasi-isomorphic to the underlying complexes,
then the first page is bounded in every total degree, the induced filtration on cohomology is
finite, and the spectral sequence converges canonically to the cohomology of the derived tensor
product.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_kunneth_filtered_complex
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (K L : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ) :
    ∃ (P Q : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
      (f : P ⟶ K) (g : Q ⟶ L)
      (T : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} R) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
      (eT : P.X ⊗ Q.X ≅ T.X),
      ((∀ n : ℤ, Module.Flat R (P.X.X n)) ∧
        (∀ i n : ℤ, Module.Flat R ((P.filtration.obj (op i)).X n)) ∧
        (∀ i n : ℤ, Module.Flat R (((FilteredObject.gr i).obj P).X n)) ∧
        P.X.KFlat ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, (P.filtration.obj (op i)).KFlat) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, ((FilteredObject.gr i).obj P).KFlat) ∧
        QuasiIso f.hom ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, QuasiIso (f.natTrans.app (op i))) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, QuasiIso ((FilteredObject.gr i).map f))) ∧
      ((∀ n : ℤ, Module.Flat R (Q.X.X n)) ∧
        (∀ i n : ℤ, Module.Flat R ((Q.filtration.obj (op i)).X n)) ∧
        (∀ i n : ℤ, Module.Flat R (((FilteredObject.gr i).obj Q).X n)) ∧
        Q.X.KFlat ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, (Q.filtration.obj (op i)).KFlat) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, ((FilteredObject.gr i).obj Q).KFlat) ∧
        QuasiIso g.hom ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, QuasiIso (g.natTrans.app (op i))) ∧
        (∀ i : ℤ, QuasiIso ((FilteredObject.gr i).map g))) ∧
      (∀ p n : ℤ, ∀ U : Subobject (T.X.X n),
        Subobject.mk ((T.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n) ≤ U ↔
          ∀ ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = p},
            imageSubobject ((((P.filtration.ι.app (op ij.1.1)) ⊗ₘ
              (Q.filtration.ι.app (op ij.1.2))) ≫ eT.hom).f n) ≤ U) ∧
      ∃ (F : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
        (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
        (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
        (FH : ∀ (n _p : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.homology n))
        (E : CohomologicalSpectralSequence (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0)
        (hE : ∀ (r p q n : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r) (_ : n = p + q), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _
            (inf_le_right : D r p n ⊓ Z r p n ≤ Z r p n))),
        (∀ p n : ℤ, F p n = Subobject.mk ((T.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n)) ∧
        (∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (T.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1))) ∧
        (∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
          (Subobject.«exists» (T.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1))) ∧
        (∀ n p : ℤ, FH n p =
          imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)) ∧
        (∀ p q : ℤ, Nonempty ((E.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, q) ≅
          ∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = p} ↦
            (((FilteredObject.gr ij.1.1).obj P) ⊗
              ((FilteredObject.gr ij.1.2).obj Q)).homology (p + q))) ∧
        (((∃ b : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, b < i → (K.filtration.obj (op i)).Acyclic) ∧
          (∃ a : ℤ, ∀ i : ℤ, i < a → QuasiIso (K.filtration.ι.app (op i))) ∧
          (∃ b : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, b < j → (L.filtration.obj (op j)).Acyclic) ∧
          (∃ a : ℤ, ∀ j : ℤ, j < a → QuasiIso (L.filtration.ι.app (op j)))) →
          (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 1 (by omega)).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
          (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ FH n a = ⊤ ∧ FH n b = ⊥) ∧
          (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ b : ℤ, ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : 0 ≤ r), b ≤ r →
            (E.page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0) ∧
          (∀ p n : ℤ,
            IsGLB (Set.range fun r : ℕ ↦
                F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (T.X.d n (n + 1))).obj
                  (F (p + r) (n + 1)) ⊔ F (p + 1) n)
              (kernelSubobject (T.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n) ∧
            IsLUB (Set.range fun r : ℕ ↦
                F p n ⊓ (Subobject.«exists» (T.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj
                  (F (p - r) (n - 1)) ⊔ F (p + 1) n)
              (imageSubobject (T.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n)) ∧
          (∀ p n : ℤ,
            let A := (Subobject.pullback (T.X.iCycles n)).obj (F p n)
            let N := kernelSubobject (T.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
            let B := imageSubobject (T.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
            ∃ (a : (A : ModuleCat.{u} R) ⟶ (N : ModuleCat.{u} R))
              (b : (A : ModuleCat.{u} R) ⟶
                image (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))
              (e : cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≅
                cokernel (image.preComp
                  (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.diagram.map
                    (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
                  (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))),
              A.arrow ≫ T.X.iCycles n = a ≫ N.arrow ∧
              A.arrow ≫ T.X.homologyπ n =
                b ≫ image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
                  (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n) ∧
              a ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≫ e.hom =
                b ≫ cokernel.π (image.preComp
                  (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.diagram.map
                    (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
                  (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
                    (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))))

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Kunneth.exists_kunneth_spectral_sequence
declarations.doc:
**Künneth spectral sequence.** For bounded complexes `K` and `L` of modules over a
commutative ring, there is a bounded cohomological spectral sequence with
`E₂^(p,q) = ⊕_(i+j=q) Tor_(-p)(H^i(K), H^j(L))`, converging to the cohomology in degree
`p + q` of the derived tensor product. The derived tensor product is represented here by the
tensor product of K-flat replacements of `K` and `L`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_kunneth_spectral_sequence
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R]
    (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ)
    (L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} R) ℤ)
    (aK bK aL bL : ℤ) [K.IsGE aK] [K.IsLE bK] [L.IsGE aL] [L.IsLE bL] :
    let S := ULift.{max v w} R
    let U : ModuleCat.{v} R ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v w} S :=
      ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{max u w} R ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom
    let V : ModuleCat.{w} R ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v w} S :=
      ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{max u v} R ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom
    let K' := (U.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K
    let L' := (V.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L
    ∃ (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat S) ℤ) (f : P ⟶ K') (g : Q ⟶ L')
      (_ : QuasiIso f) (_ : QuasiIso g) (_ : P.KFlat) (_ : Q.KFlat)
      (T : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat S) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
      (eT : P ⊗ Q ≅ T.X)
      (E : E₂CohomologicalSpectralSequence (ModuleCat S))
      (F : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
      (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
      (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
      (FH : ∀ (_n _p : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.homology _n))
      (hE : ∀ (r p q : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
        cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _
          (inf_le_right : D (r - 1) (-q) (p + q) ⊓ Z (r - 1) (-q) (p + q) ≤
            Z (r - 1) (-q) (p + q)))),
      (∀ p n : ℤ, F p n = Subobject.mk ((T.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n)) ∧
      (∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
        F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (T.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1))) ∧
      (∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
        (Subobject.«exists» (T.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1))) ∧
      (∀ n p : ℤ, FH n p =
        imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, p ≤ 0 →
        Nonempty ((E.page 2).X (p, q) ≅
          ∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = q} ↦
            ((Tor' (ModuleCat S) (-p).toNat).obj (K'.homology ij.1.1)).obj
              (L'.homology ij.1.2))) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, 0 < p → IsZero ((E.page 2).X (p, q))) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 2).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ FH n a = ⊤ ∧ FH n b = ⊥) ∧
      (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ (r₀ : ℤ) (hr₀ : 2 ≤ r₀), ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r),
        let n := p + q
        let i := -q
        let N := kernelSubobject (T.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F i n ⊔ F (i + 1) n
        let B := imageSubobject (T.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F i n ⊔ F (i + 1) n
        (E.page r (by omega)).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0 ∧
          Z (r - 1) i n ⊔ F (i + 1) n = N ∧
          (D (r - 1) i n ⊓ Z (r - 1) i n) ⊔ F (i + 1) n = B ⊓ N) ∧
      (∀ p n : ℤ,
        let A := (Subobject.pullback (T.X.iCycles n)).obj (F p n)
        let N := kernelSubobject (T.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
        let B := imageSubobject (T.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
        ∃ (a : (A : ModuleCat S) ⟶ (N : ModuleCat S))
          (b : (A : ModuleCat S) ⟶
            image (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))
          (e : cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≅
            cokernel (image.preComp
              (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.diagram.map
                (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
              (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))),
          A.arrow ≫ T.X.iCycles n = a ≫ N.arrow ∧
          A.arrow ≫ T.X.homologyπ n =
            b ≫ image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
              (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n) ∧
          a ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≫ e.hom =
            b ≫ cokernel.π (image.preComp
              (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.diagram.map
                (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
              (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
                (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)))

declarations.name: CochainComplex.Kunneth.tor_isZero_and_exists_kunneth_shortExact
declarations.doc:
**Künneth short exact sequence over a Dedekind domain.** Higher Tor modules vanish over a
Dedekind domain. Thus the bounded Künneth spectral sequence degenerates at `E₂`, and its edge
maps exhibit the cohomology of a derived tensor product as an extension of the direct sum of
tensor products in total degree `n` by the direct sum of first Tor modules in total degree
`n + 1`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem tor_isZero_and_exists_kunneth_shortExact
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsDedekindDomain R] :
    let S := ULift.{max v w} R
    let U : ModuleCat.{v} R ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v w} S :=
      ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{max u w} R ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom
    let V : ModuleCat.{w} R ⥤ ModuleCat.{max u v w} S :=
      ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{max u v} R ⋙ ModuleCat.restrictScalars ULift.ringEquiv.toRingHom
    (∀ (M : ModuleCat.{v} R) (N : ModuleCat.{w} R) (i : ℕ), i ≠ 0 → i ≠ 1 →
      IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat S) i).obj (U.obj M)).obj (V.obj N))) ∧
    ∀ (K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{v} R) ℤ) (L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{w} R) ℤ)
      (aK bK aL bL : ℤ) [K.IsGE aK] [K.IsLE bK] [L.IsGE aL] [L.IsLE bL],
      let K' := (U.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K
      let L' := (V.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L
      ∃ (P Q : CochainComplex (ModuleCat S) ℤ) (f : P ⟶ K') (g : Q ⟶ L')
        (_ : QuasiIso f) (_ : QuasiIso g) (_ : P.KFlat) (_ : Q.KFlat)
        (T : FilteredObject (CochainComplex (ModuleCat S) ℤ) ℤᵒᵖ)
        (eT : P ⊗ Q ≅ T.X)
        (E : E₂CohomologicalSpectralSequence (ModuleCat S))
        (F : ∀ (_p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
        (Z : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
        (D : ∀ (_r _p n : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.X n))
        (FH : ∀ (_n _p : ℤ), Subobject (T.X.homology _n))
        (_hE : ∀ (r p q : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r), (E.page r hr).X (p, q) ≅
          cokernel (Subobject.ofLE _ _
            (inf_le_right : D (r - 1) (-q) (p + q) ⊓ Z (r - 1) (-q) (p + q) ≤
              Z (r - 1) (-q) (p + q))))
        (e₂ : ∀ (p q : ℤ) (_hp : p ≤ 0), (E.page 2).X (p, q) ≅
          ∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = q} ↦
            ((Tor' (ModuleCat S) (-p).toNat).obj (K'.homology ij.1.1)).obj
              (L'.homology ij.1.2)),
        (∀ p n : ℤ, F p n = Subobject.mk ((T.filtration.ι.app (op p)).f n)) ∧
        (∀ r p n : ℤ, Z r p n =
          F p n ⊓ (Subobject.pullback (T.X.d n (n + 1))).obj (F (p + r) (n + 1))) ∧
        (∀ r p n : ℤ, D r p n = Z (r - 1) (p + 1) n ⊔
          (Subobject.«exists» (T.X.d (n - 1) n)).obj (Z (r - 1) (p - r + 1) (n - 1))) ∧
        (∀ n p : ℤ, FH n p =
          imageSubobject (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)) ∧
        (∀ p q : ℤ, 0 < p → IsZero ((E.page 2).X (p, q))) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, {p : ℤ | ¬ IsZero ((E.page 2).X (p, n - p))}.Finite) ∧
        (∀ n : ℤ, ∃ a b : ℤ, a ≤ b ∧ FH n a = ⊤ ∧ FH n b = ⊥) ∧
        (∀ p q : ℤ, ∃ (r₀ : ℤ) (hr₀ : 2 ≤ r₀), ∀ (r : ℤ) (hr : r₀ ≤ r),
          let n := p + q
          let i := -q
          let N := kernelSubobject (T.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F i n ⊔ F (i + 1) n
          let B := imageSubobject (T.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F i n ⊔ F (i + 1) n
          (E.page r (by omega)).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0 ∧
            Z (r - 1) i n ⊔ F (i + 1) n = N ∧
            (D (r - 1) i n ⊓ Z (r - 1) i n) ⊔ F (i + 1) n = B ⊓ N) ∧
        (∀ p n : ℤ,
          let A := (Subobject.pullback (T.X.iCycles n)).obj (F p n)
          let N := kernelSubobject (T.X.d n (n + 1)) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
          let B := imageSubobject (T.X.d (n - 1) n) ⊓ F p n ⊔ F (p + 1) n
          ∃ (a : (A : ModuleCat S) ⟶ (N : ModuleCat S))
            (b : (A : ModuleCat S) ⟶
              image (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))
            (e : cokernel (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≅
              cokernel (image.preComp
                (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.diagram.map
                  (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
                (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n))),
            (A.arrow ≫ T.X.iCycles n = a ≫ N.arrow ∧
            A.arrow ≫ T.X.homologyπ n =
              b ≫ image.ι (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
                (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n) ∧
            a ≫ cokernel.π (Subobject.ofLE (B ⊓ N) N inf_le_right) ≫ e.hom =
              b ≫ cokernel.π (image.preComp
                (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap (T.filtration.diagram.map
                  (homOfLE (Int.le_add_one le_rfl) : (p : ℤ) ⟶ p + 1).op) n)
                (HomologicalComplex.homologyMap
                  (T.filtration.ι.app (op p)) n)))) ∧
        (∀ (r p q : ℤ) (hr : 2 ≤ r),
          (E.page r hr).d (p, q) (p + r, q - r + 1) = 0) ∧
        ∀ n : ℤ,
          FH n (-n - 1) = ⊤ ∧ FH n (-n + 1) = ⊥ ∧
          ∃ (torZeroTensor :
              (∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = n} ↦
                ((Tor' (ModuleCat S) (-0 : ℤ).toNat).obj
                  (K'.homology ij.1.1)).obj (L'.homology ij.1.2)) ≅
              ∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = n} ↦
                K'.homology ij.1.1 ⊗ L'.homology ij.1.2)
            (torOne :
              (∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = n + 1} ↦
                ((Tor' (ModuleCat S) (-(-1 : ℤ)).toNat).obj
                  (K'.homology ij.1.1)).obj (L'.homology ij.1.2)) ≅
              ∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = n + 1} ↦
                ((Tor' (ModuleCat S) 1).obj (K'.homology ij.1.1)).obj
                  (L'.homology ij.1.2))
            (eTensor : (E.page 2).X (0, n) ≅
              ∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = n} ↦
                K'.homology ij.1.1 ⊗ L'.homology ij.1.2)
            (eTor : (E.page 2).X (-1, n + 1) ≅
              ∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = n + 1} ↦
                ((Tor' (ModuleCat S) 1).obj (K'.homology ij.1.1)).obj
                  (L'.homology ij.1.2))
            (e₀ : (E.page 2).X (0, n) ≅ (FH n (-n) : ModuleCat S))
            (e₁ : (E.page 2).X (-1, n + 1) ≅ cokernel (FH n (-n)).arrow)
            (ι : (∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = n} ↦
                K'.homology ij.1.1 ⊗ L'.homology ij.1.2) ⟶ (P ⊗ Q).homology n)
            (π : (P ⊗ Q).homology n ⟶
              ∐ fun ij : {ij : ℤ × ℤ // ij.1 + ij.2 = n + 1} ↦
                ((Tor' (ModuleCat S) 1).obj (K'.homology ij.1.1)).obj
                  (L'.homology ij.1.2))
            (h : ι ≫ π = 0),
            eTensor = (e₂ 0 n (by omega)).trans torZeroTensor ∧
            eTor = (e₂ (-1) (n + 1) (by omega)).trans torOne ∧
            ι = eTensor.inv ≫ e₀.hom ≫ (FH n (-n)).arrow ≫
                HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eT.inv n ∧
            π = HomologicalComplex.homologyMap eT.hom n ≫
                cokernel.π (FH n (-n)).arrow ≫ e₁.inv ≫ eTor.hom ∧
            (ShortComplex.mk ι π h).ShortExact

declarations.name: StacksDraft.Perfect.hasFlatRepresentative_derivedDual
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H81.** If a perfect complex has Tor amplitude in `[a, b]` -- that is, a flat
representative supported in `[a, b]` -- then its derived dual has Tor amplitude in `[-b, -a]`.
declarations.statement:
theorem hasFlatRepresentative_derivedDual
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max u v} (ULift.{v} A)))
    (hK : IsPerfect K) {a b : ℤ}
    (hKamp : HasFlatRepresentative K a b) :
    HasFlatRepresentative (derivedDual K) (-b) (-a)

declarations.name: StacksDraft.PowerTorsionVanishing.positive_homology_derivedTensorProduct_isZero_of_mod_ideal
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H82.** If `K ⊗ᴸ[R] R / I` has no positive cohomology, then positive cohomology
also vanishes after derived tensoring `K` with every positive-power quotient of `R`, with
every `I`-power-torsion module, and with every bounded, nonpositively concentrated object of
`D(R)` whose cohomology is `I`-power torsion.
declarations.statement:
public theorem positive_homology_derivedTensorProduct_isZero_of_mod_ideal
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (I : Ideal R)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} R))
    (hK : ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj
        (((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor R).obj K).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj
            (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I)))))) :
    (∀ (n : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj
        (((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor R).obj K).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj
            (ModuleCat.of R (R ⧸ I ^ n)))))) ∧
    (∀ (N : ModuleCat.{u} R), IsIPowerTorsion R N I → ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj
        (((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor R).obj K).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) 0).obj N)))) ∧
    (∀ (M : DerivedCategory.Bounded (ModuleCat.{u} R)),
      (∀ i : ℤ, IsIPowerTorsion R
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj M.obj) I) →
      (∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj M.obj)) →
      ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i →
        IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} R) i).obj
          (((CochainComplex.DerivedTensor.canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor R).obj K).obj
            M.obj)))

declarations.name: KoszulTensorVanishing.positive_homology_isZero_iff_derivedTensorProduct_mod_ideal_iff_koszul
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H83.** For a complex derived complete with respect to the ideal
generated by a finite sequence, the following are equivalent: it has no positive cohomology,
its derived reduction modulo that ideal has no positive cohomology, and its derived tensor
product with the Koszul complex of the sequence has no positive cohomology.
declarations.statement:
theorem positive_homology_isZero_iff_derivedTensorProduct_mod_ideal_iff_koszul
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] {r : ℕ} (f : Fin r → A)
    (K : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :
    letI : HasProductsOfShape ℕ (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A)) :=
      Stacks.DerivedProducts.hasProductsOfShape_derivedCategory
    IsDerivedComplete (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) K →
    let I := Ideal.span (Set.range f)
    let K₁ : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} A) :=
      DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        ((ComplexShape.embeddingDownNat.extendFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A)).obj
          (Koszul.seqComplex f))
    let p₁ := ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj K)
    let p₂ := ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
        (((canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor A).obj K).obj
          ((DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) 0).obj
            (ModuleCat.of A (A ⧸ I)))))
    let p₃ := ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} A) i).obj
        (((canonicalDerivedTensorProductFunctor A).obj K).obj K₁))
    (p₁ ↔ p₂) ∧ (p₂ ↔ p₃)

declarations.name: Stacks.DerivedCategory.MultiplicationCone.homology_isZero_of_localization_and_cone_isZero
declarations.doc:
Let `C` be a cone of multiplication by `f` on `M`. If every negative cohomology module of
`M` vanishes after localizing away from `f`, and the cohomology of `C` vanishes in degrees below
`-1`, then every negative cohomology module of `M` vanishes.
declarations.statement:
theorem homology_isZero_of_localization_and_cone_isZero
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R]
    (f : R) (M C : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} R))
    (g : M ⟶ C) (h : C ⟶ M⟦1⟧)
    (hC : Triangle.mk (f • 𝟙 M) g h ∈
      distTriang (DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{v} R)))
    (hM : ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 →
      IsZero (ModuleCat.of R (LocalizedModule.Away f
        ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) i).obj M))))
    (hcone : ∀ i : ℤ, i < -1 →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) i).obj C)) :
    ∀ i : ℤ, i < 0 →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{v} R) i).obj M)

declarations.name: Stacks.Flatness.LocalizationReduction.isomorphic_to_flat_module_of_localization_and_quotient
declarations.doc:
Let `M ∈ D(R)` have no positive cohomology. If its derived base changes to the
localization `R_f` and the quotient `R / fR` are each isomorphic to a flat module placed in
degree zero, then `M` is isomorphic to a flat `R`-module placed in degree zero.
declarations.statement:
public theorem isomorphic_to_flat_module_of_localization_and_quotient
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] (f : R)
    (M : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{max v u} R))
    (hM : ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i →
      IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} R) i).obj M))
    (hAway : ∃ F : ModuleCat.{max v u} (Localization.Away f),
      Module.Flat (Localization.Away f) F ∧
        Nonempty ((CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.totalDerivedExtensionScalars
          (algebraMap R (Localization.Away f))).functor.obj M ≅
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{max v u} (Localization.Away f)) 0).obj F))
    (hQuot : ∃ F : ModuleCat.{max v u} (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}),
      Module.Flat (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f}) F ∧
        Nonempty ((CochainComplex.DerivedExtensionScalars.totalDerivedExtensionScalars
          (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {f}))).functor.obj M ≅
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (ModuleCat.{max v u} (R ⧸ Ideal.span {f})) 0).obj F)) :
    ∃ F : ModuleCat.{max v u} R, Module.Flat R F ∧
      Nonempty (M ≅
        (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor (ModuleCat.{max v u} R) 0).obj F)

declarations.name: DividedPowerRing.tensorProductQuotientEquivPushoutQuotient
declarations.doc:
For a pushout of divided power rings, the tensor product of the quotients of the two
factors over the quotient of the base is canonically isomorphic to the quotient of the
pushout.
declarations.statement:
public noncomputable def tensorProductQuotientEquivPushoutQuotient
    {A B B' B'' : DividedPowerRing.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) (f' : A ⟶ B')
    (g : B ⟶ B'') (g' : B' ⟶ B'') (h : IsPushout f f' g g') :
    letI : Algebra (A ⧸ A.ideal) (B ⧸ B.ideal) := (quotientRingHom f).toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra (A ⧸ A.ideal) (B' ⧸ B'.ideal) := (quotientRingHom f').toAlgebra
    {e : (B ⧸ B.ideal) ⊗[A ⧸ A.ideal] (B' ⧸ B'.ideal) ≃+* (B'' ⧸ B''.ideal) //
      ∀ (b : B) (b' : B'),
        e (Ideal.Quotient.mk B.ideal b ⊗ₜ[A ⧸ A.ideal] Ideal.Quotient.mk B'.ideal b') =
          Ideal.Quotient.mk B''.ideal (g b * g' b')}
declarations.comment: quotient_of_pushout

declarations.name: DividedPowerRing.tensorProductToPushout_surjective
declarations.doc:
In a pushout of divided power rings, the canonical map from the tensor product of the
underlying rings to the underlying ring of the pushout is surjective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem tensorProductToPushout_surjective
    {A B B' B'' : DividedPowerRing.{u}} (f : A ⟶ B) (f' : A ⟶ B')
    (g : B ⟶ B'') (g' : B' ⟶ B'') (h : IsPushout f f' g g') :
    Function.Surjective (tensorProductToPushout f f' g g' h.w)
declarations.comment: tensor_map_surjective

declarations.name: DividedPowerRing.dividedPowerIdeal_surjective_of_isPushout
declarations.doc:
In a pushout of divided power rings, the canonical map from the sum of the two extended
divided power ideals onto the distinguished ideal of the pushout is surjective.
declarations.statement:
public theorem dividedPowerIdeal_surjective_of_isPushout
    {A B B' B'' : DividedPowerRing.{u}}
    (f : A ⟶ B) (g : A ⟶ B') (h : B ⟶ B'') (h' : B' ⟶ B'')
    (H : IsPushout f g h h') :
    letI : Algebra A B := f.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    letI : Algebra A B' := g.toRingHom.toAlgebra
    ∀ y : B''.ideal,
      ∃ x : (Ideal.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeLeftRingHom B.ideal +
          Ideal.map Algebra.TensorProduct.includeRight.toRingHom B'.ideal :
            Ideal (B ⊗[A] B')),
        canonicalTensorProductHom f g h h' H.w x.1 = y.1
declarations.comment: ideal_map_surjective

declarations.name: DividedPowers.factorial_mul_of_smul_add
declarations.doc:
Homogeneity and the divided-power addition law imply the factorial identity for the
`p`th operation.
declarations.statement:
public lemma factorial_mul_of_smul_add {A : Type*} [CommRing A] (I : Ideal A) (p : ℕ)
    (hp : p.Prime) (hA : ∀ n : ℕ, ¬p ∣ n → IsUnit (n : A)) (δ : I → I)
    (smul : ∀ (a : A) (x : I), δ (a • x) = a ^ p • δ x)
    (add : ∀ x y : I,
      (δ (x + y) : A) = (δ x : A) +
        ∑ ij ∈ (antidiagonal p).filter (fun ij ↦ ij.1 ≠ 0 ∧ ij.2 ≠ 0),
          factorialInverse p hp hA ij.1 * factorialInverse p hp hA ij.2 *
            (x : A) ^ ij.1 * (y : A) ^ ij.2 +
        (δ y : A)) :
    ∀ x : I, (p.factorial : A) * (δ x : A) = (x : A) ^ p

declarations.name: Stacks.AlgebraicGeometry.QcohLimits.isQuasicoherent_restrictScalars_iff
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H88.** Let `α : 𝒪_S ⟶ A` be a sheaf of rings on a scheme `S` which is
quasi-coherent as an `𝒪_S`-module.  An `A`-module is quasi-coherent as an `𝒪_S`-module if and
only if it is quasi-coherent as an `A`-module.
declarations.statement:
theorem isQuasicoherent_restrictScalars_iff
    (hA : ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} α).obj (SheafOfModules.unit A)).IsQuasicoherent)
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} A) :
    ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars.{u} α).obj G).IsQuasicoherent ↔ G.IsQuasicoherent

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.exists_isFlat_iff_exists_isFlat_derivedPullback
declarations.doc:
**Stacks 0H89** (Longke Tang). Let `f : X ⟶ S` be a surjective morphism of finite presentation
and let `M` be an object of `D_QCoh(𝒪_S)` such that `H^i(M) = 0` for `i > 0`. Then `M` is
isomorphic to a flat `𝒪_S`-module placed in degree `0` if and only if `Lf^*M` is isomorphic to a
flat `𝒪_X`-module placed in degree `0`.
declarations.statement:
theorem exists_isFlat_iff_exists_isFlat_derivedPullback [Surjective f]
    (hf : FinitePresentation f)
    (M : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.toRingedSpace)))
    (hQCoh : ∀ i : ℤ, ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.toRingedSpace)) i).obj M).IsQuasicoherent)
    (hM : ∀ i : ℤ, 0 < i → IsZero ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.toRingedSpace)) i).obj M)) :
    (∃ F : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.toRingedSpace),
      SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := S.toRingedSpace.sheaf) F ∧
        Nonempty (M ≅ (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
          (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing S.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj F)) ↔
      ∃ G : SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace),
        SheafOfModules.IsFlat.{u, u, u, u} (O := X.toRingedSpace.sheaf) G ∧
          Nonempty ((Stacks.Cohomology.DerivedAdjunctionOnRingedSpaces.derivedPullback
              f.toLRSHom.toShHom).obj M ≅
            (DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
              (SheafOfModules.{u} (structureSheafRing X.toRingedSpace)) 0).obj G)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpaceOfModule.exists_isOpen_forall_closedPoint_projection_restrict
declarations.doc:
**Stacks Project, Tag 0H8A.** Let `V` be a finite-dimensional vector space over an
algebraically closed field `k`, let `Z ⊆ X ⊆ 𝐏(V)` be closed subvarieties with `Z ≠ X` and
`X ≠ 𝐏(V)`, and let `x` be a point of `Z` which is nonsingular on `X`. Then there is a nonempty
Zariski open `U ⊆ 𝐏(V)` such that for every closed point `p ∈ U` the projection `r_p` is
defined on `Z` and the morphism `r_p|_Z : Z → r_p(Z)` is an isomorphism over an open
neighbourhood of `r_p(x)`.

`X` is a closed subvariety, a closed immersion `iX` whose source is a variety over `k`; `Z` is
an irreducible closed subscheme of `X`, the closed immersion `e` with `e ≫ iX = iZ` — this
generalizes the source, which takes `Z` reduced as well. `Z ≠ X` and `X ≠ 𝐏(V)` are `e` and `iX`
not being isomorphisms. That `r_p` is defined on `Z` is the lift `j` of `iZ` through the domain
of definition of the projection away from `p`, and the isomorphism of `Z` onto `r_p(Z)` over a
neighbourhood `N` of `r_p(x)` is spelled as `r_p|_Z` restricted over `N` being a closed
immersion, which is the same thing: a closed immersion over `N` is an isomorphism of its source
onto its scheme-theoretic image, and that image is `r_p(Z) ∩ N`.
declarations.statement:
public theorem exists_isOpen_forall_closedPoint_projection_restrict {Z X : Scheme.{u}}
    (iZ : Z ⟶ projectiveSpaceOfModule k V) [IsClosedImmersion iZ] [IrreducibleSpace Z]
    (iX : X ⟶ projectiveSpaceOfModule k V) [IsClosedImmersion iX]
    [IsVariety k (iX ≫ projectiveSpaceOfModuleToSpec k V)]
    (e : Z ⟶ X) (he : e ≫ iX = iZ) (hZX : ¬ IsIso e) (hX : ¬ IsIso iX)
    (x : Z) (hreg : e x ∈ regularLocus X) :
    ∃ U : (projectiveSpaceOfModule k V).Opens,
      (U : Set (projectiveSpaceOfModule k V)).Nonempty ∧
      ∀ p ∈ U, IsClosed ({p} : Set (projectiveSpaceOfModule k V)) →
        ∃ j : Z ⟶ (projectionDomain k V (pointSubmodule k V p)).toScheme,
          j ≫ (projectionDomain k V (pointSubmodule k V p)).ι = iZ ∧
          ∃ N : (projectiveSpaceOfModule k ↥(pointSubmodule k V p)).Opens,
            (j ≫ projection k V (pointSubmodule k V p)) x ∈ N ∧
            IsClosedImmersion ((j ≫ projection k V (pointSubmodule k V p)) ∣_ N)

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.diagonalPeriodicityEquiv
declarations.doc:
The diagonal three-periodicity identification in the Hom double-complex of two
distinguished triangles.
declarations.statement:
noncomputable def diagonalPeriodicityEquiv
    (K : HomDoubleComplexSetup (C := C)) (p q : ℤ) :
    K.term p q ≃+ K.term (p + 3) (q - 3)
declarations.comment: diagonal_periodicity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.diagonalPeriodicityEquiv_d₁
declarations.doc: The diagonal periodicity identification commutes with the first differential.
declarations.statement:
lemma diagonalPeriodicityEquiv_d₁
    (K : HomDoubleComplexSetup (C := C)) (p q : ℤ) (f : K.term p q) :
    cast (congrArg (fun i => K.term i (q - 3)) (by omega))
        (diagonalPeriodicityEquiv K (p + 1) q (K.d₁ p q f)) =
      K.d₁ (p + 3) (q - 3) (diagonalPeriodicityEquiv K p q f)
declarations.comment: diagonal_periodicity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.diagonalPeriodicityEquiv_d₂
declarations.doc: The diagonal periodicity identification commutes with the second differential.
declarations.statement:
lemma diagonalPeriodicityEquiv_d₂
    (K : HomDoubleComplexSetup (C := C)) (p q : ℤ) (f : K.term p q) :
    cast (congrArg (K.term (p + 3)) (by omega))
        (diagonalPeriodicityEquiv K p (q + 1) (K.d₂ p q f)) =
      K.d₂ (p + 3) (q - 3) (diagonalPeriodicityEquiv K p q f)
declarations.comment: diagonal_periodicity

declarations.name: AlgebraicGeometry.HomDoubleComplexSetup.d₁_exact

declarations.statement:
theorem d₁_exact (K : HomDoubleComplexSetup (C := C)) (p q : ℤ) :
